Savory Matcha Soba Pancakes with Scallion & Nori

Ingredients:
- 150 g buckwheat soba noodles, cooked and finely chopped
- 2 tbsp matcha powder
- 1 cup all‑purpose flour
- 1 egg
- 3/4 cup milk
- 2 tbsp soy sauce
- 2 tbsp chopped scallions
- 1 sheet nori, shredded
- 2 tbsp vegetable oil
- pinch of black pepper

Instructions:
1. In a bowl combine flour, matcha powder, and black pepper.
2. Whisk in egg, milk, soy sauce, and chopped soba until batter is smooth.
3. Fold in scallions and shredded nori.
4. Heat oil in a non‑stick skillet over medium heat; pour 1/4 cup batter per pancake.
5. Cook 2‑3 minutes each side until golden; keep warm.
6. Serve pancakes stacked, drizzled with a little soy‑matcha sauce.
title: Savory Matcha Soba Pancakes with Scallion & Nori

Matcha Soba Spring Rolls with Peanut‑Matcha Dipping Sauce

Ingredients:
- 100 g buckwheat soba noodles
- 8 rice paper wrappers
- 1 carrot, julienned
- 1 cucumber, julienned
- 4 lettuce leaves, torn
- 4 fresh mint leaves
- 2 tbsp matcha powder
- 3 tbsp soy sauce
- 2 tbsp peanut butter (smooth)
- 1 tbsp honey
- 1 tbsp lime juice
- 1 tsp sesame oil
- water (for softening wrappers)

Instructions:
1. Cook soba noodles, drain, and set aside.
2. Prepare dipping sauce: whisk matcha, soy sauce, peanut butter, honey, lime juice, and sesame oil until smooth.
3. Dip a rice paper wrapper in warm water 5 seconds; lay flat.
4. Place a lettuce leaf, some carrot, cucumber, mint, and a small handful of soba noodles near the bottom edge.
5. Fold sides inward, then roll tightly; repeat for remaining wrappers.
6. Serve rolls with the peanut‑matcha sauce.
title: Matcha Soba Spring Rolls with Peanut‑Matcha Dipping Sauce

Matcha Soba Carbonara with Crispy Pork Belly

Ingredients:
- 180 g buckwheat soba noodles

- 3 tbsp grated Parmesan cheese
- 2 tbsp matcha powder
- 2 tbsp soy sauce
- 1 tbsp mirin
- 1 tsp black pepper
- 1 tbsp vegetable oil

Instructions:

Inside‑Out Matcha Soba Sushi Rolls (Uramaki)

Ingredients:

- 4 nori sheets

Matcha Soba Pesto Pasta with Pine Nuts

Ingredients:
- 180 g buckwheat soba noodles

- 1 cup fresh basil leaves

text:
Nonce: 56c7b91d8cabb5feff1b06cfec77705471535a97

Matcha Soba Ice Cream with Black Sesame Swirl

Ingredients:
- 150 g buckwheat soba noodles, cooked and pureed
- 2 tbsp matcha powder
- 1 cup heavy cream
- 1 cup whole milk
- 3/4 cup granulated sugar
- 4 egg yolks
- 2 tbsp black sesame paste
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- pinch of salt

Instructions:
1. In a saucepan combine milk, cream, and half the sugar; heat until just simmering.
2. Whisk egg yolks with remaining sugar in a bowl; slowly pour hot milk mixture into yolks while whisking.
3. Return the custard to the saucepan; cook over low heat, stirring, until it coats the back of a spoon.
4. Remove from heat; stir in matcha powder, pureed soba, vanilla, and salt; chill completely.
5. Churn the mixture in an ice‑cream maker according to manufacturer’s directions.
6. In a separate bowl mix black sesame paste with a tablespoon of warm milk to loosen; swirl into the churned ice cream before freezing.
7. Freeze until firm and serve scoops garnished with a dusting of matcha.
title: Matcha Soba Ice Cream with Black Sesame Swirl

cuisine_title: **Title:** Caribbean Jerk Chicken with Mango Salsa
text:
Nonce: ad983178fdd9b4287b1f12e1e34704d15ef85ffd
Jerk Chicken Tacos with Pineapple Slaw

Ingredients:
- 2 lbs chicken thighs, boneless, skinless
- 2 tbsp Jamaican jerk seasoning
- 1 tbsp olive oil
- 8 small corn tortillas
- 1 cup fresh pineapple, finely diced
- ½ red bell pepper, thinly sliced
- ¼ cup red cabbage, shredded
- 2 tbsp lime juice
- 1 tbsp honey
- Fresh cilantro leaves for garnish

Instructions:
1. In a bowl, toss chicken with jerk seasoning and olive oil; let marinate 30 minutes.  
2. Grill chicken over medium‑high heat 6‑7 minutes per side, until cooked through; slice into strips.  
3. Combine pineapple, bell pepper, cabbage, lime juice, and honey in a bowl to make slaw; season with salt.  
4. Warm tortillas on the grill for 30 seconds per side.  
5. Assemble tacos by placing chicken strips on each tortilla, topping with pineapple slaw, and garnishing with cilantro.
title: Jerk Chicken Tacos with Pineapple Slaw

cuisine_title: **Title:** Caribbean Jerk Chicken with Mango Salsa
text:
Nonce: 9ae692fb21fb2a49915f9a4b13f92a0a234932dd
Jerk Chicken Curry with Coconut Milk

Ingredients:
- 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cubed
- 2 tbsp jerk spice blend
- 1 tbsp vegetable oil
- 1 onion, diced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 tbsp ginger, grated
- 1 can (14 oz) coconut milk
- 1 cup chicken broth
- 1 tsp turmeric
- 1 cup diced sweet potatoes
- ½ cup frozen peas
- Salt and pepper to taste
- Fresh lime wedges for serving

Instructions:
1. Coat chicken cubes with jerk spice; set aside.  
2. Heat oil in a pot over medium heat; sauté onion until translucent, then add garlic and ginger; cook 1 minute.  
3. Add seasoned chicken and brown on all sides, about 5 minutes.  
4. Stir in turmeric, then pour coconut milk and broth; bring to a simmer.  
5. Add sweet potatoes; simmer 15 minutes until tender.  
6. Add peas, cook 3 minutes; season with salt and pepper.  
7. Serve hot with lime wedges.
title: Jerk Chicken Curry with Coconut Milk

cuisine_title: **Title:** Caribbean Jerk Chicken with Mango Salsa
text:

- ½ cup mango chutney
- 1 cup mozzarella cheese, shredded
- ¼ cup red onion, thinly sliced

Jerk Chicken Fried Rice with Pineapple

Ingredients:
- 2 cups cooked jasmine rice, chilled
- 1 cup jerk chicken, diced
- ½ cup fresh pineapple chunks
- 2 eggs, lightly beaten
- 2 tbsp soy sauce
- 1 tbsp sesame oil
- 2 green onions, sliced
- 1 garlic clove, minced
- 1 tsp ginger, minced
- 1 tbsp vegetable oil

Instructions:
1. Heat vegetable oil in a wok over high heat; add garlic and ginger, stir‑fry 30 seconds.  
2. Push aromatics to side; scramble eggs in the wok until just set; mix with aromatics.  
3. Add chicken and pineapple; stir‑fry 2 minutes.  
4. Add rice, soy sauce, and sesame oil; toss to combine and heat through, about 3 minutes.  
5. Stir in green onions; serve hot.
title: Jerk Chicken Fried Rice with Pineapple

cuisine_title: **Title:** Caribbean Jerk Chicken with Mango Salsa
text:
Nonce: 4f8f3adb5603b85f7c9ecdba5d23107c3d27732d
Jerk Chicken Stuffed Sweet Potatoes

Ingredients:
- 4 medium sweet potatoes
- 1.5 cups cooked jerk chicken, shredded
- ¼ cup Greek yogurt
- 2 tbsp mango salsa (sweet mango, red onion, lime)
- 1 tbsp chopped scallions
- ½ tsp smoked paprika
- Salt to taste

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Pierce sweet potatoes with a fork; bake 45‑50 minutes until tender.  
2. While potatoes bake, mix shredded chicken with smoked paprika and a pinch of salt.  
3. When potatoes are done, split open lengthwise, fluff interior with a fork.  
4. Top each potato with chicken mixture, a dollop of Greek yogurt, mango salsa, and scallions.
title: Jerk Chicken Stuffed Sweet Potatoes

cuisine_title: **Title:** Caribbean Jerk Chicken with Mango Salsa
text:
Nonce: eaef6ac5877c3b9bcb4a4a17370872bc8e70d235
Jerk Chicken Lettuce Wraps with Coconut Lime Drizzle

Ingredients:
- 1 lb ground chicken
- 2 tbsp jerk seasoning
- 1 tbsp coconut oil
- 1 small carrot, grated
- ½ cup water chestnuts, chopped
- 1 head butter lettuce, leaves separated
- 2 tbsp coconut milk
- 1 tsp lime juice
- 1 tsp honey
- Salt to taste

Instructions:
1. Heat coconut oil in a skillet over medium heat; add ground chicken and jerk seasoning; cook until browned, breaking up meat.  
2. Stir in carrot and water chestnuts; cook 2 minutes.  
3. In a small bowl, whisk coconut milk, lime juice, honey, and a pinch of salt.  
4. Spoon chicken mixture into lettuce leaves; drizzle with coconut lime sauce; serve immediately.
title: Jerk Chicken Lettuce Wraps with Coconut Lime Drizzle

cuisine_title: **Title:** Caribbean Jerk Chicken with Mango Salsa
text:
Nonce: afcdfd61f01f3d5abb64631508dfa122dd1fafd9
Jerk Chicken Pasta with Creamy Mango Sauce

Ingredients:
- 8 oz linguine
- 1 cup cooked jerk chicken, sliced
- 1 cup mango puree
- ½ cup heavy cream
- 1 tbsp lime zest
- 2 tbsp butter
- 1 garlic clove, minced
- Salt and pepper to taste
- Fresh basil leaves for garnish

Instructions:
1. Cook linguine according to package directions; drain, reserving ½ cup pasta water.  
2. In a saucepan, melt butter over medium heat; add garlic and sauté 1 minute.  
3. Stir in mango puree, heavy cream, and lime zest; simmer 3‑4 minutes until slightly thickened.  
4. Add cooked chicken and linguine; toss to coat, adding reserved pasta water if needed.  
5. Season with salt and pepper; garnish with basil leaves; serve warm.
title: Jerk Chicken Pasta with Creamy Mango Sauce

cuisine_title: **Title:** Caribbean Jerk Chicken with Mango Salsa
text:
Nonce: 1ab0dc498523e86371da61c2a3244095bad3d152
Jerk Chicken Empanadas with Spicy Mango Dip

Ingredients:
- 1 package empanada dough discs (12)
- 1 cup jerk chicken, shredded
- ½ cup shredded cheddar cheese
- ¼ cup red onion, finely diced
- 1 tsp cumin
- 1 egg, beaten (for egg wash)
- ½ cup mango salsa (sweet mango, red onion, lime)
- 1 tsp hot sauce
- Fresh cilantro for garnish

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). In a bowl, combine chicken, cheese, onion, and cumin.  
2. Place a heaping tablespoon of filling on each dough disc; fold and seal edges with a fork.  
3. Brush tops with beaten egg.  
4. Bake 15‑18 minutes until golden brown.  
5. Mix mango salsa with hot sauce to create dip; serve empanadas with dip and garnish with cilantro.
title: Jerk Chicken Empanadas with Spicy Mango Dip

cuisine_title: **Title:** Caribbean Jerk Chicken with Mango Salsa
text:
Nonce: 54c76dc7d9f420864bcd3eb2610bc6d8275c09d5
Jerk Chicken Breakfast Burrito with Mango Avocado Salsa

Ingredients:
- 4 large flour tortillas
- 1 cup jerk chicken, diced
- 4 eggs, scrambled
- ½ cup black beans, rinsed
- ¼ cup shredded Monterey Jack cheese
- ½ cup mango avocado salsa (mango, avocado, red onion, lime)
- 1 tbsp butter
- Salt and pepper to taste

Instructions:
1. In a skillet, melt butter over medium heat; add diced chicken and heat through.  
2. Add scrambled eggs, stirring gently; season with salt and pepper.  
3. Warm tortillas briefly in the same skillet.  
4. Assemble each burrito with black beans, chicken‑egg mixture, cheese, and mango avocado salsa.  
5. Fold and serve hot.
title: Jerk Chicken Breakfast Burrito with Mango Avocado Salsa

text:
Nonce: 5ae820ea9d21540f1a1ac04ebffe3c21c77ee8aa
Classic Turkish Delight Pistachio Baklava

Ingredients:
- 1 package phyllo dough, thawed
- 1 cup unsalted butter, melted
- 2 cups pistachios, finely chopped
- 1 cup granulated sugar
- 1 cup water
- 1/2 cup honey
- 2 tbsp rose water
- 1 tsp lemon juice
- Pinch of salt

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Brush a 9×13‑inch baking dish with melted butter.
2. Layer 6 sheets of phyllo, brushing each sheet with butter; repeat until 12 sheets are used.
3. Sprinkle half of the chopped pistachios evenly over the phyllo.
4. Add another 6 butter‑brushed phyllo sheets, then the remaining pistachios, and finish with the final 6 butter‑brushed sheets.
5. Cut the assembled pastry into diamond shapes before baking.
6. Bake for 45‑50 minutes, or until golden brown.
7. Meanwhile, combine sugar, water, honey, lemon juice, and a pinch of salt in a saucepan; bring to a boil, then simmer 10 minutes.
8. Remove from heat and stir in rose water.
9. Pour the hot syrup over the baked baklava, allowing it to soak for at least 2 hours before serving.
title: Classic Turkish Delight Pistachio Baklava

text:
Nonce: 48d1957e0070334a3bdc0c5c9b085c30470ed7f7
Rose‑Infused Pistachio Baklava with Cardamom Syrup

Ingredients:
- 1 package phyllo dough
- 1 cup clarified butter
- 1 ½ cups pistachios, coarsely ground
- 1 tsp ground cardamom
- 1 cup sugar
- 1 cup water
- 3 tbsp rose water
- 1 tbsp orange blossom water
- 1 tsp lemon zest

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 340°F (170°C). Grease a 10‑inch square pan with clarified butter.
2. Mix pistachios with ground cardamom; set aside.
3. Lay 4 sheets of phyllo, brushing each with butter; sprinkle a third of the pistachio mixture; repeat layers, ending with 4 butter‑brushed sheets on top.
4. Cut the assembled layers into 2‑inch squares.
5. Bake 40‑45 minutes until crisp and amber.
6. For the syrup, boil sugar, water, and lemon zest for 5 minutes; remove from heat and stir in rose water and orange blossom water.
7. Immediately drizzle the warm syrup over the hot baklava; let rest 3 hours before serving.
title: Rose‑Infused Pistachio Baklava with Cardamom Syrup

text:
Nonce: 6965bd0e94b89b014940246efa184da3a8d1d015
Chocolate Pistachio Baklava with Orange Zest

Ingredients:
- 1 package phyllo dough
- 1 cup unsalted butter, melted
- 1 cup pistachios, finely chopped
- ½ cup dark chocolate chips
- ½ cup cocoa powder
- 1 cup sugar
- 1 cup water
- 2 tbsp orange zest
- 2 tbsp orange juice
- Pinch of sea salt

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 355°F (180°C). Butter a 9×13‑inch pan.
2. Combine pistachios, chocolate chips, and cocoa powder; set aside.
3. Layer 5 sheets of phyllo, brushing each with butter; spread a thin layer of the chocolate‑pistachio mix; repeat until all phyllo and filling are used, ending with a buttered sheet.
4. Cut into rectangles before baking.
5. Bake 35‑40 minutes until the top is crisp.
6. Meanwhile, simmer sugar, water, orange zest, and orange juice for 8 minutes; add a pinch of sea salt.
7. Pour the citrus‑chocolate syrup over the baklava; allow to absorb for 2 hours before serving.
title: Chocolate Pistachio Baklava with Orange Zest

text:
Nonce: 2225c6b724bc6e6974e6335552568e9311350ce2
Savory Spinach & Pistachio Baklava

Ingredients:
- 1 package phyllo dough
- 1 cup melted butter
- 2 cups fresh spinach, wilted and drained
- 1 cup pistachios, coarsely chopped
- ½ cup feta cheese, crumbled
- 1 tsp ground cumin
- ½ tsp black pepper
- 1 cup chicken broth
- 2 tbsp lemon juice
- 1 tsp honey

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Grease a 9‑inch round baking dish with butter.
2. Toss wilted spinach with pistachios, feta, cumin, and black pepper.
3. Lay 3 sheets of phyllo, brushing each with butter; spread half the spinach mixture; add 3 more buttered sheets, then the remaining spinach; finish with 3 final buttered sheets.
4. Cut the pastry into wedges.
5. Bake 30‑35 minutes until golden.
6. In a saucepan, combine chicken broth, lemon juice, and honey; simmer 5 minutes.
7. Drizzle the savory broth over the hot baklava; serve warm as an appetizer.
title: Savory Spinach & Pistachio Baklava

text:
Nonce: d3260c9e1575847427df373b13c7db8861f4c2ef
Pistachio Baklava Ice Cream Sandwich

Ingredients:
- 12 baklava squares (prepared from classic recipe)
- 2 cups vanilla ice cream, softened
- ½ cup pistachio paste
- 2 tbsp rose water
- 1 tbsp honey

Instructions:
1. Slice each baklava square in half horizontally, creating top and bottom layers.
2. In a bowl, blend softened vanilla ice cream with pistachio paste, rose water, and honey until smooth.
3. Spoon a generous dollop of the pistachio‑rose ice cream onto the bottom half of each baklava piece.
4. Place the top half over the filling, pressing gently to adhere.
5. Freeze the assembled sandwiches for at least 2 hours before serving.
title: Pistachio Baklava Ice Cream Sandwich

text:
Nonce: 7a24ec446e9374f3e7b0afcb6b59aac463ff98bf
Pistachio Baklava Parfait with Yogurt and Honey

Ingredients:
- 8 baklava bites (cut from classic baklava)
- 1 cup Greek yogurt
- 2 tbsp honey
- ¼ cup pistachios, toasted and chopped
- 1 tsp rose water
- Fresh mint leaves for garnish

Instructions:
1. Whisk Greek yogurt with honey and rose water until smooth.
2. In serving glasses, layer a piece of baklava at the bottom.
3. Add a layer of rose‑scented yogurt, then sprinkle toasted pistachios.
4. Repeat layers, finishing with yogurt and a drizzle of honey.
5. Garnish with mint leaves; serve chilled.
title: Pistachio Baklava Parfait with Yogurt and Honey

text:
Nonce: 258741747e3e60dbf8d97783365e80d19d629a36
Pistachio Baklava Truffles

Ingredients:
- 1 cup baklava crumbs (from classic baklava)
- ½ cup pistachio butter
- ¼ cup powdered sugar
- 2 tbsp rose water
- 200 g dark chocolate, melted
- Crushed pistachios for coating

Instructions:
1. In a bowl, combine baklava crumbs, pistachio butter, powdered sugar, and rose water; mix until a cohesive dough forms.
2. Shape the mixture into 1‑inch balls.
3. Chill the balls for 30 minutes.
4. Dip each chilled ball into melted dark chocolate, ensuring full coverage.
5. Roll the chocolate‑coated truffles in crushed pistachios.
6. Refrigerate until set; serve as a sweet bite‑size treat.
title: Pistachio Baklava Truffles

text:
Nonce: 536a34414ef6d01327c6648f2752b40f650d1640
Pistachio Baklava Pancakes

Ingredients:
- 1 cup all‑purpose flour
- 1 tsp baking powder
- ½ tsp salt
- 1 cup milk
- 2 eggs
- 2 tbsp melted butter
- ¼ cup pistachio‑infused baklava syrup (from classic recipe)
- ¼ cup chopped pistachios
- Butter for cooking

Instructions:
1. In a bowl, whisk flour, baking powder, and salt.
2. In another bowl, beat milk, eggs, and melted butter; stir in baklava syrup.
3. Combine wet and dry ingredients; fold in chopped pistachios.
4. Heat a skillet over medium heat; melt a small pat of butter.
5. Pour batter to form 4‑inch pancakes; cook until bubbles form, then flip and cook another 2 minutes.
6. Serve pancakes drizzled with extra baklava syrup and a sprinkle of pistachios.
title: Pistachio Baklava Pancakes

text:
Nonce: dac948ecebcbaa430639ec852ec9ac0a4c2e6bac
Pistachio Baklava Milkshake

Ingredients:
- 2 scoops vanilla ice cream
- ½ cup milk
- ¼ cup pistachio baklava syrup
- 2 tbsp pistachio butter
- 1 tsp rose water
- Whipped cream for topping
- Crushed pistachios for garnish

Instructions:
1. In a blender, combine vanilla ice cream, milk, baklava syrup, pistachio butter, and rose water.
2. Blend on high until smooth and creamy.
3. Pour into tall glasses; top with whipped cream.
4. Sprinkle crushed pistachios over the whipped cream.
5. Serve immediately with a straw.
title: Pistachio Baklava Milkshake

text:
Nonce: 1186b5e0bdcad050e7388874c8cd67ee6fa1ecb2
Pistachio Baklava Tart with Lemon Cream

Ingredients:
- 1 pre‑baked tart shell (9‑inch)
- 8 baklava squares, finely chopped
- 1 cup pistachios, ground
- ½ cup butter, melted
- 1 cup sugar
- 1 cup water
- 2 tbsp rose water
- 1 cup lemon curd
- Zest of 1 lemon for garnish

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 325°F (165°C). In a bowl, mix chopped baklava, ground pistachios, and melted butter; press the mixture into the tart shell to form a crust.
2. Bake the crust 12‑15 minutes until set; let cool.
3. Prepare syrup by boiling sugar and water for 5 minutes; remove from heat and stir in rose water.
4. Brush the cooled baklava crust generously with the rose‑scented syrup; allow to absorb for 30 minutes.
5. Spread a layer of lemon curd over the syrup‑soaked crust.
6. Garnish with lemon zest and a drizzle of remaining syrup.
7. Chill the tart for at least 1 hour before slicing and serving.
title: Pistachio Baklava Tart with Lemon Cream

text:
Nonce: ea16d5ddecbe6a95cca3b3810f7b90025c56e19e
Spicy Gochujang‑Glazed Tofu Skewers (Grilled)

Ingredients:
- 400 g firm tofu, pressed and cut into 2 cm cubes
- 2 Tbsp gochujang
- 1 Tbsp soy sauce
- 1 Tbsp rice vinegar
- 1 Tbsp honey
- 1 tsp sesame oil
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 tsp grated ginger
- 2 Tbsp water
- Bamboo skewers, soaked 30 min
- Pickled radish, for serving

Instructions:
1. Whisk together gochujang, soy sauce, rice vinegar, honey, sesame oil, garlic, ginger, and water to form a glaze.
2. Toss tofu cubes in the glaze; let sit 15 minutes.
3. Thread tofu onto soaked bamboo skewers.
4. Preheat a grill to medium‑high and lightly oil the grates.
5. Grill skewers 3‑4 minutes per side, brushing with any remaining glaze.
6. Serve immediately with pickled radish on the side.
title: Spicy Gochujang‑Glazed Tofu Skewers (Grilled)

text:
Nonce: 311cc23a006e5e801b30e0803de4953df87e1ba7
Baked Gochujang‑Glazed Tofu Skewers with Sesame Seeds

Ingredients:
- 400 g firm tofu, cubed
- 2 Tbsp gochujang
- 1 Tbsp soy sauce
- 1 Tbsp maple syrup
- 1 tsp toasted sesame oil
- 1 tsp sesame seeds
- 1 clove garlic, minced
- 1 tsp rice vinegar
- Bamboo skewers, soaked
- Olive oil spray

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 200 °C (400 °F) and line a baking sheet with parchment.
2. Mix gochujang, soy sauce, maple syrup, sesame oil, garlic, and rice vinegar in a bowl.
3. Coat tofu cubes in the mixture, then thread onto skewers.
4. Sprinkle sesame seeds over the skewered tofu.
5. Place skewers on the baking sheet, spray lightly with olive oil.
6. Bake 12‑15 minutes, turning once, until caramelized.
7. Serve warm, optionally with a drizzle of extra glaze.
title: Baked Gochujang‑Glazed Tofu Skewers with Sesame Seeds

text:
Nonce: 793a79bc30e8034e10332f2d75a0d3b1eb1ef6fb
Gochujang‑Glazed Tofu Lettuce Wraps

Ingredients:
- 300 g firm tofu, sliced into thin strips
- 2 Tbsp gochujang
- 1 Tbsp soy sauce
- 1 Tbsp honey
- 1 tsp sesame oil
- 1 clove garlic, grated
- 1 tsp rice vinegar
- Butter lettuce leaves
- Shredded carrots
- Sliced cucumber
- Fresh cilantro leaves

Instructions:
1. Combine gochujang, soy sauce, honey, sesame oil, garlic, and rice vinegar in a shallow dish.
2. Marinate tofu strips in the sauce for 10 minutes.
3. Heat a non‑stick pan over medium heat; sear tofu strips 2‑3 minutes per side until glossy.
4. Spoon a few tofu strips onto each lettuce leaf.
5. Top with shredded carrots, cucumber slices, and cilantro.
6. Drizzle any remaining glaze and fold the lettuce leaf to eat.
title: Gochujang‑Glazed Tofu Lettuce Wraps

text:
Nonce: 3d440b6cab93c614d46d2f35b89112ed6b0709c7
Gochujang‑Glazed Tofu Fried Rice

Ingredients:
- 250 g firm tofu, crumbled
- 2 Tbsp gochujang
- 1 Tbsp soy sauce
- 1 Tbsp brown sugar
- 2 tsp sesame oil
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 cup cooked rice, chilled
- ½ cup frozen peas and carrots
- 2 green onions, sliced
- 1 egg (optional)
- Vegetable oil

Instructions:
1. In a small bowl whisk gochujang, soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, and garlic; set aside.
2. Heat a wok over high heat, add a splash of oil, and scramble the egg if using; remove and set aside.
3. Add more oil, then stir‑fry crumbled tofu until lightly browned; pour in the glaze and coat tofu, cooking 2 minutes.
4. Add rice, peas, carrots, and the scrambled egg; stir‑fry until heated through.
5. Sprinkle with green onions and serve hot.
title: Gochujang‑Glazed Tofu Fried Rice

text:
Nonce: c095d21f35b398aba17d324a602b64f6db8fbf6c
Gochujang‑Glazed Tofu Bibimbap Bowl

Ingredients:
- 300 g firm tofu, pressed and sliced into rectangles
- 2 Tbsp gochujang
- 1 Tbsp soy sauce
- 1 Tbsp honey
- 1 tsp sesame oil
- 1 clove garlic, minced
- 1 tsp rice vinegar
- 2 cups cooked short‑grain rice
- ½ cup sautéed spinach
- ½ cup bean sprouts, blanched
- ½ cup sliced shiitake mushrooms, sautéed
- 1 fried egg (optional)
- Sesame seeds for garnish

Instructions:
1. Whisk together gochujang, soy sauce, honey, sesame oil, garlic, and rice vinegar.
2. Pan‑sear tofu slices in a little oil until golden; brush with the glaze and cook another minute.
3. Assemble a bowl with a base of rice, arranging spinach, bean sprouts, mushrooms, and glazed tofu on top.
4. Add a fried egg if desired, drizzle any remaining glaze, and sprinkle sesame seeds.
5. Mix everything together before eating.
title: Gochujang‑Glazed Tofu Bibimbap Bowl

text:
Nonce: ba9887399887aa2507ca980f185e7220551a9bb5
Gochujang‑Glazed Tofu Tacos with Kimchi Slaw

Ingredients:
- 250 g firm tofu, cut into small cubes
- 2 Tbsp gochujang
- 1 Tbsp soy sauce
- 1 Tbsp agave nectar
- 1 tsp sesame oil
- 1 clove garlic, minced
- 4 small corn tortillas
- 1 cup kimchi, chopped
- ½ cup shredded red cabbage
- 2 Tbsp mayonnaise
- 1 tsp rice vinegar
- Fresh cilantro leaves

Instructions:
1. Mix gochujang, soy sauce, agave, sesame oil, and garlic; toss tofu cubes in the sauce and let sit 10 minutes.
2. Heat a skillet, add tofu, and cook until caramelized, stirring occasionally.
3. In a bowl combine kimchi, red cabbage, mayonnaise, and rice vinegar to make slaw.
4. Warm tortillas on a dry pan, then fill each with glazed tofu and top with kimchi slaw.
5. Garnish with cilantro and serve immediately.
title: Gochujang‑Glazed Tofu Tacos with Kimchi Slaw

text:
Nonce: 3ad4754963fa873beb91db9c611602dbc7bf5d5e
Gochujang‑Glazed Tofu Pizza

Ingredients:
- 200 g firm tofu, sliced thin
- 2 Tbsp gochujang
- 1 Tbsp soy sauce
- 1 Tbsp honey
- 1 tsp sesame oil
- 1 clove garlic, minced
- 1 pre‑made pizza crust
- ½ cup shredded mozzarella
- ¼ cup sliced green onions
- 1 Tbsp toasted sesame seeds
- Olive oil

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 220 °C (425 °F).
2. Blend gochujang, soy sauce, honey, sesame oil, and garlic; brush tofu slices with the glaze.
3. Place pizza crust on a baking sheet, drizzle lightly with olive oil.
4. Arrange glazed tofu slices over the crust, sprinkle mozzarella, green onions, and sesame seeds.
5. Bake 12‑15 minutes until cheese melts and edges are crisp.
6. Slice and serve hot.
title: Gochujang‑Glazed Tofu Pizza

text:
Nonce: cabf4e5d6be2898237e0d115d6c30b1d2b914d27
Gochujang‑Glazed Tofu Ramen

Ingredients:
- 200 g firm tofu, cubed
- 2 Tbsp gochujang
- 1 Tbsp soy sauce
- 1 Tbsp mirin
- 1 tsp sesame oil
- 1 clove garlic, minced
- 4 cups vegetable broth
- 2 packs ramen noodles (discard seasoning)
- ½ cup sliced bok choy
- ¼ cup sliced green onions
- Soft‑boiled egg (optional)
- Chili oil (optional)

Instructions:
1. Whisk gochujang, soy sauce, mirin, sesame oil, and garlic; toss tofu cubes in the mixture.
2. In a pot bring broth to a simmer; add tofu and cook 3 minutes.
3. Add ramen noodles and bok choy; cook until noodles are tender.
4. Ladle soup into bowls, top with green onions, a soft‑boiled egg, and a drizzle of chili oil if desired.
5. Serve hot, stirring the glaze into the broth.
title: Gochujang‑Glazed Tofu Ramen

text:
Nonce: 063b0ef2147b5823840f00a551bad5c8e53444de
Gochujang‑Glazed Tofu Pancake (Jeon) with Scallions

Ingredients:
- 200 g firm tofu, mashed
- 2 Tbsp gochujang
- 1 Tbsp soy sauce
- 1 Tbsp sugar
- 1 tsp sesame oil
- 1 clove garlic, minced
- ½ cup all‑purpose flour
- ¼ cup water
- 2 green onions, finely sliced
- Vegetable oil for frying
- Soy dipping sauce

Instructions:
1. In a bowl combine gochujang, soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, and garlic; stir into mashed tofu.
2. Add flour, water, and sliced green onions; mix to a batter consistency.
3. Heat a thin layer of oil in a skillet over medium heat.
4. Spoon batter to form small pancakes; cook 2‑3 minutes per side until golden.
5. Drain on paper towels and serve with soy dipping sauce.
title: Gochujang‑Glazed Tofu Pancake (Jeon) with Scallions

text:
Nonce: 0d68e7ad4edbfc45b7bf2fd04d4b6db2db899fe2
Gochujang‑Glazed Tofu Hot Pot (Jjigae)

Ingredients:
- 300 g firm tofu, cubed
- 2 Tbsp gochujang
- 1 Tbsp soy sauce
- 1 Tbsp Korean chili flakes (gochugaru)
- 1 tsp sesame oil
- 1 clove garlic, minced
- 4 cups vegetable stock
- 1 cup sliced napa cabbage
- ½ cup sliced zucchini
- ½ cup sliced mushrooms
- 2 green onions, chopped
- Cooked rice, for serving

Instructions:
1. Whisk together gochujang, soy sauce, gochugaru, sesame oil, and garlic; set aside.
2. In a pot bring vegetable stock to a boil; add the glaze mixture and stir.
3. Add tofu, cabbage, zucchini, and mushrooms; simmer 10 minutes until vegetables are tender.
4. Taste and adjust seasoning if needed.
5. Ladle hot pot into bowls, garnish with green onions, and serve with steamed rice.
title: Gochujang‑Glazed Tofu Hot Pot (Jjigae)

text:
Nonce: 9912c4db4a612fd18a152397262bc9b9ab6857ae
Classic Black Clam Ceviche

Ingredients:
- 500 g fresh black clams, shucked and cleaned
- 1/2 cup freshly squeezed lime juice
- 1/4 cup pisco
- 1 small red onion, thinly sliced
- 1 jalapeño, seeded and minced
- 2 tbsp chopped cilantro
- Salt to taste
- Sweet potato chips, for serving

Instructions:
1. Place the cleaned black clams in a glass bowl and pour the lime juice over them, ensuring they are fully submerged.
2. Add the pisco, sliced red onion, and minced jalapeño; stir gently.
3. Sprinkle with chopped cilantro and season with a pinch of salt.
4. Let the mixture marinate in the refrigerator for 12 minutes, allowing the clams to “cook” in the citrus.
5. Serve chilled, accompanied by crisp sweet potato chips on the side.
title: Classic Black Clam Ceviche

text:
Nonce: 0b96369edb67a6e6ec07aaeb953680731e29b863
Classic Black Clam Ceviche

Ingredients:
- 500 g fresh black clams (conchas negras), shucked and cleaned
- 1 cup freshly squeezed lime juice
- ½ cup pisco
- 1 small red onion, thinly sliced
- 1 jalapeño, seeded and minced
- ¼ cup chopped fresh cilantro
- 1 tsp sea salt
- 1 tsp black pepper
- Sweet potato chips, for garnish

Instructions:
1. Place the cleaned black clams in a glass bowl and pour the lime juice over them, ensuring they are fully submerged.
2. Add the pisco, salt, and pepper; stir gently to combine.
3. Let the mixture cure in the refrigerator for 12‑15 minutes, until the clams turn opaque.
4. Fold in the red onion, jalapeño, and cilantro.
5. Serve chilled, topped with a handful of sweet potato chips for crunch.
title: Classic Black Clam Ceviche

text:
Nonce: 4d50b9a919a8079e404bffe144327591e8223f6d
Black Clam Ceviche with Sweet‑Potato Purée

Ingredients:
- 400 g black clams, shucked
- ¾ cup lime juice
- ¼ cup pisco
- 1 small red onion, finely diced
- 1 small habanero, minced
- ½ cup cilantro leaves, chopped
- 1 tsp salt
- 2 medium sweet potatoes, boiled and mashed
- 2 tbsp olive oil
- Lime zest, for garnish

Instructions:
1. In a bowl, combine lime juice, pisco, salt, and habanero; whisk.
2. Add the black clams and let them cure for 10 minutes in the fridge.
3. Mix in the red onion and cilantro; set aside.
4. In a separate pan, heat olive oil and fold the mashed sweet potatoes until smooth; season with a pinch of salt.
5. Spoon a layer of sweet‑potato purée onto each plate, top with the ceviche, and finish with lime zest.
title: Black Clam Ceviche with Sweet‑Potato Purée

text:
Nonce: c6bb60edf70f275971b924b9a8050334f2bbfcb0
Ceviche Tostada with Black Clams

Ingredients:
- 300 g black clams, shucked
- ½ cup lime juice
- ¼ cup pisco
- 1 small red onion, julienned
- 1 tsp ají amarillo paste
- ¼ cup cilantro, chopped
- ½ tsp sea salt
- 8 corn tostada shells
- ¼ cup crumbled queso fresco
- Microgreens, for garnish

Instructions:
1. Mix lime juice, pisco, ají amarillo, and salt in a bowl.
2. Add the black clams, red onion, and cilantro; toss and refrigerate for 12 minutes.
3. Arrange the tostada shells on a platter.
4. Spoon the ceviche onto each tostada, sprinkle with queso fresco, and garnish with microgreens.
title: Ceviche Tostada with Black Clams

text:
Nonce: fee2cd18097afa7cd9b18fd823e979c1038717e2
Black Clam Ceviche Martini (Cocktail)

Ingredients:
- 200 g black clams, shucked and finely diced
- ¼ cup lime juice
- 2 tbsp pisco
- 1 tsp simple syrup
- 2 dashes Angostura bitters
- 1 small cucumber slice
- Pinch of sea salt
- Ice cubes
- Lime wheel, for garnish

Instructions:
1. In a shaker, combine lime juice, pisco, simple syrup, bitters, and a pinch of salt.
2. Add the diced black clams and a handful of ice; shake vigorously for 10 seconds.
3. Strain into a chilled martini glass.
4. Float a cucumber slice on top and garnish with a lime wheel.
title: Black Clam Ceviche Martini (Cocktail)

text:
Nonce: 4896a0766fa0b36c958b9b31cd7da44900b16017
Black Clam Ceviche Soup (Chupe de Conchas Negras)

Ingredients:
- 400 g black clams, shucked
- 4 cups fish stock
- ½ cup lime juice
- ¼ cup pisco
- 1 small red onion, diced
- 1 garlic clove, minced
- 1 small potato, cubed
- ½ cup corn kernels
- ¼ cup cilantro, chopped
- 1 tsp ají panca paste
- Salt and pepper to taste

Instructions:
1. Bring fish stock to a simmer; add potatoes and cook until tender, about 8 minutes.
2. Stir in onion, garlic, corn, and ají panca; simmer 3 minutes.
3. Add black clams, lime juice, pisco, and cilantro; cook just until the clams turn opaque, 2‑3 minutes.
4. Season with salt and pepper, then ladle into bowls and serve hot.
title: Black Clam Ceviche Soup (Chupe de Conchas Negras)

text:
Nonce: 89e98da58fea27763363e2870b3a466ccb12b8b3
Black Clam Ceviche Rice Bowl

Ingredients:
- 250 g black clams, shucked
- 1 cup sushi‑grade rice, cooked and cooled
- ½ cup lime juice
- ¼ cup pisco
- 1 small red onion, thinly sliced
- 1 tsp grated ginger
- ¼ cup cilantro, chopped
- 1 avocado, sliced
- 1 tbsp toasted quinoa
- Salt to taste

Instructions:
1. In a bowl, whisk lime juice, pisco, ginger, and salt.
2. Add black clams and let them cure for 10 minutes in the refrigerator.
3. Assemble the bowl: start with a base of rice, top with cevied clams, red onion, cilantro, avocado slices, and toasted quinoa.
4. Drizzle any remaining citrus‑pisco liquid over the top and serve.
title: Black Clam Ceviche Rice Bowl

text:
Nonce: c628d1e8282a8ae04939a1d7390dfab80308be4c
Black Clam Ceviche with Avocado Mousse

Ingredients:
- 350 g black clams, shucked
- ½ cup lime juice
- ¼ cup pisco
- 1 small red onion, minced
- 1 jalapeño, seeded and diced
- ¼ cup cilantro, chopped
- 1 tsp salt
- 2 ripe avocados
- 1 tbsp lime zest
- 2 tbsp Greek yogurt
- Chili flakes, for garnish

Instructions:
1. Blend avocados, lime zest, Greek yogurt, and a pinch of salt until smooth; set aside.
2. In a separate bowl, combine lime juice, pisco, salt, and jalapeño; add black clams and let cure 12 minutes.
3. Fold in red onion and cilantro.
4. Spoon a layer of avocado mousse onto plates, top with the ceviche, and sprinkle with chili flakes.

text:
Nonce: 8736dd921a83ffca0842995aebb77b252abdbfb2
Black Clam Ceviche Causa (Layered Potato Cake)

Ingredients:
- 300 g black clams, shucked
- 1 cup lime juice
- ¼ cup pisco
- 1 small red onion, finely diced
- 1 tsp ají limo paste
- ¼ cup cilantro, chopped
- 1 tsp salt
- 2 large yellow potatoes, boiled and mashed
- 2 tbsp olive oil
- ½ cup queso fresco, crumbled
- Sweet potato chips, for garnish

Instructions:
1. Mix lime juice, pisco, ají limo, and salt; add black clams and refrigerate 10 minutes.

text:
Nonce: f6912bfb68488debead53ad3205b5aa1c0d1822f
Black Clam Ceviche Salsa Verde for Grilling

Ingredients:
- 250 g black clams, shucked and roughly chopped
- ½ cup lime juice
- ¼ cup pisco
- 1 cup fresh cilantro leaves
- ¼ cup parsley leaves
- 1 jalapeño, seeded
- 2 garlic cloves
- ¼ cup olive oil
- 1 tsp sea salt
- 1 tsp black pepper
- Grilled corn on the cob, for serving

Instructions:
1. In a food processor, blend cilantro, parsley, jalapeño, garlic, olive oil, salt, and pepper into a smooth salsa verde.
2. Toss the chopped black clams with lime juice, pisco, and the salsa verde; let sit for 8 minutes.
3. Grill corn on the cob until lightly charred.
4. Serve the ceviche salsa verde spooned over the grilled corn as a vibrant side dish.
title: Black Clam Ceviche Salsa Verde for Grilling

text:
Nonce: c7b7478e55cb095d142d8635911b8c9fc3edffc3
Classic Doro Wat with Injera

Ingredients:
- 2 lbs chicken thighs, bone‑in, skinless
- 2 large onions, finely chopped
- 3 tbsp niter kibbeh (spiced clarified butter)
- 2 tbsp berbere spice mix
- 3 garlic cloves, minced
- 1 tbsp ginger, grated
- 2 tbsp tomato paste
- 2 cups chicken broth
- 1 hard‑boiled egg per serving
- Salt to taste
- 2 cups teff flour
- 3 cups water

Instructions:
1. In a large pot, melt niter kibbeh over medium heat and sauté the onions until deep golden, about 10 minutes.
2. Add garlic, ginger, and berbere; stir for 2 minutes until fragrant.
3. Mix in tomato paste, then add the chicken pieces, coating them well with the spice mixture.
4. Pour in chicken broth, bring to a simmer, cover, and cook 35‑40 minutes until the chicken is tender.
5. Season with salt, add the hard‑boiled eggs, and let them warm in the stew for 5 minutes.
6. Meanwhile, whisk teff flour with water to a thin batter; let rest 10 minutes.
7. Heat a non‑stick skillet, pour a thin layer of batter, cover, and steam for 2‑3 minutes; repeat to make several injera rounds. Serve doro wat hot atop the injera.
title: Classic Doro Wat with Injera

text:
Nonce: bd39ceeaaffa0000018417aef67b313c32b6cefe
Spicy Beef Tibs with Injera

Ingredients:
- 1.5 lbs beef sirloin, cut into 1‑inch cubes
- 1 large onion, sliced
- 2 tbsp niter kibbeh
- 1 tbsp berbere spice
- 1 tsp smoked paprika
- 2 garlic cloves, minced
- 1 tbsp fresh rosemary, chopped
- 1 cup beef broth
- 1 tbsp lemon juice
- Salt and black pepper
- 2 cups teff flour
- 3 cups water

Instructions:
1. Heat niter kibbeh in a skillet; add onions and sauté until translucent.
2. Stir in garlic, berbere, and smoked paprika; cook 1 minute.
3. Add beef cubes, searing on all sides until browned.
4. Pour beef broth, reduce heat, and simmer 20 minutes until the sauce thickens.
5. Finish with rosemary, lemon juice, salt, and pepper; stir well.
6. Prepare injera batter by whisking teff flour with water; let rest 10 minutes.
7. Cook thin injera sheets on a hot non‑stick pan, cover briefly to steam, and serve the beef tibs over the warm injera.
title: Spicy Beef Tibs with Injera

text:
Nonce: c972bd1129da3941fd0539eb9720352a42922278
Vegetarian Split‑Pea Wat (Kik Alicha) with Injera

Ingredients:
- 1 cup split yellow peas, rinsed
- 1 large onion, diced
- 2 carrots, diced
- 2 tbsp niter kibbeh (or vegetable oil for vegan)
- 1 tsp turmeric powder
- 1 tsp cumin seeds
- 2 garlic cloves, minced
- 4 cups vegetable broth
- Salt to taste
- 2 cups teff flour
- 3 cups water

Instructions:
1. In a pot, melt niter kibbeh and toast cumin seeds until fragrant.
2. Add onion and garlic; sauté until soft.
3. Stir in turmeric, then add carrots and split peas, coating them with the spices.
4. Pour vegetable broth, bring to a boil, then reduce to a gentle simmer for 30‑35 minutes until peas are tender.
5. Season with salt; blend lightly for a creamy texture if desired.
6. Whisk teff flour with water to form a thin batter; let rest 10 minutes.
7. Cook injera sheets on a hot skillet, cover briefly, and serve the split‑pea wat atop the injera.
title: Vegetarian Split‑Pea Wat (Kik Alicha) with Injera

text:
Nonce: 606901127ee650bd2902c50636f6ee79966d1a79
Lamb Kitfo with Injera

Ingredients:
- 1 lb lamb shoulder, finely minced (or ground)
- 2 tbsp niter kibbeh
- 1 tbsp mitmita (hot chili blend)
- 1 tsp ground cardamom
- 1 tsp salt
- 1 tbsp clarified butter (extra for serving)
- 2 cups teff flour
- 3 cups water
- Fresh cilantro leaves for garnish

Instructions:
1. In a chilled bowl, combine minced lamb, mitmita, cardamom, and salt; mix thoroughly.
2. Melt niter kibbeh in a small pan; drizzle the warm butter over the meat mixture and stir quickly to coat.
3. Transfer the kitfo to a serving plate, drizzle a little extra clarified butter on top, and garnish with cilantro.
4. Prepare injera batter by whisking teff flour with water; let rest 10 minutes.
5. Cook thin injera rounds on a hot non‑stick pan, covering briefly to steam.
6. Serve the raw spiced lamb alongside the warm injera for scooping.
title: Lamb Kitfo with Injera

text:
Nonce: b9537ac72c1dbc8e76d4cd9388fad840b82af44e
Tilapia Tibs with Injera

Ingredients:
- 1.5 lbs tilapia fillets, cut into bite‑size pieces
- 1 large onion, sliced
- 2 tbsp niter kibbeh
- 1 tbsp berbere spice
- 1 tsp ground coriander
- 2 garlic cloves, minced
- 1 cup fish stock or water
- Juice of 1 lemon
- Salt and pepper
- 2 cups teff flour
- 3 cups water

Instructions:
1. Heat niter kibbeh in a skillet; add onion and sauté until soft.
2. Stir in garlic, berbere, and coriander; cook 1 minute.
3. Add tilapia pieces, gently turning to coat them with the spice mixture.
4. Pour fish stock, bring to a gentle simmer, and cook 8‑10 minutes until fish is opaque.
5. Finish with lemon juice, season with salt and pepper.
6. Whisk teff flour with water to create injera batter; rest 10 minutes.
7. Cook thin injera sheets on a hot pan, cover briefly, and serve the tilapia tibs over the injera.
title: Tilapia Tibs with Injera

text:
Nonce: b92c29d2c52c8142dab3516af8e031efc38ec8a8
Mushroom & Spinach Ayib Wat with Injera

Ingredients:
- 2 cups fresh mushrooms, sliced
- 3 cups baby spinach leaves
- 1 large onion, diced
- 2 tbsp niter kibbeh
- 1 tbsp berbere (optional, for mild heat)
- 1 tsp ground fenugreek
- 1 cup cottage cheese (ayib), crumbled
- 1 cup vegetable broth
- Salt to taste
- 2 cups teff flour
- 3 cups water

Instructions:
1. Melt niter kibbeh in a pot; sauté onion until translucent.
2. Add mushrooms and cook until they release moisture and begin to brown.
3. Stir in berbere (if using) and fenugreek; cook 1 minute.
4. Add spinach and broth; simmer until spinach wilts, about 3 minutes.
5. Fold in crumbled ayib, season with salt, and heat through.
6. Prepare injera batter by mixing teff flour with water; let rest 10 minutes.
7. Cook thin injera sheets on a hot skillet, cover briefly, and serve the mushroom‑spinach ayib wat on the injera.
title: Mushroom & Spinach Ayib Wat with Injera

text:
Nonce: 4ff1ad0ef5e8171adb5395f7c7efa3baeef73eca
Injera Pizza with Doro Wat Topping

Ingredients:
- 2 cups teff flour
- 3 cups water
- 1 tbsp olive oil
- 1 cup doro wat (prepared from classic recipe)
- 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese
- ½ cup red bell pepper, thinly sliced
- ¼ cup fresh basil leaves
- Salt to taste

Instructions:
1. Whisk teff flour with water and olive oil; let the batter rest 10 minutes.
2. Heat a non‑stick pan over medium heat; pour a thin layer of batter, cover, and steam for 2‑3 minutes to form a pliable injera base.
3. Transfer the injera to a baking sheet; spread a thin layer of doro wat over the surface.
4. Sprinkle shredded mozzarella evenly, then add bell pepper slices.
5. Bake in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 8‑10 minutes until cheese melts and bubbles.
6. Remove, garnish with fresh basil leaves, slice, and serve as a fusion Ethiopian‑Italian pizza.
title: Injera Pizza with Doro Wat Topping

text:
Nonce: 136ff1c844833cee83838173ce1e7d70d8f8f9a7
Injera Breakfast Roll with Scrambled Eggs & Berbere

Ingredients:
- 2 cups teff flour
- 3 cups water
- 4 large eggs
- 2 tbsp milk
- 1 tbsp butter
- 1 tsp berbere spice
- Salt and pepper
- 2 tbsp chopped scallions
- 1 avocado, sliced (optional)

Instructions:
1. Prepare injera batter by whisking teff flour with water; let rest 10 minutes.
2. Cook thin injera sheets on a hot non‑stick pan, covering briefly; set aside to cool.
3. In a bowl, whisk eggs with milk, berbere, salt, and pepper.
4. Melt butter in a skillet; pour egg mixture and scramble gently until just set.
5. Lay an injera sheet flat, place a line of scrambled eggs, sprinkle scallions, and add avocado slices if desired.
6. Roll the injera tightly around the filling, slice in half, and serve warm.
title: Injera Breakfast Roll with Scrambled Eggs & Berbere

text:
Nonce: 0d0ce5222a2292a9a6367b503d6965d8b9fab07d
Sweet Injera Pancakes with Honey‑Nut Drizzle

Ingredients:
- 2 cups teff flour
- 2 cups milk (or plant‑based milk)
- 2 tbsp honey
- 1 tsp ground cinnamon
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 2 eggs
- Pinch of salt
- ¼ cup chopped mixed nuts (almonds, walnuts, pistachios)
- Extra honey for drizzling

Instructions:
1. In a bowl, combine teff flour, cinnamon, and salt.
2. In another bowl, whisk milk, eggs, honey, and vanilla; pour into the dry mixture and stir until smooth.
3. Heat a lightly oiled skillet over medium heat; pour batter to form small pancakes, cooking 2‑3 minutes per side.
4. While pancakes cook, toast chopped nuts in a dry pan until fragrant.
5. Stack pancakes on a plate, drizzle generously with honey, and sprinkle toasted nuts on top.
6. Serve warm as a sweet Ethiopian‑inspired breakfast or dessert.
title: Sweet Injera Pancakes with Honey‑Nut Drizzle

text:
Nonce: 5371610af4b71e6456f61c47b9a4546eabe7f2da
Injera Salad with Roasted Vegetables & Niter Kibbeh Dressing

Ingredients:
- 2 cups teff flour
- 3 cups water
- 1 red bell pepper, cubed
- 1 zucchini, sliced
- 1 sweet potato, diced
- 2 tbsp niter kibbeh (melted)
- 1 tbsp lemon juice
- 1 tsp ground cumin
- Salt and pepper
- Handful fresh parsley, chopped

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C); toss bell pepper, zucchini, and sweet potato with melted niter kibbeh, cumin, salt, and pepper.
2. Roast vegetables on a baking sheet for 20‑25 minutes until caramelized.
3. Meanwhile, whisk teff flour with water to create injera batter; let rest 10 minutes.
4. Cook thin injera sheets on a hot non‑stick pan, covering briefly; cut each injera into bite‑size strips.
5. In a large bowl, combine roasted vegetables, injera strips, lemon juice, and additional melted niter kibbeh if needed.
6. Toss gently, garnish with chopped parsley, and serve as a hearty salad.
title: Injera Salad with Roasted Vegetables & Niter Kibbeh Dressing

text:

- ½ avocado, sliced

4. Top each bowl with the marinated tuna, avocado slices, shredded nori, and green onions.  
5. Sprinkle black sesame seeds and furikake over the top. Serve immediately.

cuisine_title: **Title:** Hawaiian Poke Bowl with Ahi Tuna

cuisine_title: **Title:** Hawaiian Poke Bowl with Ahi Tuna
text:

Grilled Salmon Poke Bowl with Pineapple

cuisine_title: **Title:** Hawaiian Poke Bowl with Ahi Tuna
text:

text:
Nonce: dc79f58e9df136224ecd9b72c09039141357f22a
Crispy Tempura Ahi Poke Bowl

- 2 Tbsp soy sauce
- 1 Tbsp rice vinegar
- 1 tsp sesame oil
- ½ cup tempura batter mix
- ½ cup cold sparkling water
- 2 cups sushi rice
- ¼ cup shredded lettuce
- ¼ cup sliced green onions
- 1 Tbsp furikake
- 1 tsp toasted sesame seeds
- Oil for deep‑frying

Instructions:
1. Whisk soy sauce, rice vinegar, and sesame oil; toss the tuna cubes briefly, then set aside.  
2. Prepare tempura batter by mixing batter mix with sparkling water until smooth.  
3. Heat oil to 350 °F; dip a portion of the tuna in batter and fry for 30‑45 seconds until crisp; drain on paper towels.  
4. Assemble bowls with sushi rice, then add crispy tuna, lettuce, and green onions.  
5. Sprinkle furikake and sesame seeds. Serve immediately while the tempura is still crunchy.
title: Crispy Tempura Ahi Poke Bowl

cuisine_title: **Title:** Hawaiian Poke Bowl with Ahi Tuna
text:
Nonce: 1e3914f32453dc78add5e916add17f944477a58b
Kimchi Beef Poke Bowl (Fusion)

Ingredients:
- 8 oz thinly sliced ribeye steak
- 2 Tbsp soy sauce
- 1 Tbsp gochujang
- 1 tsp sesame oil
- 1 tsp grated garlic
- 2 cups cooked quinoa
- ½ cup kimchi, chopped
- ¼ cup sliced cucumber
- ¼ cup shredded carrots
- 1 Tbsp toasted sesame seeds
- 1 Tbsp sliced scallions

Instructions:
1. Marinate steak in soy sauce, gochujang, sesame oil, and garlic for 15 minutes.  
2. Quickly sear the steak in a hot pan, 1‑minute per side, then slice thinly.  
3. Place quinoa in bowls, then top with sliced beef, kimchi, cucumber, and carrots.  
4. Garnish with sesame seeds and scallions. Serve warm or at room temperature.
title: Kimchi Beef Poke Bowl (Fusion)

text:
Nonce: 7211e024c4199b46fc52fc76aba0316e54d91a1c
Breakfast Poke Bowl with Smoked Salmon and Egg

Ingredients:
- 6 oz smoked salmon, sliced into strips
- 2 Tbsp soy sauce
- 1 tsp sesame oil
- 1 tsp honey
- 2 cups sushi rice, warm
- 1 soft‑boiled egg, halved
- ¼ avocado, sliced
- ¼ cup edamame, shelled
- 1 Tbsp furikake
- 1 tsp chopped chives
- 1 tsp toasted nori strips

Instructions:
1. Whisk soy sauce, sesame oil, and honey; drizzle over smoked salmon and toss gently.  
2. Divide warm sushi rice into bowls.  
3. Arrange smoked salmon, soft‑boiled egg halves, avocado, and edamame on top of the rice.  
4. Sprinkle furikake, chives, and nori strips. Serve immediately for a hearty breakfast.
