text:
Nonce: eb58dd6566d51c5b6393774e6a669651410bf22f
Classic Lavender Crème Brûlée

Ingredients:
- 4 large egg yolks
- 1/2 cup granulated sugar (plus extra for caramelizing)
- 2 cups heavy cream
- 1 tablespoon culinary lavender buds
- 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract
- Pinch of fine sea salt

Instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 325 °F (160 °C) and place six ramekins in a large baking dish.
2. In a saucepan, combine the heavy cream and lavender buds; bring to a gentle simmer, then remove from heat and let steep for 10 minutes.
3. Strain the lavender‑infused cream through a fine mesh into a bowl; discard the buds.
4. Whisk together egg yolks, sugar, vanilla, and salt until the mixture lightens in color.
5. Slowly pour the warm cream into the yolk mixture, whisking constantly to avoid curdling.
6. Divide the custard evenly among the ramekins and pour hot water into the baking dish until it reaches halfway up the sides of the ramekins.
7. Bake for 35‑40 minutes, or until the custard is set but still slightly wobbly in the center.
8. Chill the ramekins in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours.
9. Just before serving, sprinkle a thin layer of granulated sugar over each custard and use a kitchen torch to caramelize until golden and crisp.
title: Classic Lavender Crème Brûlée

text:
Nonce: 5be4c822b98fcb6308f500214430c299208da24d
Lavender & Honey Crème Brûlée with Orange Zest

Ingredients:
- 4 large egg yolks
- 1/3 cup honey
- 1/4 cup granulated sugar (plus extra for topping)
- 2 cups whole milk
- 1 cup heavy cream
- 1 tablespoon dried culinary lavender
- Zest of 1 orange
- 1 teaspoon vanilla bean paste
- Pinch of salt

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 300 °F (150 °C) and set six ramekins in a deep roasting pan.
2. In a saucepan, combine milk, cream, lavender, and orange zest; bring to a simmer, then remove from heat and let steep 12 minutes.
3. Strain the mixture, discarding solids, and return the liquid to the pan; stir in honey until fully dissolved.
4. In a bowl, whisk egg yolks, sugar, vanilla, and salt until smooth.
5. Temper the yolk mixture by slowly adding the warm lavender‑cream, whisking constantly.
6. Pour the custard into the ramekins, then place the pan in the oven and add hot water to reach halfway up the ramekins.
7. Bake for 30‑35 minutes, until just set. Cool, then refrigerate for 2 hours.
8. Before serving, dust each custard with a thin layer of granulated sugar and torch until caramelized, revealing a fragrant orange‑lavender crust.
title: Lavender & Honey Crème Brûlée with Orange Zest

text:
Nonce: 42b91a14ec2472a5f3a8124d57ba27e419bbd4ed
Lavender-Infused Caramel Crème Brûlée Tart

Ingredients:
- 1 pre‑baked 9‑inch tart shell (pâte sucrée)
- 4 large egg yolks
- 1/2 cup light brown sugar
- 1 cup heavy cream
- 2 tablespoons culinary lavender buds
- 1/4 cup caramel sauce (store‑bought or homemade)
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- Pinch of sea salt
- Extra granulated sugar for brûlée topping

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 325 °F (160 °C). Set the tart shell on a baking sheet.
2. Heat the heavy cream with lavender buds until just simmering; remove from heat and steep 10 minutes, then strain.
3. In a mixing bowl, whisk egg yolks with brown sugar, vanilla, and salt until pale.
4. Gradually whisk the lavender‑infused cream into the yolk mixture, then fold in the caramel sauce.
5. Pour the custard filling into the prepared tart shell, smoothing the top.
6. Place the tart in a water bath (water reaching halfway up the sides) and bake for 35‑40 minutes, until the center is set but still slightly trembling.
7. Cool to room temperature, then refrigerate for at least 3 hours.
8. Just before serving, sprinkle a generous layer of granulated sugar over the tart surface and torch until a deep amber crust forms.
title: Lavender-Infused Caramel Crème Brûlée Tart

text:
Nonce: edcced032996a16d8be37bc035c330ec96a65e3a
Lavender Savory Crème Brûlée with Goat Cheese

Ingredients:
- 4 large egg yolks
- 1 cup heavy cream
- 1 cup whole milk
- 2 teaspoons dried culinary lavender
- 4 ounces fresh goat cheese, crumbled
- 1 tablespoon fresh thyme leaves
- 1/2 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper
- 1/4 teaspoon sea salt
- 2 tablespoons grated Gruyère cheese
- Extra grated cheese for topping

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 325 °F (160 °C) and arrange four ramekins in a baking dish.
2. In a saucepan, combine cream, milk, lavender, and thyme; bring to a gentle simmer, then remove from heat and let steep 8 minutes.
3. Strain the liquid, then stir in the crumbled goat cheese until smooth.
4. In a bowl, whisk egg yolks with salt and pepper until well blended.
5. Slowly whisk the warm lavender‑goat cheese mixture into the yolks, creating a uniform custard.
6. Divide the custard among the ramekins, then sprinkle a thin layer of grated Gruyère on each.
7. Place the baking dish in the oven, add hot water to reach halfway up the ramekins, and bake for 30‑35 minutes.
8. Cool slightly, then refrigerate for 1 hour.
9. Just before serving, top each with a pinch of extra grated cheese and use a torch to melt and brown the cheese, forming a savory brûlée crust.
title: Lavender Savory Crème Brûlée with Goat Cheese

text:
Nonce: 82c1b0e74195932478fdba74c5beffb154136644
Lavender Ice Cream Parfait with Crème Brûlée Crumble

Ingredients:
- 2 cups vanilla ice cream, softened
- 1/2 cup lavender‑infused crème brûlée (see Classic Lavender Crème Brûlée recipe)
- 1/4 cup toasted almond slivers
- 2 tablespoons honey
- Fresh lavender sprigs for garnish

Instructions:
1. Prepare the classic lavender crème brûlée and allow it to set; once chilled, break it into coarse crumbs.
2. In a bowl, gently fold the softened vanilla ice cream with honey until smooth.
3. In serving glasses, layer 2 tbsp of ice cream, then a spoonful of crème brûlée crumbs, followed by toasted almond slivers.
4. Repeat layers, finishing with a drizzle of honey and a small lavender sprig on top.
5. Freeze the parfaits for 15 minutes to firm, then serve with a spoon.
title: Lavender Ice Cream Parfait with Crème Brûlée Crumble

text:
Nonce: 22a417ceeee30a407a4c955f2cc6e5cbd27bed43
Lavender Panna Cotta with Brûléed Sugar

Ingredients:
- 2 cups heavy cream
- 1 cup whole milk
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 2 teaspoons culinary lavender buds
- 2 teaspoons powdered gelatin
- 1/4 cup cold water
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- Extra granulated sugar for torching

Instructions:
1. Sprinkle gelatin over cold water in a small bowl; let bloom for 5 minutes.
2. In a saucepan, combine cream, milk, sugar, and lavender buds; bring to a simmer, then remove from heat and steep 10 minutes.
3. Strain the mixture, discarding lavender, and stir in vanilla extract.
4. Re‑heat the cream mixture gently, then whisk in the bloomed gelatin until fully dissolved.
5. Pour the panna cotta into six small ramekins or glasses; refrigerate for at least 4 hours, until set.
6. Just before serving, evenly coat the surface of each panna cotta with a thin layer of granulated sugar and torch until a crisp caramelized crust forms.
title: Lavender Panna Cotta with Brûléed Sugar

text:
Nonce: 4283b60ceffc513585de60c603ca6e1454657722
Lavender Shortbread Crust Crème Brûlée

Ingredients:
- 1 cup all‑purpose flour
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, softened
- 2 tablespoons powdered sugar
- 1 tablespoon dried culinary lavender, finely ground
- 4 large egg yolks
- 1/2 cup heavy cream
- 1/2 cup whole milk
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar (plus extra for topping)
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- Pinch of salt

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350 °F (175 °C). In a bowl, combine flour, ground lavender, and powdered sugar.
2. Cut in the softened butter until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
3. Press the shortbread mixture evenly into the bottom of six ramekins, creating a thin crust.
4. Bake the crusts for 10‑12 minutes, until lightly golden; set aside to cool.
5. Meanwhile, heat cream and milk together until just simmering; remove from heat.
6. In a separate bowl, whisk egg yolks with granulated sugar and vanilla until pale.
7. Slowly pour the warm cream mixture into the yolks, whisking constantly.
8. Pour the custard over the cooled shortbread crusts.
9. Place the ramekins in a water bath and bake for 30‑35 minutes, until the custard is set.
10. Chill for 2 hours, then sprinkle a thin layer of sugar on each and torch to create a caramelized top.
title: Lavender Shortbread Crust Crème Brûlée

text:
Nonce: 01fe2b0473ad7c64f90670c4226909d6d372d525
Lavender Chocolate Ganache Crème Brûlée

Ingredients:
- 4 large egg yolks
- 1/2 cup granulated sugar
- 1 cup heavy cream
- 2 teaspoons culinary lavender buds
- 200 g dark chocolate (70% cacao), finely chopped
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- Pinch of sea salt
- Extra sugar for brûlée topping

Instructions:
1. Heat the cream with lavender buds in a saucepan until just simmering; remove from heat and steep 8 minutes.
2. Strain the lavender‑infused cream and return to the pan; add the chopped dark chocolate, stirring until smooth.
3. Stir in vanilla and salt, then let the ganache cool to warm temperature.
4. In a bowl, whisk egg yolks with sugar until thick and pale.
5. Temper the yolk mixture by slowly adding the warm chocolate ganache, whisking continuously.
6. Divide the custard among six ramekins.
7. Place ramekins in a water bath and bake at 300 °F (150 °C) for 30‑35 minutes, until set.
8. Cool, then refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
9. Just before serving, dust each with a thin layer of granulated sugar and torch until a glossy caramelized crust forms, contrasting with the rich chocolate interior.
title: Lavender Chocolate Ganache Crème Brûlée

text:
Nonce: 2a2075e4b7b3b11654c35817ddbba9a6cbe4cfdd
Lavender Lemon Soufflé Brûlée

Ingredients:
- 3 large eggs, separated
- 1/4 cup granulated sugar (plus extra for topping)
- 1/2 cup fresh lemon juice
- Zest of 2 lemons
- 1 tablespoon culinary lavender buds
- 1/2 cup heavy cream
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- Pinch of salt

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375 °F (190 °C) and butter six ramekins, then dust with a little sugar.
2. In a saucepan, combine heavy cream, lavender buds, and lemon zest; bring to a simmer, then remove from heat and steep 5 minutes.
3. Strain the mixture and stir in lemon juice, vanilla, and salt.
4. In a bowl, whisk egg yolks with 1/4 cup sugar until thick and pale; slowly whisk in the warm lavender‑lemon cream.
5. In a separate clean bowl, beat egg whites until soft peaks form, then continue beating to stiff peaks.
6. Gently fold the egg whites into the yolk mixture in three additions, preserving air.
7. Pour the batter into the prepared ramekins, filling each three‑quarters full.
8. Bake for 12‑15 minutes, until the soufflés have risen and the tops are lightly golden.
9. Immediately sprinkle a thin layer of granulated sugar over each soufflé and torch to create a crisp brûlée crust; serve immediately.
title: Lavender Lemon Soufflé Brûlée

text:
Nonce: 98c41ec9c3536e2420912b060961437cfce4653c
Lavender French 75 Cocktail with Brûléed Sugar Rim

Ingredients:
- 1 ½ oz gin
- ½ oz lavender‑infused simple syrup (see note)
- ½ oz fresh lemon juice
- 3 oz chilled Champagne or sparkling wine
- Granulated sugar for rim
- Fresh lavender sprig for garnish

Lavender‑Infused Simple Syrup:
- 1 cup water
- 1 cup sugar
- 1 tablespoon dried culinary lavender

Instructions:
1. To make the syrup, combine water, sugar, and lavender in a small saucepan; bring to a boil, then simmer 5 minutes. Cool, strain, and refrigerate.
2. Moisten the rim of a chilled coupe glass with a lemon wedge, then dip the rim into granulated sugar to coat.
3. In a shaker filled with ice, combine gin, lavender‑infused simple syrup, and lemon juice; shake briskly for 10 seconds.
4. Strain the mixture into the prepared glass, then top with chilled Champagne.
5. Using a kitchen torch, lightly caramelize a thin layer of sugar on the rim for a subtle brûléed aroma.
6. Garnish with a small lavender sprig and serve immediately.
title: Lavender French 75 Cocktail with Brûléed Sugar Rim

text:
Nonce: 5847b7fdf952986a0cc491297adad49ddf6cac2d
Classic Truffle‑Scented Risotto

Ingredients:
- 1 ½ cups Arborio rice
- 4 cups chicken or vegetable broth, kept warm
- ½ cup dry white wine
- 1 small shallot, finely minced
- 2  tbsp unsalted butter
- ¼ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese
- 2  tbsp extra‑virgin olive oil
- 30 g black truffle, thinly shaved
- Salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste

Instructions:
1. In a saucepan, bring the broth to a gentle simmer and keep it warm over low heat.
2. In a large skillet, heat the olive oil and 1  tbsp butter over medium heat; add the shallot and sauté until translucent, about 2 minutes.
3. Stir in the Arborio rice, coating each grain with oil; toast for 1 minute until the edges become translucent.
4. Deglaze with the white wine, stirring until the liquid is mostly absorbed.
5. Add a ladleful of warm broth to the rice, stirring constantly; once absorbed, add another ladleful. Continue this process, stirring frequently, until the rice is creamy and al dente, about 18‑20 minutes.
6. Remove the pan from heat; stir in the remaining butter, Parmesan, and shaved truffle. Season with salt and pepper.
7. Let the risotto rest for 1 minute, then serve immediately, garnished with extra truffle shavings if desired.
title: Classic Truffle‑Scented Risotto

text:
Nonce: 22dd04980cdeccb8b286a9433bf69e98f5e211ef
Wild Mushroom & Truffle Risotto

Ingredients:
- 1 ½ cups Arborio rice
- 4 cups mushroom‑infused broth (vegetable broth simmered with dried porcini)
- ½ cup dry white wine
- 1  cup mixed wild mushrooms, cleaned and sliced
- 1  small onion, diced
- 2  tbsp butter
- 2  tbsp olive oil
- ¼ cup grated Pecorino Romano
- 20 g black truffle, shaved
- 1  tsp fresh thyme leaves
- Salt and pepper to taste

Instructions:
1. Warm the mushroom‑infused broth in a saucepan over low heat.
2. In a deep pan, heat olive oil and 1  tbsp butter; add the onion and sauté until soft, about 3 minutes.
3. Add the wild mushrooms and thyme; cook until the mushrooms release their moisture and begin to brown, 5‑6 minutes.
4. Stir in the Arborio rice, coating it with the mushroom mixture; toast for 1 minute.
5. Pour in the white wine, stirring until it is mostly absorbed.
6. Begin adding the warm broth one ladle at a time, stirring continuously; wait until each addition is absorbed before adding the next. Continue until the rice is creamy and al dente, roughly 18 minutes.
7. Remove from heat; fold in the remaining butter, Pecorino, and shaved truffle. Adjust seasoning with salt and pepper.
8. Serve hot, garnished with extra mushroom slices and a few more truffle shavings.
title: Wild Mushroom & Truffle Risotto

text:
Nonce: 39504da96b4660425602b06a3a94067188cdd67e
Seafood Truffle Risotto

Ingredients:
- 1 ½ cups Arborio rice
- 4 cups seafood stock (made from shrimp shells and fish bones)
- ½ cup dry white wine
- 200 g mixed seafood (shrimp, scallops, and mussels), cleaned
- 1  small garlic clove, minced
- 2  tbsp butter
- 2  tbsp olive oil
- ¼ cup grated Parmesan cheese
- 15 g black truffle, shaved
- Zest of 1 lemon
- Fresh parsley, chopped
- Salt and white pepper to taste

Instructions:
1. Keep the seafood stock at a gentle simmer.
2. In a large skillet, heat olive oil and 1  tbsp butter; add garlic and sauté for 30 seconds.
3. Add the mixed seafood and cook just until opaque, about 2 minutes; remove and set aside.
4. Add the Arborio rice to the pan, stirring to coat; toast for 1 minute.
5. Deglaze with white wine, stirring until the liquid is absorbed.
6. Begin adding the hot seafood stock ladle by ladle, stirring constantly; wait for absorption before adding more. Cook until the rice is creamy and al dente, about 18 minutes.
7. Return the cooked seafood to the risotto; stir in the remaining butter, Parmesan, lemon zest, and shaved truffle.
8. Season with salt and white pepper; garnish with chopped parsley and extra truffle shavings before serving.
title: Seafood Truffle Risotto

text:
Nonce: e23a3c3ed0a9c9aaa46c7aa2d6eb8269de160b83
Saffron & Porcini Truffle Risotto

Ingredients:
- 1 ½ cups Arborio rice
- 4 cups vegetable broth infused with saffron threads
- ½ cup dry white wine
- ¼ cup dried porcini mushrooms, rehydrated in warm water
- 1  small shallot, minced
- 2  tbsp butter
- 2  tbsp olive oil
- ¼ cup grated Parmigiano‑Reggiano
- 20 g black truffle, shaved
- Pinch of saffron threads (from the broth)
- Salt and black pepper to taste

Instructions:
1. Prepare the saffron‑infused broth by simmering vegetable stock with a pinch of saffron; keep warm.
2. Drain the rehydrated porcini mushrooms, reserving the soaking liquid; chop the mushrooms.
3. In a saucepan, melt 1  tbsp butter with olive oil; sauté the shallot until translucent.
4. Add the chopped porcini and cook for 2 minutes, then stir in the Arborio rice, toasting lightly.
5. Pour in the white wine, stirring until absorbed.
6. Begin adding the warm saffron broth, one ladle at a time, stirring constantly; incorporate the reserved porcini liquid as part of the broth. Continue until the rice is creamy and al dente, about 18 minutes.
7. Remove from heat; fold in the remaining butter, Parmigiano‑Reggiano, and shaved truffle. Season with salt and pepper.
8. Serve immediately, garnished with a few extra saffron threads and truffle shavings.
title: Saffron & Porcini Truffle Risotto

text:
Nonce: 9a8d975232bcfde8c3b74cf5a6aa8a07a528269c
Prosciutto, Pea & Truffle Risotto

Ingredients:
- 1 ½ cups Arborio rice
- 4 cups chicken broth, kept warm
- ½ cup dry white wine
- 100 g prosciutto, thinly sliced and torn
- 1  cup fresh or frozen peas, thawed
- 1  small onion, finely diced
- 2  tbsp butter
- 2  tbsp olive oil
- ¼ cup grated Parmesan cheese
- 18 g black truffle, shaved
- Fresh mint leaves, torn
- Salt and pepper to taste

Instructions:
1. Warm the chicken broth in a saucepan over low heat.
2. In a large pan, heat olive oil and 1  tbsp butter; sauté the onion until soft, about 3 minutes.
3. Add the Arborio rice, stirring to coat; toast for 1 minute.
4. Deglaze with white wine, stirring until the liquid is absorbed.
5. Begin adding the warm broth ladle by ladle, stirring constantly; when the rice is halfway cooked (about 10 minutes), stir in the peas.
6. Continue adding broth until the rice reaches a creamy, al dente texture, roughly 18 minutes total.
7. Remove from heat; fold in the remaining butter, Parmesan, prosciutto, and shaved truffle. Season with salt and pepper.
8. Garnish with fresh mint and extra truffle shavings before serving.
title: Prosciutto, Pea & Truffle Risotto

text:
Nonce: d3d2f9a396d9f6630dca0fa0079379eb55fd9987
Roasted Butternut Squash & Truffle Risotto

Ingredients:
- 1 ½ cups Arborio rice
- 4 cups vegetable broth, kept warm
- ½ cup dry white wine
- 2  cups cubed butternut squash, roasted
- 1  small shallot, minced
- 2  tbsp butter
- 2  tbsp olive oil
- ¼ cup grated Pecorino Romano
- 22 g black truffle, shaved
- ½ tsp ground nutmeg
- Salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste

Instructions:
1. Roast the cubed butternut squash at 200 °C (400 °F) until tender and caramelized, about 25 minutes; set aside.
2. Keep the vegetable broth simmering in a saucepan.
3. In a deep skillet, heat olive oil and 1  tbsp butter; sauté the shallot until translucent.
4. Add the Arborio rice, stirring to coat; toast for 1 minute.
5. Deglaze with white wine, stirring until the liquid is absorbed.
6. Begin adding the warm broth ladle by ladle, stirring continuously; when the rice is about halfway done, fold in the roasted squash.
7. Continue adding broth until the rice is creamy and al dente, about 18 minutes total.
8. Remove from heat; stir in the remaining butter, Pecorino, nutmeg, and shaved truffle. Adjust seasoning with salt and pepper.
9. Serve hot, topped with additional truffle shavings.
title: Roasted Butternut Squash & Truffle Risotto

text:
Nonce: 1b423fcb5324306a1bdf39935e06a86cf1edef75
Gorgonzola, Walnut & Truffle Risotto

Ingredients:
- 1 ½ cups Arborio rice
- 4 cups beef or vegetable broth, kept warm
- ½ cup dry white wine
- 100 g Gorgonzola cheese, crumbled
- ¼ cup toasted walnuts, chopped
- 1  small garlic clove, minced
- 2  tbsp butter
- 2  tbsp olive oil
- ¼ cup grated Parmesan cheese
- 20 g black truffle, shaved
- Fresh rosemary leaves, minced
- Salt and black pepper to taste

Instructions:
1. Warm the broth in a saucepan over low heat.
2. In a large pot, heat olive oil and 1  tbsp butter; sauté the garlic until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
3. Add the Arborio rice, stirring to coat; toast for 1 minute.
4. Deglaze with white wine, stirring until the liquid is absorbed.
5. Add broth ladle by ladle, stirring constantly; continue until the rice is creamy and al dente, about 18 minutes.
6. Remove from heat; fold in the remaining butter, Parmesan, crumbled Gorgonzola, toasted walnuts, rosemary, and shaved truffle.
7. Season with salt and pepper; let the cheese melt into the risotto for a few minutes.
8. Serve immediately, garnished with extra walnut pieces and truffle shavings.
title: Gorgonzola, Walnut & Truffle Risotto

text:
Nonce: 4262085629f3eb16cb7ba4be51cbc37dd35868f4
Lemon‑Basil Truffle Risotto

Ingredients:
- 1 ½ cups Arborio rice
- 4 cups chicken broth, kept warm
- ½ cup dry white wine
- Zest and juice of 1 lemon
- ¼ cup fresh basil leaves, torn
- 1  small shallot, minced
- 2  tbsp butter
- 2  tbsp olive oil
- ¼ cup grated Parmesan cheese
- 18 g black truffle, shaved
- Salt and white pepper to taste

Instructions:
1. Keep the chicken broth at a gentle simmer.
2. In a saucepan, heat olive oil and 1  tbsp butter; sauté the shallot until translucent.
3. Add the Arborio rice, stirring to coat; toast for 1 minute.
4. Deglaze with white wine, stirring until absorbed.
5. Begin adding the warm broth ladle by ladle, stirring constantly; when the rice is nearly done, stir in the lemon zest and juice.
6. Continue cooking until the rice is creamy and al dente, about 18 minutes total.
7. Remove from heat; fold in the remaining butter, Parmesan, fresh basil, and shaved truffle. Season with salt and white pepper.
8. Plate the risotto, topping with extra basil leaves, a drizzle of olive oil, and additional truffle shavings.
title: Lemon‑Basil Truffle Risotto

text:
Nonce: 82250d1ebcfc244037c97568cfa929f2ff241501
Grilled Asparagus & Pancetta Truffle Risotto

Ingredients:
- 1 ½ cups Arborio rice
- 4 cups vegetable broth, kept warm
- ½ cup dry white wine
- 12  spears asparagus, trimmed and grilled, then cut into 2‑inch pieces
- 80 g pancetta, diced and crisped
- 1  small onion, finely chopped
- 2  tbsp butter
- 2  tbsp olive oil
- ¼ cup grated Pecorino Romano
- 20 g black truffle, shaved
- Fresh lemon juice (optional)
- Salt and pepper to taste

Instructions:
1. Warm the vegetable broth in a saucepan over low heat.
2. In a large skillet, heat olive oil; add the pancetta and cook until crisp; remove and set aside, leaving rendered fat.
3. Add the onion to the skillet and sauté until soft, about 3 minutes.
4. Stir in the Arborio rice, coating it with the pancetta fat; toast for 1 minute.
5. Deglaze with white wine, stirring until the liquid is absorbed.
6. Add broth ladle by ladle, stirring continuously; when the rice is halfway cooked, fold in the grilled asparagus pieces.
7. Continue adding broth until the rice is creamy and al dente, roughly 18 minutes.
8. Remove from heat; stir in the remaining butter, Pecorino, crisp pancetta, and shaved truffle. Season with salt, pepper, and a splash of lemon juice if desired.
9. Serve hot, garnished with extra asparagus spears and truffle shavings.
title: Grilled Asparagus & Pancetta Truffle Risotto

text:
Nonce: 94a47e55a52a2badcc36ca778475f62eaba0ea9f
Truffle Risotto Arancini (Fried Rice Balls)

Ingredients:
- 2  cups cooked Italian truffle‑scented risotto (cooled)
- ½ cup mozzarella cheese, cubed
- 1  egg, lightly beaten
- ½ cup all‑purpose flour
- 1  cup panko breadcrumbs
- 2  tbsp black truffle oil
- Vegetable oil for deep‑frying
- Salt and pepper to taste
- Fresh parsley, chopped (for garnish)

Instructions:
1. Prepare the truffle‑scented risotto according to the classic recipe and allow it to cool to room temperature.
2. Using a spoon, take a heaping tablespoon of risotto, flatten slightly, and place a cube of mozzarella in the center; encase the cheese with more risotto, forming a compact ball.
3. Set up a breading station: place flour in one bowl, beaten egg in a second, and panko breadcrumbs in a third.
4. Roll each rice ball in flour, dip in egg, then coat thoroughly with panko breadcrumbs. Place the coated balls on a tray.
5. Heat vegetable oil in a deep pan to 180 °C (350 °F). Fry the arancini in batches until golden brown and the mozzarella is melted, about 3‑4 minutes.
6. Remove with a slotted spoon; drain on paper towels. While still hot, drizzle with truffle oil and season with salt and pepper.
7. Garnish with chopped parsley and serve with a side of marinara sauce if desired.
title: Truffle Risotto Arancini (Fried Rice Balls)

text:
Nonce: 18741c832bdfcaa2ba122ad6a538fb8ed2b89ef1
Classic Paella Valenciana

Ingredients:
- 2 cups Bomba or Calasparra rice
- 1 ½ L chicken broth
- 1 g saffron threads
- 200 g rabbit, cut into pieces
- 200 g chicken thigh, bone‑in, skin‑on
- 100 g garrofó beans (or lima beans)
- 100 g fresh green beans, trimmed
- 1 medium tomato, grated
- 4 garlic cloves, minced
- 1 tsp smoked paprika
- 4 tbsp extra‑virgin olive oil
- Salt to taste
- Fresh rosemary sprig for garnish
- Lemon wedges for serving

Instructions:
1. In a large paella pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat and brown the rabbit and chicken pieces; season with salt.
2. Add the garlic and grated tomato, sauté until the mixture thickens, then stir in the smoked paprika.
3. Sprinkle the saffron into the hot chicken broth; let it infuse for 5 minutes, then pour the broth into the pan.
4. Distribute the rice evenly, then add the green beans and garrofó beans; do not stir after this point.
5. Bring to a gentle boil, then reduce heat to a simmer; cook for 18‑20 minutes until the rice is al dente and a socarrat (crispy bottom) forms.
6. Remove from heat, cover with a clean kitchen towel, and let rest for 5 minutes.
7. Garnish with a rosemary sprig and serve with lemon wedges.
title: Classic Paella Valenciana

text:
Nonce: 91204c1083d745575c1dd89e1afd92f40cd07ba5
Paella Valenciana with Chorizo and Prawns

Ingredients:
- 2 cups short‑grain rice
- 1 ½ L seafood‑chicken broth
- 1 g saffron threads
- 150 g chorizo, sliced
- 150 g raw prawns, peeled
- 200 g chicken thigh, diced
- 100 g garrofó beans
- 80 g green beans, cut into 2‑cm pieces
- 1 small red bell pepper, diced
- 3 garlic cloves, minced
- 1 tsp sweet paprika
- 3 tbsp olive oil
- Salt and black pepper
- Fresh rosemary for garnish
- Lemon wedges

Instructions:
1. Heat olive oil in the paella pan; fry the chorizo slices until they release their oil and turn lightly crisp.
2. Add the chicken pieces and brown them; season with salt and pepper.
3. Stir in garlic, red bell pepper, and sweet paprika; cook 2 minutes.
4. Dissolve saffron in the hot broth, then pour the broth over the meat mixture.
5. Add the rice, spreading it evenly, then top with garrofó beans, green beans, and raw prawns.
6. Simmer without stirring for 18‑20 minutes, allowing the rice to absorb the liquid and develop a socarrat.
7. Remove from heat, cover with a cloth for 5 minutes, garnish with rosemary, and serve with lemon wedges.
title: Paella Valenciana with Chorizo and Prawns

text:
Nonce: d31c3db11c6ac27677f797ab01614827830d9bee
Vegetarian Paella Valenciana

Ingredients:
- 2 cups Valencia rice
- 1 ½ L vegetable broth
- 1 g saffron threads
- 150 g garrofó beans (or large lima beans)
- 150 g green beans, trimmed
- 1 medium artichoke heart, quartered
- 1 small zucchini, sliced
- 1 tomato, grated
- 3 garlic cloves, minced
- 1 tsp smoked paprika
- 3 tbsp olive oil
- Salt to taste
- Fresh rosemary sprig
- Lemon wedges

Instructions:
1. Warm olive oil in the paella pan; add garlic and sauté until fragrant.
2. Stir in grated tomato and smoked paprika; cook 2 minutes.
3. Pour saffron‑infused vegetable broth into the pan.
4. Add the rice, spreading it evenly, then arrange garrofó beans, green beans, artichoke hearts, and zucchini on top.
5. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a gentle simmer; cook 18‑20 minutes without stirring, allowing a socarrat to form.
6. Remove from heat, cover with a clean kitchen towel, and let rest 5 minutes.
7. Garnish with rosemary and serve with lemon wedges.
title: Vegetarian Paella Valenciana

text:
Nonce: 397ca74cff4d5b121cccdad738f705320f2648df
Paella Valenciana with Duck Confit

Ingredients:
- 2 cups Bomba rice
- 1 ½ L chicken broth
- 1 g saffron threads
- 2 duck leg confit pieces, shredded
- 150 g chicken thigh, diced
- 100 g garrofó beans
- 80 g green beans, cut
- 1 small onion, finely chopped
- 2 garlic cloves, minced
- 1 tsp sweet paprika
- 3 tbsp olive oil
- Salt and pepper
- Fresh rosemary sprig
- Orange zest for garnish

Instructions:
1. In the paella pan, heat olive oil and sauté onion until translucent; add garlic and paprika.
2. Add the chicken pieces and brown them; season with salt and pepper.
3. Stir in the shredded duck confit, allowing its fat to coat the ingredients.
4. Dissolve saffron in hot chicken broth and pour into the pan.
5. Spread the rice evenly, then add garrofó beans and green beans.
6. Simmer uncovered for 18‑20 minutes, avoiding stirring, until the rice is cooked and a socarrat forms.
7. Remove from heat, let rest 5 minutes, garnish with rosemary and a pinch of orange zest.
title: Paella Valenciana with Duck Confit

text:
Nonce: 642e62c920a17069834931b296c4fd90d19df387
Paella Valenciana with Smoked Paprika and Black Garlic

Ingredients:
- 2 cups short‑grain rice
- 1 ½ L chicken broth
- 1 g saffron threads
- 200 g rabbit, cubed
- 200 g chicken thigh, bone‑in
- 100 g garrofó beans
- 100 g green beans
- 2 black garlic cloves, mashed
- 1 tsp smoked paprika
- 1 tsp sweet paprika
- 4 tbsp olive oil
- Salt to taste
- Fresh rosemary
- Lemon wedges

Instructions:
1. Heat olive oil in the paella pan; brown rabbit and chicken pieces, seasoning with salt.
2. Add mashed black garlic, smoked paprika, and sweet paprika; stir for 1 minute.
3. Pour saffron‑infused chicken broth into the pan.
4. Distribute the rice, then add garrofó beans and green beans.
5. Cook over medium‑low heat for 18‑20 minutes without stirring, allowing a crisp socarrat to develop.
6. Remove from heat, cover with a towel for 5 minutes.
7. Garnish with rosemary and serve with lemon wedges.
title: Paella Valenciana with Smoked Paprika and Black Garlic

text:
Nonce: 72d77ccda4c21c725d9c3f640085150b0bff364d
Cast‑Iron Skillet Paella Valenciana (Quick Version)

Ingredients:
- 1 ½ cups quick‑cooking rice
- 1 L chicken broth
- 1 g saffron threads
- 150 g chicken breast, diced
- 150 g rabbit sausage, sliced
- 80 g garrofó beans (or canned lima beans)
- 80 g green beans, cut
- 1 small tomato, finely chopped
- 2 garlic cloves, minced
- 1 tsp smoked paprika
- 3 tbsp olive oil
- Salt and pepper
- Fresh rosemary sprig
- Lemon wedges

Instructions:
1. In a 12‑inch cast‑iron skillet, heat olive oil; sauté garlic and tomato until soft.
2. Add chicken and rabbit sausage; season with salt, pepper, and smoked paprika; cook until lightly browned.
3. Stir in saffron‑infused broth, then add the rice, spreading it evenly.
4. Top with garrofó beans and green beans; bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer.
5. Cook for 12‑15 minutes, stirring only to prevent sticking, until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed.
6. Let the skillet rest off the heat for 3 minutes; garnish with rosemary and serve with lemon wedges.
title: Cast‑Iron Skillet Paella Valenciana (Quick Version)

text:
Nonce: 3c258a0d9a721f9d1a9804f1974825b20ff91f83
Creamy Saffron Risotto‑Style Paella Valenciana

Ingredients:
- 1 ½ cups Arborio rice
- 1 ½ L chicken broth
- 1 g saffron threads
- 200 g rabbit, cubed
- 200 g chicken thigh, bone‑in
- 100 g garrofó beans
- 100 g green beans
- 1 small onion, diced
- 2 garlic cloves, minced
- 50 ml dry white wine
- 3 tbsp olive oil
- 30 g grated Parmesan cheese
- Salt and pepper
- Fresh rosemary
- Lemon zest

Instructions:
1. Heat olive oil in a wide pan; sauté onion and garlic until translucent.
2. Add rabbit and chicken pieces; brown lightly, then deglaze with white wine.
3. Stir in saffron‑infused broth and Arborio rice; cook, stirring constantly, for 2 minutes.
4. Add garrofó beans and green beans; continue to stir, allowing the rice to release its starch and become creamy (about 18 minutes).
5. Season with salt and pepper; remove from heat and fold in Parmesan cheese.
6. Let rest 2 minutes, garnish with rosemary and a sprinkle of lemon zest before serving.
title: Creamy Saffron Risotto‑Style Paella Valenciana

text:
Nonce: d4de3402c9db1d4ea6e1f74bb047c9f0ce5588ef
Citrus‑Marinated Paella Valenciana

Ingredients:
- 2 cups Valencia rice
- 1 ½ L chicken broth
- 1 g saffron threads
- 200 g chicken thigh, marinated in orange juice and zest
- 200 g rabbit, marinated in lemon juice and zest
- 100 g garrofó beans
- 100 g green beans
- 1 orange, segmented
- 2 garlic cloves, minced
- 1 tsp smoked paprika
- 4 tbsp olive oil
- Salt to taste
- Fresh rosemary
- Orange and lemon wedges for garnish

Instructions:
1. Marinate chicken and rabbit pieces in equal parts orange and lemon juice with zest for 30 minutes; pat dry.
2. Heat olive oil in the paella pan; brown the marinated meat, then add garlic and smoked paprika.
3. Dissolve saffron in hot chicken broth; pour the broth into the pan.
4. Spread the rice evenly, then add garrofó beans, green beans, and orange segments.
5. Simmer uncovered for 18‑20 minutes, avoiding stirring, until the rice is cooked and a socarrat forms.
6. Remove from heat, cover with a towel for 5 minutes.
7. Garnish with rosemary and serve with additional orange and lemon wedges.
title: Citrus‑Marinated Paella Valenciana

text:
Nonce: 518e8ed2723831f1328027f1b0ad2f55cf4ab426
Red‑Wine‑Reduced Paella Valenciana

Ingredients:
- 2 cups Bomba rice
- 1 ½ L chicken broth
- 1 g saffron threads
- 200 g chicken thigh, bone‑in
- 200 g rabbit, cut into pieces
- 100 g garrofó beans
- 100 g green beans
- 150 ml dry red wine
- 2 garlic cloves, minced
- 1 tsp sweet paprika
- 4 tbsp olive oil
- Salt and pepper
- Fresh rosemary
- Crushed red pepper flakes (optional)

Instructions:
1. In the paella pan, heat olive oil; brown chicken and rabbit pieces, seasoning with salt and pepper.
2. Add garlic and paprika; sauté 1 minute, then pour in red wine; reduce by half.
3. Dissolve saffron in hot chicken broth and add to the pan.
4. Distribute the rice, then add garrofó beans and green beans.
5. Cook over medium heat for 18‑20 minutes without stirring, allowing the rice to absorb the liquid and form a socarrat.
6. Remove from heat, let rest 5 minutes, garnish with rosemary and a pinch of red pepper flakes if desired.
title: Red‑Wine‑Reduced Paella Valenciana

text:
Nonce: e2c5969b54a293f537f3df2319397288221f8c29
Sweet‑Potato & Kale Paella Valenciana

Ingredients:
- 2 cups short‑grain rice
- 1 ½ L chicken broth
- 1 g saffron threads
- 150 g chicken thigh, diced
- 150 g rabbit, cubed
- 100 g garrofó beans
- 100 g green beans
- 1 small sweet potato, peeled and diced
- 50 g kale, torn into bite‑size pieces
- 2 garlic cloves, minced
- 1 tsp smoked paprika
- 3 tbsp olive oil
- Salt to taste
- Fresh rosemary
- Lemon wedges

Instructions:
1. Heat olive oil in the paella pan; sauté garlic and smoked paprika until fragrant.
2. Add chicken and rabbit pieces; brown lightly, then stir in diced sweet potato.
3. Pour saffron‑infused chicken broth into the pan.
4. Spread the rice evenly, then add garrofó beans, green beans, and kale.
5. Simmer uncovered for 18‑20 minutes, avoiding stirring, until the rice is tender and a crispy socarrat forms.
6. Remove from heat, cover with a clean towel for 5 minutes.
7. Garnish with rosemary and serve with lemon wedges.
title: Sweet‑Potato & Kale Paella Valenciana

text:
Nonce: fa963e314069e20a466235171fe8ff022ca9d54b
Moroccan Seven‑Vegetable Couscous (Classic)

Ingredients:
- 1 cup fine semolina couscous
- 1 ½ cups water
- 1 tbsp olive oil
- ½ tsp salt
- 1 carrot, diced
- 1 zucchini, diced
- ½ cup chickpeas, cooked
- ½ cup green beans, trimmed and halved
- ½ cup butternut squash, cubed
- ¼ cup peas
- ¼ cup raisins
- 2 tsp ras el hanout
- ½ tsp ground cumin
- ¼ tsp cinnamon
- 2 cups vegetable broth

Instructions:
1. Bring the vegetable broth to a boil, add the ras el hanout, cumin, and cinnamon; simmer 5 minutes.  
2. Add the carrot, butternut squash, and green beans; cook 8 minutes.  
3. Stir in zucchini, peas, and chickpeas; cook another 5 minutes until all vegetables are tender.  
4. Meanwhile, place couscous in a large bowl, drizzle with olive oil and salt, then pour the hot broth over it; cover and let steam 5 minutes.  
5. Fluff the couscous with a fork, fold in the raisins, and gently mix with the vegetable broth.  
6. Serve the couscous topped with the seven‑vegetable mixture, garnished with fresh cilantro.
title: Moroccan Seven‑Vegetable Couscous (Classic)

text:
Nonce: 64ea6e8a37e8d52223725cdb3272aa1840d7b157
Roasted Vegetable Tagine over Couscous

Ingredients:
- 1 cup couscous
- 1 ½ cups boiling water
- 2 tbsp olive oil, divided
- 1 red bell pepper, sliced
- 1 yellow bell pepper, sliced
- 1 small eggplant, cubed
- 1 carrot, sliced diagonally
- 1 zucchini, sliced
- ½ cup chickpeas, rinsed
- 2 tsp ras el hanout
- 1 tsp smoked paprika
- ½ tsp ground ginger
- Salt and pepper to taste
- ¼ cup chopped preserved lemon
- 2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 200 °C (400 °F). Toss all vegetables and chickpeas with 1 tbsp olive oil, ras el hanout, smoked paprika, ginger, salt, and pepper.  
2. Spread on a baking sheet and roast 25‑30 minutes, turning halfway, until caramelized.  
3. Meanwhile, place couscous in a bowl, pour boiling water over it, cover, and let sit 5 minutes; fluff with 1 tbsp olive oil.  
4. Transfer roasted vegetables to a shallow pan, add preserved lemon, and warm 2 minutes.  
5. Serve the roasted tagine vegetables atop the fluffy couscous, sprinkled with fresh parsley.
title: Roasted Vegetable Tagine over Couscous

text:
Nonce: 693c2344ccaef125e435f63df5c8de36368eacdd
Harissa‑Spiced Charred Couscous with Seven Veg

Ingredients:
- 1 cup couscous
- 1 ½ cups hot water
- 2 tbsp harissa paste
- 1 tbsp olive oil
- 1 carrot, cut into sticks
- 1 zucchini, cut into sticks
- ½ cup chickpeas
- ½ cup cauliflower florets
- ¼ cup green peas
- ¼ cup raisins
- 1 tsp ras el hanout
- Salt to taste
- Fresh mint leaves for garnish

Instructions:
1. Toss carrot, zucchini, cauliflower, and chickpeas with olive oil, ras el hanout, and a pinch of salt. Grill or broil on high heat 8‑10 minutes, turning until charred.  
2. In a bowl, combine couscous with hot water, cover 5 minutes, then fluff. Stir in harissa paste, raisins, and green peas; season with salt.  
3. Fold the charred vegetables into the couscous, mixing gently.  
4. Plate and garnish with fresh mint leaves.
title: Harissa‑Spiced Charred Couscous with Seven Veg

text:
Nonce: 05eac9e94d5fda63bcb1a4472c48970f832542b3
Lemon‑Mint Couscous Salad with Seven Fresh Vegetables

Ingredients:
- 1 cup couscous
- 1 ¼ cups boiling water
- 2 tbsp lemon juice
- 1 tbsp olive oil
- 1 tbsp chopped fresh mint
- 1 carrot, grated
- 1 zucchini, grated
- ½ cup cherry tomatoes, halved
- ½ cup cooked chickpeas
- ¼ cup diced cucumber
- ¼ cup green olives, sliced
- Salt and pepper to taste

Instructions:
1. Place couscous in a large bowl, pour boiling water over it, cover, and let sit 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork.  
2. Whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, mint, salt, and pepper; drizzle over the couscous and toss.  
3. Add grated carrot, grated zucchini, tomatoes, chickpeas, cucumber, and olives; mix gently.  
4. Chill for 15 minutes before serving as a refreshing summer salad.
title: Lemon‑Mint Couscous Salad with Seven Fresh Vegetables

text:
Nonce: a5f5aa60a5f7e81da0aaa43334bb4e5dfac87d11
Baked Couscous Casserole with Seven Vegetables and Cheese

Ingredients:
- 1 ½ cups couscous
- 1 ¾ cups vegetable broth
- 2 tbsp butter, melted
- 1 carrot, diced
- 1 zucchini, diced
- ½ cup frozen peas
- ½ cup chickpeas
- ½ cup diced tomatoes
- ¼ cup raisins
- 1 tsp ras el hanout
- 1 cup shredded mozzarella
- Salt and pepper to taste

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 180 °C (350 °F).  
2. In a saucepan, bring vegetable broth to a boil; stir in couscous, butter, ras el hanout, salt, and pepper; cover and remove from heat for 5 minutes. Fluff.  
3. In a skillet, sauté carrot, zucchini, peas, and chickpeas with a splash of oil until just tender, about 5 minutes.  
4. Combine the sautéed vegetables, tomatoes, raisins, and half the mozzarella with the couscous; transfer to a greased baking dish.  
5. Sprinkle the remaining mozzarella on top and bake 20‑25 minutes, until golden and bubbling.
title: Baked Couscous Casserole with Seven Vegetables and Cheese

text:
Nonce: 5cee8c9899a4062c6534f3de04c3401f4b9d4e5a
Sweet‑Potato and Carrot Couscous Pilaf

Ingredients:
- 1 cup couscous
- 1 ½ cups water
- 1 tbsp olive oil
- 1 sweet potato, peeled and cubed
- 1 carrot, sliced
- ½ cup chickpeas
- ¼ cup golden raisins
- 1 tsp ras el hanout
- ½ tsp ground cinnamon
- Salt to taste
- Chopped pistachios for garnish

Instructions:
1. Toss sweet potato and carrot with olive oil, ras el hanout, cinnamon, and salt; roast on a sheet at 200 °C (400 °F) for 20 minutes, stirring halfway.  
2. Meanwhile, bring water to a boil, stir in couscous, cover, and let sit 5 minutes; fluff.  
3. Stir roasted vegetables, chickpeas, and raisins into the couscous.  
4. Serve warm, sprinkled with chopped pistachios.
title: Sweet‑Potato and Carrot Couscous Pilaf

text:
Nonce: d6eff0d0000821fcf2d39a83c0c1c45aa47c7862
Zucchini‑Tomato Couscous Soup

Ingredients:
- ½ cup couscous
- 4 cups vegetable broth
- 2 tbsp olive oil
- 1 onion, diced

- ½ tsp smoked paprika
- Salt and pepper to taste
- Fresh cilantro for garnish

Instructions:
1. Heat olive oil in a pot; sauté onion and garlic until translucent.  
2. Add zucchini, tomatoes, ras el hanout, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper; cook 5 minutes.  
3. Pour in vegetable broth and bring to a boil; add chickpeas and simmer 10 minutes.

title: Zucchini‑Tomato Couscous Soup

text:
Nonce: afde38168c09ffe8f4c81b4a310ca0f2becdc391
Couscous‑Stuffed Bell Peppers with Seven Vegetables

Ingredients:
- 4 large bell peppers (any color), tops cut off and seeded
- 1 cup couscous
- 1 ¼ cups boiling water
- 1 tbsp olive oil
- 1 carrot, finely diced
- 1 zucchini, finely diced
- ½ cup chickpeas
- ¼ cup raisins
- 1 tsp ras el hanout
- ½ cup shredded feta
- Salt and pepper to taste
- Fresh parsley, chopped (for garnish)

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 190 °C (375 °F).  
2. Place couscous in a bowl, pour boiling water over it, cover, and let sit 5 minutes; fluff with olive oil, ras el hanout, salt, and pepper.  
3. In a skillet, sauté carrot, zucchini, and chickpeas until tender, about 5 minutes.  
4. Combine the sautéed veg with the couscous, raisins, and half the feta; mix well.  
5. Stuff each bell pepper with the couscous mixture, place in a baking dish, and top with remaining feta.

title: Couscous‑Stuffed Bell Peppers with Seven Vegetables

text:
Nonce: 53565bb4b14ea7506967e7d59386e98fd8fbb210
Eggplant Moussaka with Couscous Base

Ingredients:
- 1 cup couscous
- 1 ½ cups vegetable broth
- 2 tbsp olive oil, divided
- 1 large eggplant, sliced ½ cm thick
- 1 carrot, grated
- 1 zucchini, grated
- ½ cup chickpeas
- 1 tsp ras el hanout
- ½ cup tomato sauce
- ¼ cup grated Parmesan
- Salt and pepper to taste
- Fresh basil leaves for garnish

Instructions:
1. Brush eggplant slices with 1 tbsp olive oil, season, and grill or bake at 200 °C (400 °F) until soft, about 15 minutes.  
2. Bring vegetable broth to a boil, stir in couscous, cover, and let sit 5 minutes; fluff and stir in ras el hanout, salt, and pepper.  
3. In a pan, sauté grated carrot, zucchini, and chickpeas with remaining olive oil for 5 minutes.

title: Eggplant Moussaka with Couscous Base

text:
Nonce: 3b1d2cfadacfbae1ceefce558d0f1f97e63fdfab
Moroccan Breakfast Couscous Bowl with Poached Egg

Ingredients:
- ½ cup couscous
- ¾ cup water
- 1 tbsp olive oil
- 1 carrot, shredded
- 1 zucchini, shredded
- ¼ cup chickpeas, warmed
- 1 tsp ras el hanout
- 1 egg
- 1 tbsp harissa (optional)
- Salt and pepper to taste
- Fresh cilantro leaves for garnish

Instructions:
1. Bring water to a boil, stir in couscous, olive oil, ras el hanout, salt, and pepper; cover and let sit 5 minutes; fluff.  
2. Fold in shredded carrot, zucchini, and warmed chickpeas.  
3. Poach the egg: simmer water with a splash of vinegar, create a gentle whirl, slide the egg in, and cook 3 minutes. Remove with a slotted spoon.  
4. Spoon the couscous mixture into a bowl, place the poached egg on top, drizzle with harissa if desired, and garnish with cilantro.
title: Moroccan Breakfast Couscous Bowl with Poached Egg

text:
Nonce: 141913e2c3d98742c688241b04eabd6bcf05bb5a
Classic Shrimp, Sweet Potato & Shiso Tempura

Ingredients:
- 8 large shrimp, peeled and deveined
- 1 medium sweet potato, peeled and cut into ½‑inch sticks
- 10 shiso leaves, washed and patted dry
- ½ cup all‑purpose flour
- ¼ cup cornstarch
- 1 large egg, lightly beaten
- ¾ cup ice‑cold sparkling water
- Pinch of salt
- Vegetable oil, for deep‑frying
- ½ cup dashi stock
- 2 tbsp soy sauce
- 1 tbsp mirin
- 1 tsp grated daikon (optional)

Instructions:
1. Heat oil in a deep pot to 170 °C (340 °F).
2. In a bowl, whisk flour, cornstarch, and salt; add the egg and ice‑cold sparkling water, stirring just until combined (batter will be lumpy).
3. Pat shrimp dry, toss sweet potato sticks in a little flour, and keep shiso leaves whole.
4. Dip each ingredient in batter, letting excess drip off, then carefully lower into hot oil. Fry shrimp 2‑3 min, sweet potato 3‑4 min, shiso 30‑45 sec until golden and crisp.
5. Remove to a wire rack, sprinkle lightly with sea salt.
6. For tentsuyu, combine dashi, soy sauce, mirin, and grated daikon in a small saucepan; warm gently.
7. Serve the tempura on a platter with the tentsuyu dipping sauce on the side.
title: Classic Shrimp, Sweet Potato & Shiso Tempura

text:
Nonce: 281ba6faad4c7b3bb6562b4ade5d8813021d3fa0
Spicy Chili‑Lime Tempura with Shiso

Ingredients:
- 6 jumbo shrimp, tails on
- 1 small sweet potato, sliced into ¼‑inch rounds
- 8 shiso leaves
- ½ cup rice flour
- ¼ cup potato starch
- 1 egg yolk
- ¾ cup ice‑cold soda water
- 1 tsp chili oil
- Zest of 1 lime
- Salt, to taste
- Vegetable oil
- ¼ cup soy sauce
- 2 tbsp rice vinegar
- 1 tsp finely chopped red chili
- 1 tsp lime juice

Instructions:
1. Heat oil to 180 °C (350 °F).
2. Mix rice flour, potato starch, and a pinch of salt. Stir in egg yolk, chili oil, lime zest, and soda water until just combined.
3. Lightly coat shrimp, sweet potato rounds, and shiso leaves in the batter.
4. Fry each piece until crisp and golden (shrimp 2‑3 min, sweet potato 3‑4 min, shiso 20‑30 sec). Drain on paper towels.
5. Whisk together soy sauce, rice vinegar, chopped chili, and lime juice to make the dipping sauce.
6. Sprinkle a pinch of sea salt on the tempura and serve with the spicy chili‑lime sauce.
title: Spicy Chili‑Lime Tempura with Shiso

text:

Miso‑Butter Dipping Tempura

Ingredients:

- 1 sweet potato, cut into match‑stick strips

- Salt
- Vegetable oil
- 2 tbsp white miso paste

- 1 tsp grated ginger

Instructions:
1. Heat oil to 170 °C (340 °F).
2. Combine flour, cornstarch, and a pinch of salt. Add egg and ice‑cold water; stir lightly to keep batter lumpy.
3. Coat shrimp, sweet potato strips, and shiso leaves in batter and fry until golden (shrimp 2‑3 min, sweet potato 3‑4 min, shiso 30 sec). Drain on a rack.
4. In a small saucepan, melt butter over low heat, add miso paste, mirin, and grated ginger; whisk until smooth and warm.
5. Drizzle the miso‑butter sauce over the tempura or serve it in a dipping bowl.
title: Miso‑Butter Dipping Tempura

text:

Tempura Salad with Sesame‑Ginger Dressing

- 8 shiso leaves, torn

2. Toss shrimp, sweet potato cubes, and shiso leaves in batter; fry until crisp (shrimp 2‑3 min, sweet potato 3‑4 min, shiso 30 sec). Set aside on paper towels.
3. In a bowl, whisk soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, and grated ginger to make the dressing.
4. Arrange mixed greens on plates, top with the fried tempura pieces, and drizzle with sesame‑ginger dressing.
5. Sprinkle toasted sesame seeds over the salad before serving.

text:

Tempura Sushi Rolls (Tempura Maki)

Ingredients:
- 4 sheets nori seaweed
- 1 cup sushi rice, cooked and seasoned
- 6 shrimp, peeled
- ½ sweet potato, thinly sliced
- 6 shiso leaves
- ½ cup tempura batter
- Vegetable oil
- 2 tbsp soy sauce
- 1 tsp wasabi paste
- Pickled ginger, for garnish

Instructions:
1. Heat oil to 180 °C (350 °F). Prepare batter and dip shrimp, sweet potato slices, and shiso leaves; fry until golden. Drain on paper towels.
2. Lay a nori sheet on a bamboo mat, spread a thin layer of sushi rice, leaving a 1‑inch border.
3. Place 2 tempura shrimp, 2 tempura sweet potato strips, and 2 tempura shiso leaves along the bottom edge.
4. Roll tightly, sealing the edge with a little water. Repeat for remaining sheets.
5. Slice each roll into 6 pieces. Serve with soy sauce, a dab of wasabi, and pickled ginger.
title: Tempura Sushi Rolls (Tempura Maki)

text:

Tempura Skewers with Yuzu Ponzu

Ingredients:
- 8 shrimp, peeled
- 1 sweet potato, cut into ½‑inch cubes
- 8 shiso leaves
- ½ cup tempura batter
- Bamboo skewers, soaked in water
- Vegetable oil
- ¼ cup soy sauce
- 2 tbsp yuzu juice
- 1 tbsp mirin
- 1 tsp grated daikon
- 1 tsp sesame seeds

Instructions:
1. Thread shrimp, sweet potato cubes, and shiso leaves alternately onto each skewer.
2. Heat oil to 170 °C (340 °F). Dip each skewer in tempura batter, allowing excess to drip off, then fry until crisp (about 3‑4 min). Remove and set on a rack.
3. In a small bowl, combine soy sauce, yuzu juice, mirin, and grated daikon; stir in sesame seeds.
4. Serve the tempura skewers with the yuzu ponzu dipping sauce on the side.
title: Tempura Skewers with Yuzu Ponzu

text:

Tempura Bites with Wasabi Aioli

Ingredients:
- 6 shrimp, peeled
- 1 sweet potato, cut into bite‑size wedges

- Vegetable oil
- ¼ cup mayonnaise
- 1 tsp wasabi paste (adjust to taste)

Instructions:
1. Heat oil to 175 °C (345 °F). Prepare batter and coat shrimp, sweet potato wedges, and shiso leaves; fry until golden and crisp. Drain on paper towels.

title: Tempura Bites with Wasabi Aioli

Tempura Udon Soup

Ingredients:
- 4 oz udon noodles
- 4 shrimp, peeled
- ½ sweet potato, thinly sliced
- 4 shiso leaves

- Vegetable oil

- 1 tbsp mirin
- 1 tsp grated ginger

Instructions:

4. Divide cooked udon into two bowls, ladle hot broth over the noodles, and top each with a few pieces of tempura shrimp, sweet potato, and shiso.
5. Garnish with sliced scallions and serve immediately.
title: Tempura Udon Soup

Tempura Donburi (Rice Bowl)

4. Garnish with pickled ginger, toasted sesame seeds, and an extra shiso leaf.

text:

Sweet Potato & Shiso Tempura Dessert with Matcha Glaze

Ingredients:
- 1 large sweet potato, peeled and cut into ½‑inch rounds

Instructions:
1. Heat oil to 180 °C (350 °F). Dip sweet potato rounds and shiso leaves in tempura batter; fry until lightly golden (sweet potato 2‑3 min, shiso 20‑30 sec). Drain on paper towels.

text:
Nonce: 524eca3bb76110a0e65f34f58856de6f7c961601
Classic Acarajé with Traditional Vatapá, Caruru & Dried Shrimp

Ingredients:
- 2 cups black‑eye peas, soaked overnight
- 1 small onion, finely chopped
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 tsp salt
- 1 tsp ground cumin
- Vegetable oil, for deep‑frying
- 1 cup vatapá (shrimp, peanuts, coconut milk, dendê oil)
- 1 cup caruru (okra, onion, dried shrimp, palm oil)
- ½ cup dried shrimp, toasted
- Hot pepper sauce (malagueta peppers, vinegar, salt)

Instructions:
1. Drain the soaked peas, rub them in a kitchen towel to remove the skins, then pulse briefly in a food processor with onion, garlic, salt, and cumin to form a coarse batter.
2. Heat vegetable oil in a deep pot to 350 °F (175 °C). Drop spoonfuls of the batter into the oil and fry until golden brown, about 3‑4 minutes; drain on paper towels.
3. Slice each fritter open and spoon a generous layer of vatapá inside, followed by caruru and toasted dried shrimp.
4. Drizzle hot pepper sauce over the filled fritters and serve immediately.
title: Classic Acarajé with Traditional Vatapá, Caruru & Dried Shrimp

text:

Tropical Acarajé with Mango‑Papaya Salsa & Coconut‑Milk Vatapá

Ingredients:
- 2 cups black‑eye peas, soaked overnight
- 1 small red onion, diced
- 1 tsp sea salt
- 1 tsp smoked paprika
- Coconut oil, for frying
- 1 cup vatapá (coconut milk, toasted cashews, dendê oil, lime zest)
- 1 cup mango‑papaya salsa (diced mango, papaya, lime juice, chopped cilantro)
- ½ cup toasted coconut flakes
- Chili‑lime sauce (malagueta pepper, lime juice, honey)

Instructions:
1. Blend the soaked peas with red onion, salt, and smoked paprika until a thick batter forms.
2. Heat coconut oil in a deep skillet to 340 °F (170 °C) and fry spoonfuls of batter until crisp and golden; set aside on a rack.
3. Warm the coconut‑milk vatapá in a saucepan, stirring until smooth.
4. Fill each fritter with a spoonful of vatapá, top with mango‑papaya salsa, and sprinkle toasted coconut flakes.
5. Serve with a drizzle of chili‑lime sauce.
title: Tropical Acarajé with Mango‑Papaya Salsa & Coconut‑Milk Vatapá

text:

Vegan Acarajé with Tofu Vatapá & Roasted Okra Caruru

Ingredients:
- 2 cups black‑eye peas, soaked overnight
- 1 small green onion, chopped
- 1 tsp sea salt
- 1 tsp ground coriander
- Sunflower oil, for frying
- 1 cup tofu vatapá (silken tofu, peanuts, coconut milk, dendê oil, turmeric)
- 1 cup roasted okra caruru (okra, onion, tomato, palm oil, smoked paprika)
- Fresh cilantro leaves
- Spicy cashew sauce (cashews, water, hot sauce, lime)

Instructions:
1. Pulse the soaked peas with green onion, salt, and coriander to a coarse batter.
2. Heat sunflower oil to 350 °F (175 °C) and fry batter balls until firm and golden; drain on paper towels.
3. In a saucepan, combine silken tofu, peanuts, coconut milk, dendê oil, and turmeric; simmer until thickened to make tofu vatapá.
4. Toss okra with olive oil, smoked paprika, and roast at 400 °F (200 °C) until slightly charred; mix with onion and tomato to create caruru.
5. Slice each fritter, fill with tofu vatapá, top with roasted okra caruru, garnish with cilantro, and serve with spicy cashew sauce.
title: Vegan Acarajé with Tofu Vatapá & Roasted Okra Caruru

- 1 tsp black pepper

- Lime‑infused pepper sauce (lime juice, malagueta pepper, olive oil, salt)

1. Blend soaked peas with shallot, salt, and black pepper to form a thick batter.
2. Heat canola oil to 350 °F (175 °C) and fry spoonfuls of batter until crisp; set aside.
3. Warm the creamy vatapá in a pan, stirring until smooth.
4. Open each fritter, spread a layer of vatapá, add smoked salmon and avocado slices.
5. Drizzle with lime‑infused pepper sauce and serve immediately.

Sweet Dessert Acarajé with Chocolate‑Banana Vatapá & Caramel Drizzle

Ingredients:
- 2 cups black‑eye peas, soaked overnight
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1 tsp cinnamon

- Butter, for frying

- ½ cup caramel sauce (brown sugar, butter, cream)
- Powdered sugar, for dusting
- Crushed toasted peanuts

2. Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat; drop batter spoonfuls and fry until golden brown on both sides.
3. Heat chocolate‑banana vatapá in a saucepan, stirring until glossy.
4. Fill each sweet fritter with chocolate‑banana vatapá, drizzle with caramel sauce, dust with powdered sugar, and sprinkle crushed peanuts.
5. Serve warm as a dessert snack.

text:

Classic Pork Belly Kimchi Jjigae

Ingredients:
- 300 g pork belly, sliced into 1‑cm pieces
- 2 cups well‑fermented kimchi, chopped
- 1 cup anchovy broth (water + 10 g dried anchovies, simmered 15 min)
- 200 g firm tofu, cubed
- 2 green onions, sliced diagonally
- 1 tbsp gochugaru (Korean red pepper flakes)
- 1 tbsp Korean soybean paste (doenjang)
- 1 tsp minced garlic
- 1 tsp sesame oil
- Salt to taste

Instructions:
1. Heat a heavy pot over medium heat, add pork belly and render the fat until lightly browned, about 5 minutes.  
2. Add minced garlic and gochugaru, stir‑fry for 30 seconds to release aroma.  
3. Incorporate the chopped kimchi and soybean paste, cooking for 3 minutes until the kimchi softens.  
4. Pour in the anchovy broth, bring to a gentle boil, then reduce to a simmer.  
5. Add tofu cubes and simmer for 10 minutes, allowing flavors to meld.  
6. Finish with sliced green onions, drizzle sesame oil, and season with salt as needed. Serve hot with steamed rice.
title: Classic Pork Belly Kimchi Jjigae

text:
Nonce: a89abcf4a062df6ad85293ce0e9503639a6d700e
Seafood Kimchi Jjigae with Clams and Shrimp

Ingredients:
- 1 cup kimchi, roughly chopped
- 200 g fresh clams, scrubbed
- 150 g large shrimp, peeled and deveined
- 1 cup anchovy broth
- 150 g soft tofu, sliced
- 1 small Korean radish, thinly sliced
- 1 tbsp gochujang (Korean chili paste)
- 1 tsp minced ginger
- 2 green onions, chopped
- 1 tbsp vegetable oil
- Salt and pepper to taste

Instructions:
1. In a pot, heat vegetable oil over medium heat and sauté minced ginger for 1 minute.  
2. Add kimchi and radish, stir‑fry for 2 minutes until fragrant.  
3. Stir in gochujang, then pour in anchovy broth, bringing the mixture to a boil.  
4. Add clams and shrimp, cover, and cook for 4‑5 minutes until the shell opens and shrimp turn pink.  
5. Gently place tofu slices into the broth, simmer for another 2 minutes.  
6. Season with salt and pepper, garnish with chopped green onions, and serve immediately.
title: Seafood Kimchi Jjigae with Clams and Shrimp

text:
Nonce: 46e7309035174bf28b28cbf0f56e7677ec3b978d
Beef Short Rib Kimchi Jjigae

Ingredients:
- 300 g beef short rib, cut into 2‑cm pieces
- 1 ½ cups aged kimchi, coarsely chopped
- 1 cup anchovy broth
- 200 g firm tofu, cubed
- 1 small onion, sliced
- 1 tbsp gochugaru
- 1 tbsp soy sauce
- 1 tsp toasted sesame seeds
- 2 green onions, sliced
- 1 tbsp sesame oil
- Black pepper to taste

Instructions:
1. In a heavy‑bottomed pot, sear short rib pieces over high heat until browned on all sides, about 6 minutes.  
2. Add sliced onion and continue to sauté until translucent, 2 minutes.  
3. Stir in kimchi, gochugaru, and soy sauce; cook for 3 minutes, allowing the kimchi to caramelize slightly.  
4. Pour in anchovy broth, bring to a boil, then reduce to a gentle simmer.  
5. Add tofu cubes and simmer for 15 minutes, or until the meat is tender.  
6. Finish with sesame oil, toasted sesame seeds, and sliced green onions. Serve hot.
title: Beef Short Rib Kimchi Jjigae

text:
Nonce: 52202df46015e57e3a272037a0fbf6a1fad1c315
Vegan Mushroom Kimchi Jjigae

Ingredients:
- 2 cups kimchi (ensure no fish sauce)
- 200 g assorted mushrooms (shiitake, oyster, enoki), sliced
- 1 cup vegetable broth infused with dried kelp

2. Add kimchi and gochugaru, stir‑cook for 2 minutes.  
3. Mix in fermented soybean paste, then pour in kelp‑infused vegetable broth; bring to a boil.  
4. Reduce heat and add tofu cubes, simmer for 8 minutes.  
5. Season with salt, sprinkle toasted sesame seeds, and garnish with chopped green onions before serving.
title: Vegan Mushroom Kimchi Jjigae

text:
