- 2 cups cooked black beans, rinsed and drained
- 1 cup diced cooked pork shoulder
- ½ cup sliced chorizo, lightly fried and cooled
- 1 cup mixed baby greens
- ½ cup thinly sliced radish
- ¼ cup toasted pumpkin seeds
- 2 tbsp orange juice
- 1 tbsp lime juice
- 1 tbsp olive oil
- 1 tsp honey
- Salt and pepper

Instructions:
1. In a large bowl, combine black beans, pork, chorizo, greens, radish, and pumpkin seeds.
2. Whisk together orange juice, lime juice, olive oil, honey, salt, and pepper to make the vinaigrette.
3. Drizzle vinaigrette over the salad and toss gently.
4. Serve chilled, optionally with extra orange slices.
title: Cold Feijoada Salad with Citrus Vinaigrette

text:
Nonce: 960103592058c335fae0b7a4413ea315ce1ee0c6
Feijoada‑Flavored Risotto

Ingredients:
- 1 cup Arborio rice
- 3 cups feijoada broth (beans, pork, chorizo, sausage)
- ½ cup white wine
- 1 cup cooked black beans
- ½ cup diced pork shoulder
- ¼ cup grated Parmesan
- 2 tbsp butter
- 1 small onion, finely chopped
- 1 clove garlic, minced
- Fresh orange zest
- Salt and pepper

Instructions:
1. In a saucepan, keep feijoada broth warm over low heat.
2. In a separate pot, melt butter; sauté onion and garlic until translucent.
3. Add Arborio rice, stirring to coat; pour in white wine and cook until absorbed.
4. Begin adding warm broth one ladle at a time, stirring constantly, waiting for each addition to be absorbed before adding the next.
5. When rice is al dente (about 18 minutes), stir in black beans, pork, and Parmesan; season with salt and pepper.
6. Finish with a sprinkle of orange zest and serve immediately.
title: Feijoada‑Flavored Risotto

text:
Nonce: ea56e03d6f13863f10ca1894ec61554c5f8aee83
Feijoada‑Spiced Chocolate Truffles

Ingredients:
- 200 g dark chocolate (70% cacao), melted
- ½ cup heavy cream
- 1 tbsp feijoada reduction (slow‑cooked pork‑and‑bean sauce, strained)
- ¼ tsp smoked paprika
- ¼ tsp cayenne pepper
- Cocoa powder for coating
- Orange zest for garnish

Instructions:
1. Heat heavy cream in a saucepan until just simmering; stir in melted chocolate until smooth.
2. Add feijoada reduction, smoked paprika, and cayenne; mix well and chill the ganache for 2 hours.
3. Scoop small balls with a teaspoon, roll between palms to form truffles.
4. Coat each truffle in cocoa powder, then garnish with a pinch of orange zest.
5. Store in the refrigerator and serve at room temperature.
title: Feijoada‑Spiced Chocolate Truffles

cuisine_title: **Title:** Japanese Matcha Green Tea Soba Noodles
text:
Nonce: 03d39c2339294dcbff89ff79daacb0a4e0ce59c8
Matcha‑Soy Chilled Soba Salad with Citrus Vinaigrette

Ingredients:
- 200 g buckwheat soba noodles  
- 2 tsp culinary‑grade matcha powder  
- 3 tbsp soy sauce  
- 1 tbsp rice vinegar  
- zest of 1 yuzu (or lemon)  
- 1 tsp honey  
- ½ cup thinly sliced cucumber  
- ¼ cup shredded carrot  
- 1 tbsp toasted sesame seeds  
- pinch of sea salt  

Instructions:
1. Cook the soba according to the package, drain, and rinse under cold water until the noodles are no longer sticky.  
2. In a small bowl whisk together matcha, soy sauce, rice vinegar, yuzu zest, honey, and sea salt until the mixture is uniform.  
3. Toss the cooled noodles with the matcha‑soy dressing, then fold in cucumber and carrot.  
4. Transfer to serving bowls, sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds, and serve chilled.  

---
title: Matcha‑Soy Chilled Soba Salad with Citrus Vinaigrette

cuisine_title: **Title:** Japanese Matcha Green Tea Soba Noodles
text:
Nonce: 04f73deec44fd919adc42d617d65b29be60e0860
Warm Matcha Soba Soup with Shiitake and Tofu

Ingredients:
- 180 g soba noodles  
- 1 tsp matcha powder  
- 4 cups dashi broth  
- 2 tbsp soy sauce  
- 1 tbsp mirin  
- 4 oz silken tofu, cubed  
- ½ cup sliced shiitake mushrooms  
- 2 green onions, sliced thin  
- 1 tbsp toasted sesame oil  
- pinch of shichimi pepper  

Instructions:
1. Bring dashi to a gentle boil, add soy sauce and mirin, then stir in matcha until fully dissolved.  
2. Add shiitake and simmer for 3 minutes.  
3. Drop the soba noodles into the broth and cook 3‑4 minutes, or until al dente.  
4. Gently add tofu cubes, heat through, then drizzle with sesame oil.  
5. Ladle into bowls, garnish with green onions and a pinch of shichimi pepper.  

---
title: Warm Matcha Soba Soup with Shiitake and Tofu

cuisine_title: **Title:** Japanese Matcha Green Tea Soba Noodles
text:
Nonce: 36869903d915bcf9f6732b2d564292f76e2b6bec
Matcha Soba Stir‑Fry with Charred Eggplant and Miso Glaze

Ingredients:
- 200 g soba noodles  
- 1 tsp matcha powder  
- 2 tbsp white miso paste  
- 2 tbsp soy sauce  
- 1 tbsp mirin  
- 1 large eggplant, diced  
- 2 tbsp vegetable oil  
- 1 clove garlic, minced  
- 1 tsp grated ginger  
- 1 tbsp toasted sesame seeds  
- 2 tbsp chopped cilantro  

Instructions:
1. Toss the soba with a little water and set aside.  
2. In a wok heat oil, add eggplant and stir‑fry until caramelized, about 6 minutes.  
3. Add garlic and ginger; cook 30 seconds.  
4. Stir in miso, soy sauce, mirin, and matcha; whisk to create a glaze.  
5. Add the soba noodles, toss to coat, and heat for 2 minutes.  
6. Serve topped with sesame seeds and cilantro.  

---
title: Matcha Soba Stir‑Fry with Charred Eggplant and Miso Glaze

cuisine_title: **Title:** Japanese Matcha Green Tea Soba Noodles
text:
Nonce: ac4fb0040b8d6e614eec7589d49f7282509eed43
Matcha Soba Sushi Rolls with Avocado and Pickled Daikon

Ingredients:
- 250 g cooked soba noodles, cooled  
- 2 tsp matcha powder  
- 2 tbsp soy sauce  
- 1 tbsp rice vinegar  
- 4 sheets nori  
- 1 avocado, sliced thin  
- ½ cup pickled daikon, julienned  
- 1 tbsp toasted sesame seeds  
- Wasabi and soy sauce for dipping  

Instructions:
1. Whisk matcha, soy sauce, and rice vinegar; toss the cooled soba to coat evenly.  
2. Place a nori sheet on a bamboo mat, spread a thin layer of soba across the surface, leaving a 1‑inch border.  
3. Arrange avocado slices and pickled daikon along the bottom edge.  
4. Roll tightly using the mat, sealing the edge with a little water.  
5. Slice into 6 pieces, sprinkle with sesame seeds, and serve with wasabi and soy sauce.  

---
title: Matcha Soba Sushi Rolls with Avocado and Pickled Daikon

text:
Nonce: 53feac1310df0ff27954aa3b13ff088918e34504
Matcha Soba Pancakes with Sweet Red Bean Paste

Ingredients:
- 150 g soba flour (or finely ground soba noodles)  
- 1 tsp matcha powder  
- 1 egg  
- 120 ml milk (dairy or plant‑based)  
- 1 tbsp sugar  
- ½ tsp baking powder  
- 2 tbsp vegetable oil (for cooking)  
- ¼ cup sweet red bean paste (anko)  
- Powdered matcha for dusting  

Instructions:
1. In a bowl combine soba flour, matcha, sugar, and baking powder.  
2. Whisk egg and milk together, then pour into the dry ingredients; stir until just combined.  
3. Heat a non‑stick skillet, brush with oil, and ladle ¼‑cup batter per pancake. Cook 2‑3 minutes per side until golden.  
4. Stack pancakes, spread a spoonful of red bean paste between each layer.  
5. Dust the top with powdered matcha and serve warm.  

---
title: Matcha Soba Pancakes with Sweet Red Bean Paste

cuisine_title: **Title:** Japanese Matcha Green Tea Soba Noodles
text:
Nonce: f34ae5b4d27310ed727dba8149631c4d508e4991
Matcha Soba “Pasta” Carbonara with Crispy Nori

Ingredients:
- 200 g soba noodles  
- 1 tsp matcha powder  
- 3 tbsp soy sauce  
- 2 tbsp mirin  
- 2 large egg yolks  
- ¼ cup grated Parmesan (optional)  
- 4 sheets nori, toasted and crumbled  
- 2 tbsp butter  
- 1 clove garlic, minced  
- Freshly ground black pepper  

Instructions:
1. Cook soba, drain, and reserve ½ cup cooking water.  
2. In a bowl whisk egg yolks, soy sauce, mirin, matcha, and Parmesan until smooth.  
3. Melt butter in a pan, sauté garlic briefly, then add the soba and toss.  
4. Remove from heat; quickly stir in the egg‑soy mixture, adding reserved water a little at a time to create a silky coating.  
5. Plate, top with crumbled nori, and finish with a grind of black pepper.  

---
title: Matcha Soba “Pasta” Carbonara with Crispy Nori

cuisine_title: **Title:** Japanese Matcha Green Tea Soba Noodles
text:
Nonce: 39ccf3a9e773590950e4d7ec37bb3173b2d809ed
Matcha Soba Spring Rolls with Peanut‑Matcha Dipping Sauce

Ingredients:
- 150 g soba noodles, cooked and cooled  
- 1 tsp matcha powder  
- 2 tbsp soy sauce  
- 1 tbsp rice vinegar  
- 8 rice paper wrappers  
- ½ cup shredded purple cabbage  
- ¼ cup carrot ribbons  
- ¼ cup fresh mint leaves  
- ¼ cup cilantro leaves  
- 2 tbsp creamy peanut butter  
- 1 tbsp honey  
- 1 tsp lime juice  
- pinch of chili flakes  

Instructions:
1. Toss cooled soba with matcha, soy sauce, and rice vinegar; set aside.  
2. Soak a rice paper sheet in warm water until pliable, lay flat.  
3. Place a small amount of soba, cabbage, carrot, mint, and cilantro near the bottom edge; roll tightly.  
4. Repeat for remaining wrappers.  
5. For the sauce, whisk peanut butter, honey, lime juice, chili flakes, and a splash of water to reach dipping consistency.  
6. Serve rolls with the peanut‑matcha sauce.  

---
title: Matcha Soba Spring Rolls with Peanut‑Matcha Dipping Sauce

cuisine_title: **Title:** Japanese Matcha Green Tea Soba Noodles
text:
Nonce: c30ccbcdcadc3b2d7fae4409c510c885eabf05b8
Matcha Soba “Risotto” with Sweet Corn and Shiso

Ingredients:
- 180 g soba noodles, broken into short pieces  
- 1 tsp matcha powder  
- 3 cups vegetable broth, kept warm  
- 1 tbsp olive oil  
- 1 small onion, finely diced  
- 1 clove garlic, minced  
- ½ cup fresh sweet corn kernels  
- 2 tbsp shiso leaves, finely chopped  
- 2 tbsp grated Parmesan (optional)  
- Salt and white pepper to taste  

Instructions:
1. Heat olive oil in a saucepan, sauté onion and garlic until translucent.  
2. Add broken soba pieces and toast lightly for 1 minute.  
3. Stir in matcha, then begin adding warm broth one ladle at a time, stirring constantly, allowing absorption before adding more (as with risotto).  
4. When the broth is nearly absorbed, fold in corn and continue cooking until soba is tender and creamy.  
5. Remove from heat, stir in shiso, Parmesan, salt, and pepper.  
6. Serve immediately, garnished with extra shiso.  

---
title: Matcha Soba “Risotto” with Sweet Corn and Shiso

cuisine_title: **Title:** Japanese Matcha Green Tea Soba Noodles
text:
Nonce: f53f58cc0948a6407824f1ed63d2dc8ccb7052be
Matcha Soba Ice Cream Sundae with Black Sesame Crunch

Ingredients:
- 200 ml matcha‑infused milk (milk + 1 tsp matcha, whisked)  
- 200 ml heavy cream  
- ½ cup sugar  
- 4 egg yolks  
- ½ cup cooked soba noodles, finely chopped  
- 2 tbsp black sesame seeds, toasted and crushed  
- ¼ cup sweetened condensed milk (for drizzling)  

Instructions:
1. In a saucepan heat matcha‑milk and cream until just simmering.  
2. Whisk sugar and egg yolks together, then slowly pour the hot milk mixture into the yolks while whisking constantly.  
3. Return the custard to the saucepan, cook over low heat, stirring, until it coats the back of a spoon.  
4. Remove, stir in chopped soba, then chill the mixture completely.  
5. Churn in an ice‑cream maker according to manufacturer’s directions.  
6. Scoop into bowls, drizzle with condensed milk, and sprinkle black sesame crunch on top.  

---
title: Matcha Soba Ice Cream Sundae with Black Sesame Crunch

text:
Nonce: 3c899575f47a453cad294f91af25005cfcda2b88
Matcha Soba “Buddha Bowl” with Roasted Sweet Potato and Miso‑Tahini Dressing

Ingredients:
- 180 g soba noodles  
- 1 tsp matcha powder  
- 2 tbsp soy sauce  
- 1 tbsp rice vinegar  
- 1 small sweet potato, cubed  
- 2 tbsp olive oil  
- ¼ cup edamame, shelled  
- ¼ cup sliced radish  
- 2 tbsp tahini  
- 1 tbsp white miso paste  
- 1 tsp maple syrup  
- 1 tbsp water (to thin dressing)  
- 1 tbsp toasted sesame seeds  
- microgreens for garnish  

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 200 °C (400 °F). Toss sweet potato cubes with olive oil, salt, and pepper; roast 20‑25 minutes until caramelized.  
2. Cook soba, drain, and rinse under cold water; toss with matcha, soy sauce, and rice vinegar.  
3. In a small bowl whisk tahini, miso, maple syrup, and water until smooth.  
4. Assemble bowls: base of matcha‑soba, top with roasted sweet potato, edamame, radish, and a drizzle of miso‑tahini dressing.  
5. Sprinkle toasted sesame seeds and microgreens before serving.
title: Matcha Soba “Buddha Bowl” with Roasted Sweet Potato and Miso‑Tahini Dressing

text:
Nonce: 772e1b16247ea8dcb2195834f971804976d5af9e
Spicy Gochujang‑Glazed Tofu Skewers

Ingredients:
- 1 block firm tofu, pressed and cut into 1‑inch cubes
- 3 Tbsp gochujang
- 2 Tbsp soy sauce
- 1 Tbsp rice vinegar
- 1 Tbsp honey
- 1 tsp sesame oil
- 2 tsp toasted sesame seeds
- 2 tsp minced garlic
- Bamboo skewers, soaked 30 min
- Pickled radish, for serving

Instructions:
1. In a bowl whisk together gochujang, soy sauce, rice vinegar, honey, sesame oil, and minced garlic to form the glaze.
2. Toss the tofu cubes in the glaze until fully coated; let marinate 15 min.
3. Thread the tofu onto soaked bamboo skewers, leaving a little space between pieces.
4. Preheat a grill or grill pan over medium‑high heat; brush lightly with oil.
5. Grill the skewers 3‑4 min per side, basting with remaining glaze, until charred edges appear.
6. Sprinkle toasted sesame seeds over the hot skewers.
7. Serve immediately with pickled radish on the side.
title: Spicy Gochujang‑Glazed Tofu Skewers

text:
Nonce: ee9499b8fe8daeb5e35bb5ab8062d3766cebd032
Gochujang Tofu Skewers with Sesame‑Soy Drizzle

Ingredients:
- 1 block extra‑firm tofu, cubed
- 2 Tbsp gochujang
- 1 Tbsp maple syrup
- 1 Tbsp soy sauce
- 1 tsp toasted sesame oil
- 1 tsp grated ginger
- 1 tsp rice wine vinegar
- 1 Tbsp toasted sesame seeds
- 2 tsp chopped scallions
- 8 bamboo skewers, soaked
- Steamed rice, for serving

Instructions:
1. Combine gochujang, maple syrup, soy sauce, sesame oil, ginger, and rice wine vinegar; stir into a thick glaze.
2. Coat tofu cubes in the glaze; let sit 10 min.
3. Skewer the tofu and grill over medium heat, turning and brushing with glaze until caramelized, about 6 min total.
4. In a small bowl mix 1 Tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp sesame oil, and a splash of water; drizzle over the cooked skewers.
5. Garnish with toasted sesame seeds and chopped scallions; serve over steamed rice.
title: Gochujang Tofu Skewers with Sesame‑Soy Drizzle

text:
Nonce: 9ebfd163c1694c70093c8b8e9a2946e72e3db02f
Gochujang‑Marinated Tofu Skewers with Kimchi Slaw

Ingredients:
- 1 block firm tofu, cubed
- 2 Tbsp gochujang
- 1 Tbsp gochugaru (Korean red pepper flakes)
- 1 Tbsp soy sauce
- 1 Tbsp brown sugar
- 1 tsp minced garlic
- 1 tsp sesame oil
- 6 bamboo skewers, soaked
- 1 cup kimchi, finely chopped
- ½ cup shredded napa cabbage
- 1 Tbsp rice vinegar
- 1 tsp honey
- 1 tsp toasted sesame seeds

Instructions:
1. Whisk together gochujang, gochugaru, soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, and sesame oil; marinate tofu cubes for 20 min.
2. Thread tofu onto skewers and grill on medium heat, turning until glossy and lightly charred, about 8 min total.
3. Meanwhile, combine kimchi, napa cabbage, rice vinegar, honey, and sesame seeds in a bowl; toss to create slaw.
4. Serve the hot tofu skewers atop a bed of kimchi slaw, allowing the tangy crunch to balance the spicy glaze.
title: Gochujang‑Marinated Tofu Skewers with Kimchi Slaw

text:
Nonce: 6e1320a30d4f32d17f6dfd87c8f399d20e4e7daa
Grilled Gochujang Tofu Skewers with Sweet Potato Mash

Ingredients:
- 1 block firm tofu, cubed
- 2 Tbsp gochujang
- 1 Tbsp soy sauce
- 1 Tbsp maple syrup
- 1 tsp smoked paprika
- 1 tsp minced garlic
- 2 medium sweet potatoes, peeled and cubed
- 2 Tbsp butter or vegan alternative
- 1 tsp ground black pepper
- 6 bamboo skewers, soaked
- Chopped chives, for garnish

Instructions:
1. Blend gochujang, soy sauce, maple syrup, smoked paprika, and garlic into a glaze.
2. Toss tofu cubes in the glaze; let rest 10 min.
3. Meanwhile, boil sweet potato cubes until tender, then drain.
4. Mash sweet potatoes with butter, black pepper, and a pinch of salt until smooth.
5. Grill tofu skewers over medium heat, basting with extra glaze, until caramelized, about 7 min.
6. Plate the sweet potato mash, top with the grilled tofu skewers, and sprinkle with chopped chives.
title: Grilled Gochujang Tofu Skewers with Sweet Potato Mash

text:
Nonce: 9e19dcc8c5b2d4621ddb525fb7b3874a0d056e49
Gochujang Tofu Skewers over Bibimbap Bowl

Ingredients:
- 1 block firm tofu, cubed
- 2 Tbsp gochujang
- 1 Tbsp soy sauce
- 1 Tbsp sesame oil
- 1 tsp minced garlic
- 1 tsp ginger paste
- 4 bamboo skewers, soaked
- 2 cups cooked short‑grain rice
- ½ cup sautéed spinach
- ½ cup shredded carrots
- ½ cup bean sprouts, blanched
- 1 fried egg (optional)
- 1 Tbsp toasted sesame seeds
- Gochujang sauce, for extra heat

Instructions:
1. Mix gochujang, soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic, and ginger into a glaze; coat tofu cubes and marinate 15 min.
2. Thread tofu onto skewers and grill until glossy, about 6 min total.
3. Assemble a bowl with a base of warm rice, arranging spinach, carrots, bean sprouts, and the grilled tofu skewers.
4. Top with a fried egg if desired, drizzle additional gochujang sauce, and sprinkle sesame seeds before serving.
title: Gochujang Tofu Skewers over Bibimbap Bowl

text:
Nonce: c5f5ff87a4af6b8ac063d59d96e9d86d45462866
Gochujang Tofu Skewers with Coconut‑Lime Rice

Ingredients:
- 1 block firm tofu, cubed
- 2 Tbsp gochujang
- 1 Tbsp soy sauce
- 1 tsp lime zest
- 1 tsp toasted sesame oil
- 1 tsp minced garlic
- 6 bamboo skewers, soaked
- 1 cup jasmine rice
- 1 cup coconut milk
- ½ cup water
- 1 Tbsp lime juice
- 2 tsp chopped cilantro
- 1 tsp toasted coconut flakes

Instructions:
1. Whisk gochujang, soy sauce, lime zest, sesame oil, and garlic; marinate tofu cubes for 10 min.
2. Cook jasmine rice with coconut milk and water; once done, stir in lime juice and cilantro; keep warm.
3. Grill tofu skewers over medium heat, turning and basting with glaze until caramelized, about 7 min.
4. Serve the skewers atop coconut‑lime rice, garnish with toasted coconut flakes.
title: Gochujang Tofu Skewers with Coconut‑Lime Rice

text:
Nonce: 5fcc8a4f4b7379d460a4528615903129a5259591
Gochujang Tofu Skewer Lettuce Wraps

Ingredients:
- 1 block extra‑firm tofu, cubed
- 2 Tbsp gochujang
- 1 Tbsp soy sauce
- 1 tsp honey
- 1 tsp rice vinegar
- 1 tsp sesame oil
- 1 tsp minced garlic
- 8 bamboo skewers, soaked
- Butter lettuce leaves
- ¼ cup shredded carrots
- ¼ cup sliced cucumber
- 1 Tbsp chopped peanuts
- Lime wedges, for serving

Instructions:
1. Combine gochujang, soy sauce, honey, rice vinegar, sesame oil, and garlic; coat tofu cubes and let sit 10 min.
2. Thread tofu onto skewers and grill until glossy, about 6 min total.
3. Arrange lettuce leaves on a platter; place a grilled tofu skewer in each leaf.
4. Top with shredded carrots, cucumber slices, and chopped peanuts; squeeze lime over before eating.
title: Gochujang Tofu Skewer Lettuce Wraps

text:
Nonce: a0951c86eff147cbb6d60072d6cb0dd35eda101a
Gochujang Tofu Skewers with Pickled Cucumber & Carrot

Ingredients:
- 1 block firm tofu, cubed
- 2 Tbsp gochujang
- 1 Tbsp soy sauce
- 1 tsp brown sugar
- 1 tsp sesame oil
- 1 tsp minced garlic
- 6 bamboo skewers, soaked
- ½ cup thinly sliced cucumber
- ½ cup thinly sliced carrot
- 2 Tbsp rice vinegar
- 1 tsp sugar
- ½ tsp salt
- 1 tsp toasted sesame seeds

Instructions:
1. Whisk gochujang, soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, and garlic; marinate tofu cubes for 15 min.
2. Meanwhile, combine cucumber, carrot, rice vinegar, sugar, and salt; let pickle for at least 10 min.
3. Grill tofu skewers over medium heat, turning and basting with glaze until charred, about 7 min.
4. Serve the skewers alongside the quick pickles, sprinkling toasted sesame seeds over both.
title: Gochujang Tofu Skewers with Pickled Cucumber & Carrot

text:
Nonce: 021968cb16c288e5632b34e72cc4de924fd2643d
Gochujang Tofu Skewers in Spicy Ramen Soup

Ingredients:
- 1 block firm tofu, cubed
- 2 Tbsp gochujang
- 1 Tbsp soy sauce
- 1 tsp sesame oil
- 1 tsp minced garlic
- 6 bamboo skewers, soaked
- 4 cups vegetable broth
- 2 Tbsp miso paste
- 1 Tbsp chili oil
- 200 g ramen noodles
- ½ cup sliced shiitake mushrooms
- 2 tsp sliced green onions
- 1 tsp toasted sesame seeds

Instructions:
1. Mix gochujang, soy sauce, sesame oil, and garlic; coat tofu cubes and marinate 10 min.
2. Grill tofu skewers until glazed, about 6 min total.
3. In a pot bring vegetable broth to a simmer; whisk in miso paste and chili oil.
4. Add ramen noodles and shiitake mushrooms; cook until noodles are tender.
5. Transfer noodles and broth to bowls; place two grilled tofu skewers on top.
6. Garnish with green onions and toasted sesame seeds; serve hot.
title: Gochujang Tofu Skewers in Spicy Ramen Soup

text:
Nonce: 88280e23a6554f219eff38cb311f32d660e90774
Gochujang Tofu Skewers with Crispy Garlic Noodles

Ingredients:
- 1 block firm tofu, cubed
- 2 Tbsp gochujang
- 1 Tbsp soy sauce
- 1 tsp honey
- 1 tsp sesame oil
- 1 tsp minced garlic
- 6 bamboo skewers, soaked
- 200 g thin wheat noodles
- 2 Tbsp vegetable oil
- 3 cloves garlic, thinly sliced
- 1 Tbsp soy sauce
- 1 tsp chili flakes
- 1 tsp toasted sesame seeds
- 2 tsp chopped scallions

Instructions:
1. Combine gochujang, soy sauce, honey, sesame oil, and garlic; marinate tofu cubes for 12 min.
2. Grill tofu skewers, basting with extra glaze, until caramelized, about 7 min.
3. Cook noodles according to package; drain and set aside.
4. In a skillet heat vegetable oil; add sliced garlic and fry until golden and crisp; remove garlic and set aside.
5. Toss cooked noodles in the same skillet with soy sauce, chili flakes, and a splash of water; heat through.
6. Plate noodles, top with grilled tofu skewers, sprinkle crispy garlic, toasted sesame seeds, and scallions.
title: Gochujang Tofu Skewers with Crispy Garlic Noodles

text:
Nonce: d12b4a09b6d02cce66b3eaf51eceb8d8bbf402b5
Classic Doro Wat with Injera

Ingredients:
- 2 lb chicken thighs, bone‑in, skinless
- 2 large onions, finely chopped
- 4 garlic cloves, minced
- 2 tbsp berbere spice blend
- 1 tbsp niter kibbeh (spiced clarified butter)
- 2 tbsp tomato paste
- 2 hard‑boiled eggs, peeled
- 2 cups chicken broth
- Salt to taste
- 2 cups teff flour
- 3 cups water
- ½ tsp salt (for injera batter)

Instructions:
1. In a large pot, melt niter kibbeh over medium heat and sauté the onions until deep golden, about 15 minutes, stirring constantly.
2. Add garlic, berbere, and tomato paste; cook 2 minutes until fragrant.
3. Stir in the chicken pieces, coating them in the spice mixture; brown lightly for 5 minutes.
4. Pour in chicken broth, bring to a simmer, cover, and cook 35 minutes until the chicken is tender.
5. Add the hard‑boiled eggs, season with salt, and simmer uncovered for another 5 minutes.
6. For injera, whisk teff flour, water, and ½ tsp salt into a smooth batter; let ferment at room temperature for 24 hours.
7. Heat a non‑stick skillet over medium heat, pour a thin layer of batter, swirl to cover the surface, and cook until holes form and the surface is set (≈2 minutes); do not flip.
8. Serve the steaming hot doro wat on a large platter with fresh injera sheets for tearing and scooping.
title: Classic Doro Wat with Injera

text:
Nonce: b90ce0fb329c6b7c8049fe8800fef0d72b4a48da
Kik Alicha (Mild Split‑Pea Stew) with Injera

Ingredients:
- 1 cup dried split peas, rinsed
- 1 large onion, diced
- 2 carrots, sliced
- 2 tbsp niter kibbeh
- 1 tsp turmeric powder
- 1 tsp cumin seeds
- 4 cups vegetable broth
- Salt and pepper to taste
- 2 cups teff flour
- 3 cups water
- ½ tsp salt (for injera batter)

Instructions:
1. In a pot, melt niter kibbeh and toast cumin seeds until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
2. Add onion and sauté until translucent, then stir in turmeric.
3. Add split peas, carrots, and vegetable broth; bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer 45 minutes until peas are soft.
4. Season with salt and pepper; blend lightly for a creamy texture if desired.
5. Prepare injera batter as in recipe 910, allowing 24‑hour fermentation.
6. Cook injera sheets on a hot skillet, one at a time, until surface is set and bubbles appear.
7. Serve the mild kik alicha alongside warm injera for a comforting vegetarian meal.
title: Kik Alicha (Mild Split‑Pea Stew) with Injera

text:
Nonce: d45b0f47a887383077135180576f77c17a028115
Spicy Beef Tibs with Injera

Ingredients:
- 1 lb beef sirloin, cut into ½‑inch strips
- 1 large onion, sliced
- 2 tbsp berbere spice
- 2 tbsp niter kibbeh
- 1 red bell pepper, sliced
- 2 garlic cloves, minced
- 1 tbsp ginger, minced
- ¼ cup beef broth
- Salt to taste
- 2 cups teff flour
- 3 cups water
- ½ tsp salt (for injera batter)

Instructions:
1. Heat niter kibbeh in a wok over high heat; add onion and stir‑fry until slightly caramelized, about 3 minutes.
2. Add garlic, ginger, and berbere; cook 1 minute.
3. Toss in beef strips, searing quickly until browned on all sides, about 4 minutes.
4. Add red bell pepper and beef broth; stir and cook 2 minutes until the sauce coats the meat.
5. Season with salt; remove from heat.
6. Prepare injera batter as described previously, fermenting 24 hours.
7. Cook thin injera sheets on a hot skillet; keep warm.
8. Serve the sizzling beef tibs on a platter with injera for scooping.
title: Spicy Beef Tibs with Injera

text:
Nonce: cd345997ae2fa67aff2da6d859811a686d316e2f
Lamb Kitfo with Injera (Lightly Cooked)

Ingredients:
- 1 lb ground lamb, very fresh
- 2 tbsp niter kibbeh, melted
- 1 tbsp mitmita (hot chili blend)
- 1 tsp cardamom powder
- 1 small garlic clove, minced
- Salt to taste
- 2 cups teff flour
- 3 cups water
- ½ tsp salt (for injera batter)

Instructions:
1. In a chilled bowl, combine ground lamb with melted niter kibbeh, mitmita, cardamom, garlic, and salt; mix gently to keep texture fine.
2. For a “rare‑cooked” version, briefly sear the mixture in a hot pan for 30 seconds, just to warm the surface.
3. Prepare injera batter, allowing 24‑hour fermentation.
4. Cook injera sheets on a hot non‑stick pan until bubbles form; keep covered to stay soft.
5. Serve the seasoned lamb kitfo alongside injera, allowing diners to shape small bites with the flatbread.
title: Lamb Kitfo with Injera (Lightly Cooked)

text:
Nonce: e82df35bfe2ec8643c57ef0f200d272a0bcd56eb
Fish Alicha (Mild Turmeric Fish Stew) with Injera

Ingredients:
- 1 lb white fish fillets (e.g., tilapia), cut into chunks
- 1 large onion, diced
- 2 tbsp niter kibbeh
- 2 tsp turmeric powder
- 1 tsp fenugreek seeds
- 2 garlic cloves, minced
- 2 cups fish stock or water
- Juice of 1 lemon
- Salt to taste
- 2 cups teff flour
- 3 cups water
- ½ tsp salt (for injera batter)

Instructions:
1. Melt niter kibbeh in a pot; toast fenugreek seeds until fragrant, about 20 seconds.
2. Add onion and sauté until soft; stir in garlic and turmeric, cooking 1 minute.
3. Pour fish stock, bring to a gentle simmer, then add fish pieces.
4. Cook 8‑10 minutes until fish is opaque; season with lemon juice and salt.
5. Prepare injera batter, fermenting for 24 hours.
6. Cook thin injera sheets on a hot skillet; keep warm.
7. Serve the delicate fish alicha with fresh injera for a soothing meal.
title: Fish Alicha (Mild Turmeric Fish Stew) with Injera

text:
Nonce: f2cfd3134b9736480600905b0bb77f1eaacd217d
Mushroom & Spinach Wat (Ayib Style) with Injera

Ingredients:
- 2 cups mixed mushrooms, sliced
- 3 cups fresh spinach, roughly chopped
- 1 large onion, diced
- 2 tbsp niter kibbeh
- 1 tbsp berbere
- 1 tbsp tomato paste
- ½ cup crumbled ayib (Ethiopian cheese) or feta
- 1 cup vegetable broth
- Salt to taste
- 2 cups teff flour
- 3 cups water
- ½ tsp salt (for injera batter)

Instructions:
1. Heat niter kibbeh in a saucepan; sauté onion until golden.
2. Add berbere and tomato paste; stir for 2 minutes.
3. Toss in mushrooms; cook until they release moisture, about 5 minutes.
4. Add spinach and vegetable broth; simmer until spinach wilts, 3 minutes.
5. Stir in crumbled ayib, season with salt, and remove from heat.
6. Prepare injera batter, allowing 24‑hour fermentation.
7. Cook injera sheets on a hot pan; keep covered.
8. Serve the earthy mushroom‑spinach wat with injera for scooping.
title: Mushroom & Spinach Wat (Ayib Style) with Injera

text:
Nonce: 5afc4f9b83fbc7f46424a2ea40d61caeddb7eda9
Sweet Potato & Red Lentil Stew with Injera

Ingredients:
- 1 large sweet potato, peeled and cubed
- 1 cup red lentils, rinsed
- 1 large onion, chopped
- 2 tbsp niter kibbeh
- 1 tsp cumin powder
- 1 tsp coriander powder
- 1 tbsp berbere (optional for heat)
- 4 cups vegetable broth
- Salt to taste
- 2 cups teff flour
- 3 cups water
- ½ tsp salt (for injera batter)

Instructions:
1. In a pot, melt niter kibbeh; sauté onion until translucent.
2. Add cumin, coriander, and berbere; stir 1 minute.
3. Add sweet potato cubes, red lentils, and vegetable broth; bring to a boil.
4. Reduce heat and simmer 25 minutes, or until lentils and sweet potato are soft.
5. Season with salt; blend partially for a slightly creamy texture if desired.
6. Prepare injera batter, fermenting for 24 hours.
7. Cook thin injera sheets on a hot skillet; keep warm.
8. Serve the hearty sweet potato‑lentil stew with injera for a nutritious vegetarian feast.
title: Sweet Potato & Red Lentil Stew with Injera

text:
Nonce: 7eb34a959bd88fe98815eb9bedb4c2a2c8f434b5
Injera Pizza with Berbere Tomato Sauce

Ingredients:
- 2 cups teff flour
- 3 cups water
- ½ tsp salt (for injera batter)
- 1 cup tomato sauce
- 2 tbsp berbere spice
- 1 tbsp niter kibbeh
- 1 cup shredded mozzarella or Ethiopian ayib
- ½ cup sliced red onion
- ½ cup sliced green bell pepper
- Fresh cilantro for garnish
- Salt to taste

Instructions:
1. Prepare injera batter as in previous recipes; let ferment 24 hours.
2. Cook a large injera sheet on a hot non‑stick pan; set aside.
3. In a small saucepan, melt niter kibbeh; stir in berbere and tomato sauce; simmer 5 minutes; season with salt.
4. Spread the spicy tomato sauce evenly over the cooked injera base.
5. Sprinkle shredded cheese, red onion, and green bell pepper on top.
6. Cover the pan with a lid and cook on low heat until cheese melts, about 3 minutes.
7. Garnish with fresh cilantro and slice like a pizza.
8. Serve hot, using extra injera pieces to mop up any remaining sauce.
title: Injera Pizza with Berbere Tomato Sauce

text:
Nonce: 7d6c1df90b0ab7837706e87307a5a1d3b890fefb
Breakfast Injera Roll with Scrambled Eggs & Niter Kibbeh

Ingredients:
- 2 cups teff flour
- 3 cups water
- ½ tsp salt (for injera batter)
- 4 large eggs
- 2 tbsp niter kibbeh
- 1 small tomato, diced
- 1 green chili, finely chopped (optional)
- Salt and pepper to taste
- Fresh parsley, chopped

Instructions:
1. Make injera batter, ferment for 24 hours, then cook thin sheets; keep warm.
2. In a skillet, melt 1 tbsp niter kibbeh over medium heat; add diced tomato and green chili; sauté 2 minutes.
3. Beat eggs with salt and pepper; pour into the skillet and scramble gently, cooking until just set.
4. Warm the remaining 1 tbsp niter kibbeh and brush lightly over each injera sheet.
5. Place a generous spoonful of scrambled eggs onto the center of an injera sheet, sprinkle with parsley, and roll tightly.
6. Serve the rolls warm, accompanied by extra injera for dipping.
title: Breakfast Injera Roll with Scrambled Eggs & Niter Kibbeh

text:
Nonce: 0fd54d89e483d8cb1a40e0a29c59161d7c08ab8d
Honey‑Butter Teff Pancake (Injera‑Style Dessert) with Cardamom

Ingredients:
- 1 cup teff flour
- 1 cup milk (or plant‑based alternative)
- 1 egg
- 2 tbsp melted butter
- 2 tbsp honey
- ¼ tsp ground cardamom
- Pinch of salt
- Additional butter for cooking
- Fresh berries for garnish (optional)

Instructions:
1. In a bowl, whisk together teff flour, milk, egg, melted butter, cardamom, and salt until smooth; let rest 10 minutes.
2. Heat a small amount of butter in a non‑stick skillet over medium heat.
3. Pour a ladleful of batter, spreading thinly to form a crepe‑like pancake; cook 1‑2 minutes until edges lift, then flip and cook another minute.
4. Drizzle honey and a dab of butter over the hot pancake; fold or roll.
5. Serve warm, topped with extra honey, a sprinkle of cardamom, and fresh berries if desired.
title: Honey‑Butter Teff Pancake (Injera‑Style Dessert) with Cardamom

cuisine_title: **Title:** Mexican Churros with Chocolate Dipping Sauce
text:
Nonce: b428827a2edf2700a08fc89f69781fbd4c271177
Chocolate Chili Churros

Ingredients:
- 1 cup all‑purpose flour
- 1 cup water
- 2 tbsp unsalted butter
- 1 tbsp sugar
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp ground cinnamon
- 1/2 cup granulated sugar (for coating)
- 1 tsp ground cayenne pepper
- 1 cup dark chocolate chips
- 2 tbsp heavy cream
- 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions:
1. In a saucepan combine water, butter, sugar, and salt; bring to a boil, then remove from heat and stir in flour until a smooth dough forms.
2. Let the dough cool for 2 minutes, then beat in the egg until fully incorporated.
3. Transfer the dough to a piping bag fitted with a large star tip; pipe 4‑inch strips into hot oil (350 °F) and fry until golden, about 2‑3 minutes.
4. Mix granulated sugar, cinnamon, and cayenne pepper in a shallow bowl; roll the hot churros in the mixture to coat.
5. For the sauce, melt chocolate chips with heavy cream over a double boiler, stir in vanilla, and keep warm.
6. Serve the spicy churros with the thick dark chocolate dipping sauce.
title: Chocolate Chili Churros

cuisine_title: **Title:** Mexican Churros with Chocolate Dipping Sauce
text:
Nonce: cbb316cc5ec588c4a7443bf72c5b1839e16f0214
Coconut‑Lime Churros with White Chocolate Drizzle

Ingredients:
- 1 cup rice flour
- 1 cup coconut milk
- 2 tbsp coconut oil
- 1 tbsp honey
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 1 large egg
- 1/2 cup shredded coconut (toasted)
- 1/3 cup powdered sugar
- Zest of 1 lime
- 1 cup white chocolate chips
- 1 tbsp lime juice

Instructions:
1. Heat coconut milk, coconut oil, honey, and salt; once simmering, whisk in rice flour until a thick dough forms.
2. Cool slightly, then stir in the egg until smooth.
3. Pipe the dough into hot oil and fry until crisp, about 2 minutes; drain on paper towels.
4. Toss the churros in toasted shredded coconut mixed with lime zest and powdered sugar.
5. Melt white chocolate chips with lime juice, stirring until glossy.
6. Drizzle the lime‑infused white chocolate over the churros and serve.
title: Coconut‑Lime Churros with White Chocolate Drizzle

cuisine_title: **Title:** Mexican Churros with Chocolate Dipping Sauce
text:
Nonce: 79ad95931520cf8b7e51783ca35edc342beeb2bf
Savory Cheese‑And‑Chorizo Churros with Salsa Verde

Ingredients:
- 1 cup masa harina
- 1 cup water
- 2 tbsp vegetable oil
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1 large egg
- 1/2 cup crumbled queso fresco
- 1/4 cup finely diced chorizo, cooked
- 1 tsp smoked paprika
- 1 cup tomatillo salsa verde (store‑bought or homemade)

Instructions:
1. Bring water, oil, and salt to a boil; stir in masa harina until a smooth dough forms, then remove from heat.
2. Cool for 2 minutes, then incorporate the egg, queso fresco, cooked chorizo, and smoked paprika.
3. Pipe the savory dough into hot oil, frying until golden brown, about 3 minutes.
4. Drain and serve immediately with a side of salsa verde for dipping.
title: Savory Cheese‑And‑Chorizo Churros with Salsa Verde

cuisine_title: **Title:** Mexican Churros with Chocolate Dipping Sauce
text:
Nonce: f442273f921bcd874540854464fa6e27d81b392b
Matcha‑Infused Churros with Black Sesame Chocolate Sauce

Ingredients:
- 1 cup all‑purpose flour
- 1 cup milk
- 2 tbsp butter
- 1 tbsp matcha powder
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 1 large egg
- 1/2 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tsp ground cinnamon
- 1/4 cup black sesame seeds, toasted
- 1 cup dark chocolate chips
- 2 tbsp black sesame paste (tahini‑style)
- 2 tbsp cream

Instructions:
1. Melt butter in milk, add matcha powder and salt; bring to a simmer then whisk in flour until a dough forms.
2. Cool slightly, beat in the egg until smooth.
3. Pipe into hot oil, frying until the churros are crisp and green‑tinged, about 2‑3 minutes.
4. Combine sugar and cinnamon; roll the churros in the mixture, then toss with toasted black sesame seeds.
5. For the sauce, melt dark chocolate with cream, stir in black sesame paste until glossy.
6. Serve the matcha churros with the black sesame chocolate dipping sauce.
title: Matcha‑Infused Churros with Black Sesame Chocolate Sauce

cuisine_title: **Title:** Mexican Churros with Chocolate Dipping Sauce
text:
Nonce: 5fddf61426afd48bf757120be526534d1891ca25
Baked Sweet‑Potato Churros with Caramel‑Pepper Sauce

Ingredients:
- 1 cup mashed sweet potatoes (cooled)
- 1 cup all‑purpose flour
- 1/4 cup brown sugar
- 1 tsp baking powder
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp ground cinnamon
- 1/2 tsp ground black pepper
- 2 tbsp olive oil (for brushing)
- 1 cup caramel sauce
- 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 425 °F and line a baking sheet with parchment.
2. In a bowl combine mashed sweet potatoes, flour, brown sugar, baking powder, salt, egg, cinnamon, and black pepper; mix to a thick dough.
3. Transfer to a piping bag and pipe 4‑inch sticks onto the sheet; brush lightly with olive oil.
4. Bake for 12‑15 minutes, turning halfway, until golden and firm.
5. Warm caramel sauce and stir in cayenne pepper.
6. Serve the baked sweet‑potato churros with the spicy caramel dipping sauce.
title: Baked Sweet‑Potato Churros with Caramel‑Pepper Sauce

cuisine_title: **Title:** Mexican Churros with Chocolate Dipping Sauce
text:
Nonce: 1a4fa90efe432d42eec47c86e6fc6e4fce65edc6
Coffee‑Espresso Churros with Mocha Ganache

Ingredients:
- 1 cup all‑purpose flour
- 1 cup strong brewed espresso
- 2 tbsp butter
- 1 tbsp sugar
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 1 large egg
- 1/2 cup powdered sugar
- 1 tsp ground cinnamon
- 1 cup semi‑sweet chocolate chips
- 2 tbsp espresso
- 1 tbsp butter (for ganache)

Instructions:
1. Heat espresso, butter, sugar, and salt; bring to a boil then whisk in flour until a dough forms.
2. Cool for a couple minutes, then beat in the egg.
3. Pipe the dough into hot oil, frying until deep golden, about 2‑3 minutes.
4. Toss churros in powdered sugar mixed with cinnamon.
5. For the ganache, melt chocolate chips with butter and espresso over low heat, stirring until smooth.
6. Dip or drizzle the churros with the mocha ganache and serve.
title: Coffee‑Espresso Churros with Mocha Ganache

cuisine_title: **Title:** Mexican Churros with Chocolate Dipping Sauce
text:
Nonce: ccf9997807618597df2c58430bf4824af47192d8
Blueberry‑Lavender Churros with White Chocolate Raspberry Sauce

Ingredients:
- 1 cup all‑purpose flour
- 1 cup milk
- 2 tbsp butter
- 1 tbsp sugar
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 1 large egg
- 1/2 cup dried lavender buds
- 1/2 cup freeze‑dried blueberries, crushed
- 1/2 cup powdered sugar
- 1 tsp ground cinnamon
- 1 cup white chocolate chips
- 2 tbsp raspberry puree

Instructions:
1. Infuse milk with lavender buds by heating gently; strain and return to saucepan with butter, sugar, and salt; bring to a simmer.
2. Whisk in flour until a smooth dough forms; let cool slightly, then incorporate the egg.
3. Pipe into hot oil, frying until light golden, about 2 minutes.
4. Mix powdered sugar, cinnamon, and crushed freeze‑dried blueberries; roll churros in the mixture.
5. Melt white chocolate chips with raspberry puree to create a pink‑tinged sauce.
6. Serve the lavender‑blueberry churros with the white chocolate raspberry dipping sauce.
title: Blueberry‑Lavender Churros with White Chocolate Raspberry Sauce

cuisine_title: **Title:** Mexican Churros with Chocolate Dipping Sauce
text:
Nonce: 38c21b5e2ea0c025b73ca0008e604489535b5c81
Pistachio‑Rose Churros with Dark Chocolate Rose Ganache

Ingredients:
- 1 cup all‑purpose flour
- 1 cup water
- 2 tbsp butter
- 1 tbsp sugar
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 1 large egg
- 1/2 cup finely chopped pistachios
- 1 tsp rose water
- 1/2 cup powdered sugar
- 1 tsp ground cinnamon
- 1 cup dark chocolate chips
- 2 tbsp cream
- 1 tsp rose water (for ganache)

Instructions:
1. Bring water, butter, sugar, and salt to a boil; stir in flour until a dough forms, then remove from heat.
2. Cool briefly, then beat in the egg and rose water.
3. Pipe the dough into hot oil, frying until golden, about 2‑3 minutes.
4. Toss churros in powdered sugar mixed with cinnamon and chopped pistachios.
5. For the ganache, melt dark chocolate with cream and a splash of rose water until smooth.
6. Dip or drizzle the pistachio‑rose churros with the dark chocolate rose ganache and serve.
title: Pistachio‑Rose Churros with Dark Chocolate Rose Ganache

cuisine_title: **Title:** Mexican Churros with Chocolate Dipping Sauce
text:
Nonce: 0602c7ff810bde92d62a11048db6567587e70ac3
Spicy Mango‑Habanero Churros with Coconut Chocolate Sauce

Ingredients:
- 1 cup all‑purpose flour
- 1 cup coconut milk
- 2 tbsp coconut oil
- 1 tbsp sugar
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 1 large egg
- 1/2 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tsp ground cinnamon
- 1 tsp finely diced habanero pepper (adjust to heat)
- 1 cup diced fresh mango
- 1 cup dark chocolate chips
- 2 tbsp coconut cream
- 1 tsp lime zest

Instructions:
1. Heat coconut milk, coconut oil, sugar, and salt; bring to a simmer then whisk in flour until a dough forms.
2. Cool slightly, then stir in the egg.
3. Pipe the dough into hot oil, frying until crisp and golden, about 2‑3 minutes.
4. Combine granulated sugar, cinnamon, and habanero; roll hot churros in the mixture.
5. Toss the churros with fresh mango pieces.
6. Melt dark chocolate with coconut cream and lime zest to create a silky sauce.
7. Serve the spicy mango churros with the coconut chocolate dipping sauce.
title: Spicy Mango‑Habanero Churros with Coconut Chocolate Sauce

cuisine_title: **Title:** Mexican Churros with Chocolate Dipping Sauce
text:
Nonce: 5f57d89b77948845cc209bfa1fc6d4a9a862a8ac
Gluten‑Free Almond‑Orange Churros with Blood Orange Chocolate Dip

Ingredients:
- 1 cup almond flour
- 1/4 cup tapioca starch
- 1 cup orange juice
- 2 tbsp butter
- 1 tbsp honey
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 1 large egg
- 1/2 cup powdered sugar
- 1 tsp orange zest
- 1 tsp ground cinnamon
- 1 cup dark chocolate chips
- 2 tbsp blood orange marmalade
- 1 tbsp cream

Instructions:
1. In a saucepan combine orange juice, butter, honey, and salt; bring to a boil.
2. Whisk in almond flour and tapioca starch until a smooth dough forms; remove from heat.
3. Cool for a couple minutes, then beat in the egg.
4. Pipe the gluten‑free dough into hot oil, frying until golden, about 3 minutes.
5. Mix powdered sugar, orange zest, and cinnamon; roll churros in the mixture.
6. For the dip, melt dark chocolate with cream, then stir in blood orange marmalade until smooth.
7. Serve the almond‑orange churros with the blood orange chocolate dipping sauce.
title: Gluten‑Free Almond‑Orange Churros with Blood Orange Chocolate Dip

cuisine_title: **Title:** Indian Masala Dosa with Coconut Chutney
text:
Nonce: 195bb6496a41730528297c309538fe6ff399ccae
Classic Masala Dosa with Coconut Chutney

Ingredients:
- 1 cup rice
- 1/3 cup urad dal (split black gram)
- 1/2 tsp fenugreek seeds
- 2 large potatoes, boiled and mashed
- 1 onion, finely sliced
- 1 green chili, chopped
- 1 tsp mustard seeds
- 1 tsp turmeric powder
- 1 tsp curry leaves
- 2 tbsp oil
- Salt to taste
- 1 cup grated fresh coconut
- 2 tbsp roasted chana dal
- 1 green chili
- 1/2 tsp cumin seeds
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup water

Instructions:
1. Soak rice, urad dal, and fenugreek seeds together for 6 hours; grind to a smooth batter and ferment overnight.
2. Heat a non‑stick pan, pour a ladle of batter, spread thin, and drizzle a few drops of oil; cook until crisp and golden on both sides.
3. For the masala, heat oil, add mustard seeds, curry leaves, and sliced onions; sauté until translucent.
4. Add turmeric, green chili, and mashed potatoes; mix well, season with salt, and cook 2 minutes.
5. Place a spoonful of potato masala on the dosa, fold, and serve hot.
6. To make coconut chutney, blend coconut, roasted chana dal, green chili, cumin, salt, and water to a smooth paste.
7. Serve the dosa with the fresh coconut chutney.
title: Classic Masala Dosa with Coconut Chutney

cuisine_title: **Title:** Indian Masala Dosa with Coconut Chutney

- 1 tsp lemon juice
- 1/2 tsp salt

4. Heat a skillet, pour spinach‑infused batter, spread thin, and cook until crisp.
5. Spoon paneer filling onto the dosa, fold, and keep warm.
6. For mint coconut chutney, blend coconut, mint leaves, green chili, lemon juice, salt, and water until smooth.
7. Serve the spinach‑paneer dosa with mint coconut chutney.

Banana Sweet Dosa with Coconut‑Date Chutney

Ingredients:
- 1 cup rice
- 1/3 cup urad dal

- Pinch of salt

- 5 dates, pitted

- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/4 cup water

3. Heat a lightly oiled pan, pour batter, spread thin, and cook until golden brown on both sides.
4. For the chutney, blend coconut, dates, roasted peanuts, salt, and water into a smooth dip.

Quinoa‑Lentil Dosa with Coconut‑Peanut Chutney

- 1/2 cup urad dal

- 1 tsp ginger paste
- Salt to taste
- 1 cup coconut, grated
- 2 tbsp roasted peanuts
- 1 green chili
- 1 tsp tamarind paste
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/3 cup water

Instructions:

3. Blend coconut, roasted peanuts, green chili, tamarind paste, salt, and water to a creamy chutney.
4. Serve the protein‑rich quinoa‑lentil dosa with coconut‑peanut chutney.

Mushroom & Pepper Dosa with Coconut‑Tomato Chutney

6. Serve the mushroom dosa with coconut‑tomato chutney.

Egg Masala Dosa with Coconut‑Green Chili Chutney

- 1/2 tsp turmeric powder
- 1 tsp oil
- Salt to taste

- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/4 cup water

1. Prepare and ferment the dosa batter as usual.
2. Beat eggs with onion, green chili, turmeric, salt, and oil.
3. Heat a pan, pour a thin layer of batter, cook until set, then pour the egg mixture over the top; cook until eggs are firm.

5. Blend coconut, green chilies, lime zest, salt, and water for a spicy chutney.

Mini Dosa Bites with Coconut‑Avocado Chutney

text:
Nonce: a33edb82d5958a69d3fcae4395b5435428c8ed20
Classic Pistachio Baklava with Rose‑Scented Syrup

Ingredients:
- 1 package phyllo dough, thawed
- 1 cup unsalted butter, melted
- 2 cups pistachios, finely chopped
- 1 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tsp ground cinnamon
- 1 cup water
- 1 cup honey
- 2 tbsp rose water
- 1 tbsp lemon juice
- Pinch of salt

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Brush a 9×13‑inch baking dish with melted butter.
2. Mix chopped pistachios, sugar, and cinnamon in a bowl.
3. Lay one sheet of phyllo in the dish, brush with butter; repeat for 5 sheets.
4. Sprinkle half of the pistachio mixture evenly over the layers.
5. Add another 5 sheets of phyllo, brushing each with butter.
6. Spread the remaining pistachio mixture, then top with the final 5 sheets of phyllo, buttering each sheet.
7. Cut the assembled baklava into diamond shapes before baking.
8. Bake for 45‑50 minutes, until golden brown.
9. Meanwhile, combine water, honey, lemon juice, and salt in a saucepan; bring to a boil, then simmer 10 minutes.
10. Remove from heat, stir in rose water, and let cool slightly.
11. Pour the warm rose‑scented syrup over the hot baklava, allowing it to soak for 30 minutes before serving.
title: Classic Pistachio Baklava with Rose‑Scented Syrup

text:
Nonce: 697e977672d8fa7e7bcec28e1e6d9e2eff0afe6b
Chocolate‑Infused Turkish Delight Baklava

Ingredients:
- 1 package phyllo dough, thawed
- 1 cup dark butter, melted
- 1 ½ cups pistachios, coarsely chopped
- ½ cup cocoa nibs
- 1 cup powdered sugar
- ¼ tsp ground cardamom
- 1 cup water
- ½ cup dark chocolate syrup
- ¼ cup honey
- 1 tbsp orange blossom water
- Pinch of sea salt

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 340°F (170°C) and butter a 9×13‑inch pan.
2. Combine pistachios, cocoa nibs, powdered sugar, and cardamom in a bowl.
3. Layer 4 sheets of phyllo, brushing each with melted dark butter.
4. Spread half of the nut‑chocolate mixture over the phyllo.
5. Add another 4 sheets, buttering each, then the remaining mixture.
6. Finish with 4 more buttered phyllo sheets.
7. Cut the baklava into squares and bake 40‑45 minutes until crisp.
8. In a saucepan, mix water, honey, and sea salt; bring to a boil, then simmer 8 minutes.
9. Remove from heat, stir in chocolate syrup and orange blossom water.
10. Drizzle the chocolate‑orange syrup over the hot baklava, letting it absorb for 20 minutes before serving.
title: Chocolate‑Infused Turkish Delight Baklava

text:
Nonce: 79ba1f98069b74cd1fd3cf016401e3b58132fa7b
Citrus‑Zest Pistachio Baklava

Ingredients:
- 1 package phyllo dough, thawed
- 1 cup clarified butter
- 2 cups pistachios, finely ground
- ½ cup granulated sugar
- Zest of 1 lemon
- Zest of 1 orange
- 1 cup water
- ¾ cup honey
- 2 tbsp lemon juice
- 1 tbsp rose water
- Pinch of ground cloves

Instructions:
1. Heat oven to 355°F (180°C); butter a 9×13‑inch tray with clarified butter.
2. Mix pistachios, sugar, lemon zest, orange zest, and cloves in a bowl.
3. Place 3 sheets of phyllo, brushing each with butter.
4. Evenly distribute half of the pistachio mixture.
5. Add 3 more buttered phyllo sheets, then the remaining mixture.
6. Top with 3 final buttered sheets.
7. Score the baklava into rectangles and bake 35‑40 minutes until golden.
8. Meanwhile, combine water, honey, and lemon juice; boil, then simmer 7 minutes.
9. Remove from heat, stir in rose water.
10. Pour the citrus‑infused syrup over the baked baklava, allowing it to soak for 25 minutes before serving.
title: Citrus‑Zest Pistachio Baklava

text:
Nonce: bbb5f31de53c9683b009774a98825c1a82bf58cd
Baklava Rolls with Pistachio Cream Filling

Ingredients:
- 1 package phyllo dough, thawed
- 1 cup melted ghee
- 1 cup pistachios, toasted and finely chopped
- ½ cup cream cheese, softened
- ¼ cup powdered sugar
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1 cup water
- ½ cup honey
- 1 tbsp rose water
- Pinch of salt

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment.
2. In a bowl, blend cream cheese, powdered sugar, vanilla, and toasted pistachios to form a thick filling.
3. Lay one sheet of phyllo on a clean surface, brush with melted ghee; repeat for 2 more sheets.
4. Spread a thin layer of pistachio cream across the phyllo.
5. Roll the phyllo tightly into a log; cut the log into 1‑inch pieces.
6. Place each roll seam‑side down on the prepared sheet, brush tops with ghee.
7. Bake 20‑25 minutes until crisp and golden.
8. While baking, combine water, honey, and salt in a saucepan; bring to a boil, then simmer 5 minutes.
9. Remove from heat, stir in rose water.
10. Drizzle the rose‑scented syrup over the warm rolls, let absorb for 10 minutes before serving.
title: Baklava Rolls with Pistachio Cream Filling

text:
Nonce: 898fd5d13bb2d6a79826f261c081431bb267a396
Mini Pistachio Baklava Cups

Ingredients:
- 1 package phyllo dough, thawed
- ½ cup melted butter
- 1 cup pistachios, finely chopped
- ¼ cup brown sugar
- ½ tsp ground cinnamon
- ½ cup water

- 1 tbsp rose water
- 1 tsp lemon zest
- Pinch of salt

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Lightly butter a muffin tin.
2. Cut phyllo sheets into 4‑inch squares; brush each with melted butter.
3. Press two squares into each muffin cup, forming a base and sides.
4. Mix pistachios, brown sugar, cinnamon, and lemon zest; spoon a tablespoon into each cup.
5. Top with another buttered phyllo square, sealing the edges.
6. Bake 15‑18 minutes until the cups are crisp and lightly browned.
7. Meanwhile, simmer water, honey, and salt for 5 minutes; remove from heat and stir in rose water.
8. Spoon the warm syrup over each baklava cup, allowing it to soak for 5 minutes before removing from the tin and serving.

text:

Savory Pistachio Baklava with Feta and Rose‑Honey Glaze

Ingredients:
- 1 package phyllo dough, thawed
- ¾ cup olive oil, warmed
- 1 cup pistachios, coarsely chopped
- ½ cup crumbled feta cheese
- 1 tsp dried oregano
- ½ tsp black pepper
- 1 cup water
- ½ cup honey
- 1 tbsp rose water
- 1 tsp balsamic vinegar
- Pinch of sea salt

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 340°F (170°C). Brush a 9×13‑inch pan with olive oil.
2. Combine pistachios, feta, oregano, black pepper, and a pinch of sea salt.
3. Layer 3 sheets of phyllo, brushing each with olive oil.
4. Sprinkle half of the savory mixture over the phyllo.
5. Add 3 more oiled sheets, then the remaining mixture.
6. Finish with 3 final oiled sheets.
7. Cut into diamond shapes and bake 30‑35 minutes until golden.
8. In a saucepan, bring water, honey, and balsamic vinegar to a boil; simmer 5 minutes.

text:
Nonce: abf7e3e40827d60e0ff36651377bd1ba8325b174
Pistachio Baklava Parfait with Rose Gelée

Ingredients:
- 1 package phyllo dough, thawed
- ½ cup clarified butter
- 1 cup pistachios, toasted and chopped
- ¼ cup powdered sugar
- 1 tsp ground cardamom
- 1 cup water
- ½ cup honey
- 2 tbsp rose water
- 1 tbsp agar‑agar powder
- ½ cup Greek yogurt, plain
- Fresh pistachio shards for garnish

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Butter a small 8‑inch square pan.
2. Mix pistachios, powdered sugar, and cardamom.
3. Layer 2 sheets of phyllo, brushing each with clarified butter; spread half the pistachio mixture.
4. Add 2 more buttered sheets, then the remaining pistachio mixture, finishing with 2 final sheets.
5. Score into 4 squares and bake 25‑30 minutes until crisp.
6. While baking, combine water, honey, and rose water in a saucepan; bring to a boil.
7. Dissolve agar‑agar in a small bowl with ¼ cup cold water, then stir into the hot syrup; simmer 2 minutes.
8. Pour the rose gelée into a shallow dish and chill until set, about 1 hour.
9. Once baklava cools, crumble into bite‑size pieces.
10. In serving glasses, layer crumbled baklava, a spoonful of Greek yogurt, and cubes of rose gelée; repeat layers.
11. Top with fresh pistachio shards and serve chilled.
title: Pistachio Baklava Parfait with Rose Gelée

text:
Nonce: e1b85b3faa446dc446926417b2ed693cc6538c0d

text:
Nonce: c1567b664206983e2077a123349f321115761d55
Classic Tempura Trio

Ingredients:
- 8 large shrimp, peeled and deveined
- 1 medium sweet potato, peeled and cut into ½‑inch sticks
- 10 shiso leaves, washed and patted dry
- 1 cup all‑purpose flour
- 1 egg, lightly beaten
- ¾ cup ice‑cold sparkling water
- ½ tsp salt
- Vegetable oil, for deep‑frying
- Tentsuyu dipping sauce (store‑bought or homemade)

Instructions:
1. Heat vegetable oil in a deep pot to 180 °C (350 °F).
2. In a bowl, whisk together flour, salt, egg, and ice‑cold sparkling water; the batter should be lumpy.
3. Pat shrimp dry, dust lightly with flour, then dip into batter and fry for 2‑3 minutes until golden; remove and drain on paper towels.
4. Repeat the same process for sweet‑potato sticks, frying them in batches for 3‑4 minutes until crisp.
5. Quickly dip shiso leaves in batter (they need only a light coating) and fry for 10‑15 seconds; they should stay bright green.
6. Serve all three tempura pieces together with a small bowl of tentsuyu for dipping.
title: Classic Tempura Trio

text:
Nonce: 955310ab681f1ca982b4f88e08dea5e8a0dd7b5b
Spicy Chili Tempura Shrimp & Shiso

Ingredients:
- 6 large shrimp, tails on
- 8 shiso leaves
- ½ cup rice flour
- ¼ cup cornstarch
- 1 egg white
- ½ cup ice‑cold soda water
- 1 tsp chili oil
- ½ tsp smoked paprika
- Salt to taste
- Vegetable oil for frying
- Dipping sauce: 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp rice vinegar, ½ tsp sesame oil, ½ tsp chili flakes

Instructions:
1. Combine rice flour, cornstarch, smoked paprika, and a pinch of salt in a bowl.
2. Add egg white and drizzle in soda water while stirring to create a thin, airy batter; stir in chili oil.
3. Heat oil to 190 °C (375 °F). Lightly coat shrimp and shiso leaves with a dusting of flour, then dip into the batter.
4. Fry shrimp for 2‑3 minutes and shiso leaves for 8‑10 seconds until the batter is crisp and the shrimp turn pink.
5. Drain on a wire rack, then serve with the prepared spicy dipping sauce.
title: Spicy Chili Tempura Shrimp & Shiso

text:
Nonce: 47222bfaa8f5491ac2efc285c6b07d7203e5a634
Miso‑Glazed Sweet Potato Tempura

Ingredients:
- 2 medium sweet potatoes, cut into ½‑inch rounds
- ¾ cup all‑purpose flour
- ¼ cup cornstarch
- 1 egg
- ¾ cup ice‑cold water
- ½ tsp sea salt
- Vegetable oil for deep‑frying
- Glaze: 2 tbsp white miso, 1 tbsp mirin, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp sesame oil

Instructions:
1. Whisk flour, cornstarch, and salt together; add egg and ice‑cold water, mixing just until combined.
2. Heat oil to 170 °C (340 °F). Dip sweet‑potato rounds in batter, allowing excess to drip off, then fry for 3‑4 minutes until golden.
3. While the tempura cooks, combine miso, mirin, sugar, and sesame oil in a small saucepan; simmer 2‑3 minutes until glossy.
4. Toss the fried sweet‑potato pieces in the miso glaze, coating each piece evenly.
5. Serve immediately, optionally garnished with toasted sesame seeds.
title: Miso‑Glazed Sweet Potato Tempura

text:

Yuzu‑Citrus Tempura Dipping Sauce

Ingredients:
- 8 large shrimp, peeled and deveined
- 1 cup thinly sliced lotus root
- 1 cup shiso leaves
- 1 cup all‑purpose flour
- 1 egg, lightly beaten
- ¾ cup ice‑cold sparkling water
- Vegetable oil for frying
- Dipping sauce: 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp yuzu juice, 1 tsp grated ginger, ½ tsp sugar, 1 tsp chopped green onion

Instructions:
1. Prepare a classic tempura batter by mixing flour, egg, and sparkling water; keep the batter cold.
2. Heat oil to 180 °C (350 °F). Lightly dust shrimp, lotus root, and shiso leaves with flour, dip into batter, and fry: shrimp 2‑3 minutes, lotus root 3‑4 minutes, shiso 8‑10 seconds.
3. Drain fried items on paper towels.
4. In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, yuzu juice, grated ginger, sugar, and green onion until sugar dissolves.
5. Serve the assorted tempura with the bright yuzu dipping sauce.
title: Yuzu‑Citrus Tempura Dipping Sauce

text:
Nonce: 2894c68d66720cd274f7df84d42b59e60761626a
Matcha‑Infused Tempura Batter with Veggie Medley

Ingredients:
- 1 cup all‑purpose flour
- 2 tbsp matcha green tea powder
- ½ tsp baking soda
- 1 egg
- ¾ cup ice‑cold club soda
- ½ tsp salt
- ½ cup sliced shiitake mushrooms
- ½ cup thinly sliced carrot strips
- ½ cup broccoli florets
- Vegetable oil for deep‑frying
- Dipping sauce: 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp rice vinegar, ½ tsp sesame oil, pinch of sea salt

Instructions:
1. Sift flour, matcha powder, baking soda, and salt into a bowl; whisk in egg and club soda until just combined (lumps are fine).
2. Heat oil to 175 °C (345 °F). Lightly coat each vegetable piece with a thin dusting of flour, then dip into the matcha batter.
3. Fry vegetables in batches for 2‑3 minutes until the batter turns a vibrant green and is crisp.
4. Remove and drain on a wire rack.
5. Mix dipping sauce ingredients and serve alongside the matcha‑colored tempura vegetables.
title: Matcha‑Infused Tempura Batter with Veggie Medley

text:

Tempura Udon Soup with Shrimp & Sweet Potato

Ingredients:
- 4 oz udon noodles
- 6 large shrimp, peeled
- 1 small sweet potato, cut into ¼‑inch cubes
- 1 cup tempura batter (flour, egg, ice‑cold water)
- 4 cups dashi broth
- 2 tbsp soy sauce
- 1 tbsp mirin
- ½ tsp salt
- 2 green onions, sliced
- Vegetable oil for frying

Instructions:
1. Cook udon noodles according to package directions; drain and set aside.
2. Heat oil to 180 °C (350 °F). Lightly dust shrimp and sweet‑potato cubes with flour, dip into tempura batter, and fry shrimp 2‑3 minutes, sweet‑potato 3‑4 minutes; drain on paper towels.
3. In a pot, combine dashi, soy sauce, mirin, and salt; bring to a gentle simmer.
4. Divide cooked udon into two bowls, ladle hot broth over the noodles, and top with the fried shrimp and sweet‑potato tempura.
5. Garnish with sliced green onions and serve immediately.
title: Tempura Udon Soup with Shrimp & Sweet Potato

- 4 nori sheets

- 1 tsp sugar

- Wasabi and pickled ginger (optional)

Instructions:
1. Mix cooked sushi rice with rice vinegar, sugar, and salt; let cool to room temperature.
2. Place a nori sheet on a bamboo mat, spread an even layer of rice leaving a ½‑inch border at the top.
3. Lay 2 tempura shrimp, a few sweet‑potato strips, and cucumber julienne across the center of the rice.
4. Roll tightly using the bamboo mat, sealing the edge with a little water.
5. Slice each roll into 6‑8 pieces with a sharp, wet knife.
6. Serve the tempura sushi rolls with soy sauce, wasabi, and pickled ginger.

- ¼ cup thinly sliced radish

- 1 tsp honey
- ½ tsp soy sauce
- Salt and pepper to taste

Instructions:
1. In a large bowl, combine salad greens, cherry tomatoes, radish, and whole shiso leaves.

Tempura‑Fried Ice Cream with Sweet Potato Crumble

Ingredients:
- 4 scoops vanilla ice cream
- ½ cup sweet potato puree
- ¼ cup panko breadcrumbs
- ½ cup all‑purpose flour
- 1 egg, beaten
- ½ cup ice‑cold sparkling water
- Vegetable oil for deep‑frying
- Powdered sugar for dusting
- Optional: caramel sauce for drizzling

Instructions:
1. Form each ice‑cream scoop into a ball and freeze for at least 2 hours.
2. Mix sweet potato puree with panko breadcrumbs; spread a thin layer on a plate.

4. Roll each frozen ice‑cream ball in the sweet‑potato crumb mixture, then dip quickly into the tempura batter.
5. Heat oil to 190 °C (375 °F) and fry each ball for 10‑12 seconds until the coating is golden; remove and drain.
6. Dust with powdered sugar and serve immediately with a drizzle of caramel sauce.

Tempura Bento Box Assortment

Spicy Kimchi & Doenjang Bibimbap

Ingredients:
- 2 cups cooked short‑grain rice, warm
- 1 cup kimchi, chopped
- ½ cup sautéed spinach, seasoned with sesame oil and salt
- ½ cup bean sprouts, blanched
- ¼ cup carrots, julienned and lightly stir‑fried
- ¼ cup shiitake mushrooms, sliced and sautéed
- 2 tbsp gochujang (Korean red‑pepper paste)
- 1 tbsp doenjang (fermented soybean paste)
- 1 tsp honey
- 1 tsp rice vinegar
- 1 sunny‑side‑up egg
- Sesame seeds and sliced scallions for garnish

Instructions:
1. In a small bowl, whisk together gochujang, doenjang, honey, and rice vinegar to create a spicy‑savory sauce.
2. Arrange the warm rice in a large bowl, then artfully place the kimchi, spinach, bean sprouts, carrots, and mushrooms in separate sections on top of the rice.
3. Drizzle the sauce over the vegetables and rice, spreading it lightly.
4. Top the bowl with a sunny‑side‑up egg, letting the yolk sit in the center.
5. Sprinkle sesame seeds and sliced scallions over everything. Mix thoroughly before eating to combine flavors.
title: Spicy Kimchi & Doenjang Bibimbap

Beef Bulgogi Bibimbap with Doenjang Glaze

- ½ cup carrots, julienned and sautéed

- 1 tbsp doenjang
- 1 tbsp soy sauce
- 1 tsp sesame oil
- 1 sunny‑side‑up egg
- Toasted sesame seeds and chopped garlic chives for garnish

2. In a small saucepan, combine gochujang, doenjang, and a splash of water; simmer for 2 minutes to form a glossy glaze.
3. Toss the cooked rice with the glaze, coating it evenly.
4. Arrange the glazed rice in a bowl, then place the bulgogi, zucchini, carrots, and spinach around the rim.
5. Place the sunny‑side‑up egg on top, sprinkle with sesame seeds and garlic chives, and enjoy after mixing.

- 1 sunny‑side‑up egg

3. Arrange the mushrooms, kelp, cucumber, and bean sprouts over the rice.
4. Drizzle the remaining sauce across the top, then place the sunny‑side‑up egg in the center.
5. Garnish with crushed seaweed and sesame seeds. Mix everything together before eating.
