Classic Vietnamese Bánh Xèo

Ingredients:
- 1 cup rice flour
- ¼ cup tapioca starch
- 1 ½ cups coconut milk
- ¼ tsp turmeric powder
- ¼ tsp salt
- ½ cup thinly sliced pork belly
- 8 large shrimp, peeled and deveined
- 1 cup bean sprouts
- 2 green onions, sliced
- Handful of fresh Thai basil leaves
- Handful of cilantro
- 2 tbsp vegetable oil (for frying)
- Nuoc cham dipping sauce (fish sauce, lime, sugar, garlic, chili)

Instructions:
1. In a bowl whisk rice flour, tapioca starch, turmeric, salt, and coconut milk until smooth; let rest 15 minutes.
2. Heat a non‑stick skillet over medium‑high heat and brush lightly with oil.
3. Add pork slices and shrimp; cook 1‑2 minutes until pink, then set aside.
4. Stir the batter, then pour a thin ladleful into the hot pan, swirling to coat the surface.
5. Immediately scatter bean sprouts, green onions, cooked pork, shrimp, basil, and cilantro over half the crepe.
6. Fold the crepe in half and press gently; cook another 30 seconds until edges are crisp.
7. Transfer to a plate, serve with nuoc cham for dipping.
title: Classic Vietnamese Bánh Xèo

text:
Nonce: c11d37357d6a17d1e9894a9e8de156b8f923f809
Vegetarian Bánh Xèo with Tofu & Mushroom

Ingredients:
- 1 cup rice flour
- ¼ cup cornstarch
- 1 ¼ cups coconut milk
- ¼ tsp turmeric
- ¼ tsp sea salt
- 200 g firm tofu, cubed
- 1 cup mixed mushrooms, sliced
- 1 cup bean sprouts
- 2 tbsp chopped scallions
- 1 handful mint leaves
- 2 tbsp peanut oil
- Nuoc cham (vegetarian version: soy sauce, lime, sugar, garlic, chili)

Instructions:
1. Whisk together rice flour, cornstarch, turmeric, salt, and coconut milk; rest 10 minutes.
2. In a pan, sauté tofu cubes and mushrooms in peanut oil until golden; set aside.
3. Heat a clean skillet, brush with a thin layer of oil, and pour a ladle of batter, swirling thin.
4. Sprinkle bean sprouts, scallions, sautéed tofu‑mushroom mix, and mint over half the crepe.
5. Fold the crepe, press lightly, and cook until the edges turn crispy, about 45 seconds.
6. Slide onto a serving plate and accompany with vegetarian nuoc cham.
title: Vegetarian Bánh Xèo with Tofu & Mushroom

text:
Nonce: 47824afb399629b837ec4bee52b9347cbaaab76f
Chicken & Lemongrass Bánh Xèo

Ingredients:
- 1 cup rice flour
- ¼ cup rice starch
- 1 ½ cups coconut milk
- ¼ tsp turmeric
- ¼ tsp salt
- 200 g chicken breast, thinly sliced
- 1 stalk lemongrass, minced (white part only)
- 1 tbsp fish sauce
- 1 cup bean sprouts
- 2 tbsp chopped cilantro
- 2 tbsp vegetable oil
- Nuoc cham

Instructions:
1. Combine rice flour, rice starch, turmeric, salt, and coconut milk; whisk until smooth and let sit 10 minutes.
2. Marinate chicken slices with minced lemongrass and fish sauce for 10 minutes.
3. Heat oil in a skillet; quickly stir‑fry the chicken until just cooked; set aside.
4. Pour batter into the hot pan, swirling to form a thin layer.
5. Distribute bean sprouts, cilantro, and the lemongrass‑chicken over half the crepe.
6. Fold, press, and fry until the edges are golden and crisp, about 40 seconds.
7. Serve hot with nuoc cham.
title: Chicken & Lemongrass Bánh Xèo

text:
Nonce: 62ad1ff9aa74e327fceb8e502900529ab555621d
Quinoa‑Infused Bánh Xèo (Gluten‑Free)

Ingredients:
- ¾ cup rice flour
- ¼ cup quinoa flour
- ¼ cup tapioca starch
- 1 ¼ cups coconut milk
- ¼ tsp turmeric
- ¼ tsp sea salt
- 150 g shrimp, peeled
- ½ cup shredded carrots
- 1 cup bean sprouts
- 2 tbsp chopped Thai basil
- 2 tbsp coconut oil
- Gluten‑free nuoc cham (tamari, lime, sugar, garlic, chili)

Instructions:
1. Whisk rice flour, quinoa flour, tapioca starch, turmeric, salt, and coconut milk until smooth; rest 15 minutes.
2. Heat coconut oil in a non‑stick pan; add shrimp and cook until pink, then remove.
3. Pour a thin layer of batter into the pan, swirling to coat.
4. Sprinkle carrots, bean sprouts, basil, and the cooked shrimp over half the crepe.
5. Fold the crepe, press gently, and fry until edges are crisp, about 30 seconds.
6. Serve immediately with gluten‑free nuoc cham.
title: Quinoa‑Infused Bánh Xèo (Gluten‑Free)

text:
Nonce: ff61f87aca11a6c653b84cbad8ac5613092768ab
Spicy Beef Bánh Xèo with Sriracha Mayo

Ingredients:
- 1 cup rice flour
- ¼ cup corn starch
- 1 ¼ cups coconut milk
- ¼ tsp turmeric
- ¼ tsp salt
- 200 g thinly sliced beef sirloin
- 1 tbsp soy sauce
- 1 tsp sriracha
- 1 cup bean sprouts
- 2 tbsp sliced red onion
- 1 handful coriander leaves
- 2 tbsp vegetable oil
- Sriracha mayo (mayonnaise mixed with sriracha)

Instructions:
1. Mix rice flour, corn starch, turmeric, salt, and coconut milk; whisk well and let rest 10 minutes.
2. Toss beef with soy sauce and sriracha; set aside 5 minutes.
3. Heat oil in a skillet; quickly sear the beef until medium‑rare, then remove.
4. Pour batter into the hot pan, swirling to create a thin sheet.
5. Scatter bean sprouts, red onion, cooked beef, and coriander over half the crepe.
6. Fold, press, and fry until the edges turn golden, about 35 seconds.
7. Drizzle sriracha mayo on top before serving with nuoc cham.
title: Spicy Beef Bánh Xèo with Sriracha Mayo

text:
Nonce: 659a25af00f859745993204cc1f3dd8a3d932d24
Sweet Banana Bánh Xèo Dessert

Ingredients:
- 1 cup rice flour
- ¼ cup sweet rice flour
- 1 ¼ cups coconut milk
- ¼ tsp turmeric (optional for color)
- ¼ tsp salt
- 2 ripe bananas, sliced thin
- 2 tbsp toasted coconut flakes
- 1 tbsp melted butter
- Maple‑sugar drizzle
- Whipped coconut cream (optional)

Instructions:
1. Whisk together rice flour, sweet rice flour, turmeric, salt, and coconut milk until smooth; rest 10 minutes.
2. Heat a non‑stick pan and brush with melted butter.
3. Pour a thin layer of batter, swirling to coat the surface.
4. Arrange banana slices and toasted coconut over half the crepe.
5. Fold the crepe, press lightly, and cook until edges are lightly crisp, about 30 seconds.
6. Transfer to a plate, drizzle with maple‑sugar and serve with a dollop of whipped coconut cream.
title: Sweet Banana Bánh Xèo Dessert

text:
Nonce: 2f0e86f63e919a9de89d4b5c56944ce5fc86c165
Kimchi‑Infused Bánh Xèo with Pork Belly

Ingredients:
- 1 cup rice flour
- ¼ cup potato starch
- 1 ¼ cups coconut milk
- ¼ tsp turmeric
- ¼ tsp salt
- 150 g pork belly, thinly sliced
- ½ cup kimchi, chopped
- 1 cup bean sprouts
- 2 tbsp sliced scallions
- 2 tbsp sesame oil
- Nuoc cham with extra chili

Instructions:
1. Combine rice flour, potato starch, turmeric, salt, and coconut milk; whisk and rest 10 minutes.
2. In a skillet, sear pork belly in sesame oil until crisp; set aside.
3. Heat the pan, brush with a little oil, and pour batter, swirling thin.
4. Sprinkle bean sprouts, scallions, kimchi, and pork belly over half the crepe.
5. Fold, press, and fry until the edges are crispy, about 40 seconds.
6. Serve hot with spicy nuoc cham.
title: Kimchi‑Infused Bánh Xèo with Pork Belly

text:
Nonce: e0fb67a048cf2ecd344c7f1811b3e9498b866fe5
Herb‑Rich Bánh Xèo with Shrimp & Lime Zest

Ingredients:
- 1 cup rice flour
- ¼ cup rice starch
- 1 ¼ cups coconut milk
- ¼ tsp turmeric
- ¼ tsp sea salt
- 8 large shrimp, peeled
- Zest of 1 lime
- 1 cup bean sprouts
- ¼ cup shredded lettuce
- 2 tbsp chopped mint
- 2 tbsp chopped cilantro
- 2 tbsp vegetable oil
- Nuoc cham with extra lime juice

Instructions:
1. Whisk rice flour, rice starch, turmeric, salt, and coconut milk; let rest 10 minutes.
2. Toss shrimp with lime zest; set aside.
3. Heat oil in a skillet; pour a thin layer of batter, swirling to coat.
4. Distribute bean sprouts, lettuce, mint, cilantro, and lime‑zested shrimp over half the crepe.
5. Fold, press, and fry until edges are golden and crisp, about 30 seconds.
6. Serve with nuoc cham enriched with extra lime juice.
title: Herb‑Rich Bánh Xèo with Shrimp & Lime Zest

text:
Nonce: 15e7f34f8d1d99b03f9706eb93b3dbeb2c58cf2d
Coconut‑Caramel Bánh Xèo with Mango

Ingredients:
- 1 cup rice flour
- ¼ cup sweet rice flour
- 1 ¼ cups coconut milk
- ¼ tsp turmeric (optional)
- ¼ tsp salt
- 1 ripe mango, thinly sliced
- 2 tbsp coconut sugar
- 1 tbsp coconut oil
- 2 tbsp toasted coconut flakes
- Coconut‑caramel sauce (coconut milk, sugar, pinch of salt, simmered)
- Whipped coconut cream (optional)

Instructions:
1. Whisk rice flour, sweet rice flour, turmeric, salt, and coconut milk; rest 10 minutes.
2. Heat a pan, brush with coconut oil, and pour a thin layer of batter, swirling to coat.
3. Arrange mango slices and toasted coconut over half the crepe.
4. Fold, press, and cook until edges are lightly crisp, about 30 seconds.
5. Drizzle warm coconut‑caramel sauce over the crepe and serve with a spoonful of whipped coconut cream.
title: Coconut‑Caramel Bánh Xèo with Mango

text:
Nonce: 0ac0e6aafca3e94ac5b01b83d27c3f639bafc17c
Seaweed‑Wrapped Bánh Xèo with Fish Fillet

Ingredients:
- 1 cup rice flour
- ¼ cup tapioca starch
- 1 ¼ cups coconut milk
- ¼ tsp turmeric
- ¼ tsp salt
- 200 g white fish fillet (e.g., cod), cut into strips
- 1 tbsp fish sauce
- 1 tsp minced garlic
- 1 cup bean sprouts
- 2 tbsp chopped scallions
- 4 sheets nori seaweed, cut to size
- 2 tbsp vegetable oil
- Nuoc cham with added fish sauce

Instructions:
1. Whisk rice flour, tapioca starch, turmeric, salt, and coconut milk; let rest 10 minutes.
2. Marinate fish strips in fish sauce and garlic for 5 minutes; then quickly pan‑sear until opaque; set aside.
3. Heat oil in a skillet; pour a thin layer of batter, swirling to coat.
4. Place bean sprouts, scallions, and cooked fish strips over half the crepe.
5. Fold the crepe, then wrap the folded crepe in a nori sheet, sealing the edge with a dab of water.
6. Press gently and fry the wrapped crepe for another 20 seconds to crisp the seaweed.
7. Serve with nuoc cham.
title: Seaweed‑Wrapped Bánh Xèo with Fish Fillet

text:
Nonce: 3e169e7ca80a88502666b38aad25021b884c4106
Chimichurri Ribeye Steak with Charred Sweet Potato Wedges

Ingredients:
- 1 ribeye steak (≈300 g)
- 2 large sweet potatoes, cut into wedges
- 1 cup fresh parsley, finely chopped
- 3 cloves garlic, minced
- ¼ cup olive oil
- 2 tbsp red wine vinegar
- 1 tsp smoked paprika
- Salt and freshly ground black pepper
- 1 tbsp butter

Instructions:
1. Preheat the grill to medium‑high heat and the oven to 200 °C (390 °F).
2. Toss sweet‑potato wedges with 1 tbsp olive oil, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper; spread on a baking sheet and roast 25 minutes, turning once, until caramelized.
3. Meanwhile, combine parsley, garlic, remaining olive oil, red wine vinegar, and a pinch of salt to make chimichurri; set aside.
4. Season the ribeye generously with salt and pepper, then grill 4‑5 minutes per side for medium‑rare; during the last minute, add butter to the grill and baste the steak.
5. Rest the steak 5 minutes, then slice against the grain and brush with chimichurri.
6. Serve the sliced steak alongside the charred sweet‑potato wedges, drizzling any remaining chimichurri over the top.
title: Chimichurri Ribeye Steak with Charred Sweet Potato Wedges

text:
Nonce: 5b840548e183f77df0e5569752b0e69e30ff523a
Chimichurri Grilled Chicken Thighs with Garlic Roasted Potatoes

Ingredients:
- 4 bone‑in, skin‑on chicken thighs
- 1 kg baby potatoes, halved
- 1 cup parsley, chopped
- 2 cloves garlic, minced (plus 2 whole cloves for potatoes)
- ¼ cup olive oil
- 2 tbsp red wine vinegar
- 1 tsp dried oregano
- Salt and pepper
- 1 tbsp melted butter

Instructions:
1. In a bowl, whisk together parsley, minced garlic, olive oil, red wine vinegar, oregano, salt, and pepper; reserve half for the chicken.
2. Toss the potatoes with melted butter, whole garlic cloves, salt, and pepper; spread on a baking sheet and roast 30 minutes at 200 °C, turning halfway.
3. Coat the chicken thighs with the remaining chimichurri mixture; let them sit 10 minutes.
4. Grill the chicken over medium heat, skin side down, 6‑7 minutes per side, until internal temperature reaches 74 °C (165 °F).
5. Slice the chicken and serve over the roasted garlic potatoes, drizzling any extra chimichurri on top.
title: Chimichurri Grilled Chicken Thighs with Garlic Roasted Potatoes

text:
Nonce: e0c6fcf54c356f0215a150b02f65abaeb80bc87c
Chimichurri Lamb Kebabs with Herb‑Infused Potato Salad

Ingredients:
- 500 g lamb shoulder, cubed
- 4 large potatoes, diced
- 1 cup parsley, chopped
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- ¼ cup olive oil
- 2 tbsp red wine vinegar
- 1 tsp ground cumin
- 1 tsp smoked paprika
- Salt and pepper
- 2 tbsp mayonnaise
- 1 tbsp lemon juice
- Skewers (metal or soaked wooden)

Instructions:
1. Mix parsley, garlic, olive oil, red wine vinegar, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper; toss the lamb cubes in the mixture and marinate 30 minutes.
2. Boil the diced potatoes until tender, drain, and let cool.
3. In a bowl, combine mayonnaise, lemon juice, chopped parsley, salt, and pepper; fold into the cooled potatoes for a herb‑infused salad.
4. Thread the lamb onto skewers and grill over medium‑high heat, turning every 2 minutes, until browned and cooked to desired doneness (≈8 minutes total).
5. Serve the kebabs with a generous side of parsley potato salad and drizzle any remaining chimichurri over the meat.
title: Chimichurri Lamb Kebabs with Herb‑Infused Potato Salad

text:
Nonce: 5cbeb486c87d903556435a40526ab4a738a77a6a
Chimichurri Steak Tacos with Spicy Potato Filling

Ingredients:
- 300 g flank steak
- 8 small corn tortillas
- 2 large potatoes, peeled and diced
- 1 cup parsley, finely chopped
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- ¼ cup olive oil
- 2 tbsp red wine vinegar
- 1 tsp chili powder
- ½ tsp cayenne pepper
- Salt and pepper
- 1 tbsp lime juice
- Fresh cilantro leaves (optional)

Instructions:
1. Combine parsley, garlic, olive oil, red wine vinegar, lime juice, salt, and pepper to make chimichurri; set aside.
2. Toss diced potatoes with chili powder, cayenne, salt, and a drizzle of oil; sauté in a skillet over medium heat until crispy and golden, about 12 minutes; keep warm.
3. Season the flank steak with salt and pepper, then grill over high heat 3‑4 minutes per side for medium‑rare; let rest 5 minutes and slice thinly.
4. Warm the corn tortillas on the grill or in a dry pan.
5. Assemble each taco: layer steak slices, top with spicy potatoes, drizzle chimichurri, and garnish with cilantro if desired. Serve immediately.
title: Chimichurri Steak Tacos with Spicy Potato Filling

text:
Nonce: f06c93c2252405f56e307154827af7b5d42e9963
Chimichurri Steak Salad with Warm Potato Croutons

Ingredients:
- 250 g sirloin steak
- 4 cups mixed salad greens
- 2 large potatoes, cut into 1 cm cubes
- 1 cup parsley, chopped
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- ¼ cup olive oil
- 2 tbsp red wine vinegar
- 1 tsp smoked paprika
- Salt and pepper
- 2 tbsp shaved Parmesan (optional)

Instructions:
1. Toss potato cubes with olive oil, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper; bake at 200 °C for 20 minutes until crisp, turning once.
2. Meanwhile, blend parsley, garlic, remaining olive oil, red wine vinegar, salt, and pepper to create chimichurri.
3. Season the steak with salt and pepper; grill over medium‑high heat 4 minutes per side for medium; rest 5 minutes, then slice thinly.
4. In a large bowl, combine salad greens, warm potato croutons, and sliced steak; drizzle generously with chimichurri and toss gently.
5. Top with shaved Parmesan if using, and serve immediately.
title: Chimichurri Steak Salad with Warm Potato Croutons

text:
Nonce: 05883e192489adf3ef72205bf3882a4e79036ebe
Chimichurri Beef Stir‑Fry with Potato Noodles

Ingredients:
- 300 g thinly sliced beef (e.g., top round)
- 2 large potatoes, spiralized into noodles
- 1 cup parsley, chopped
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- ¼ cup olive oil
- 2 tbsp red wine vinegar
- 1 tbsp soy sauce
- 1 tsp ground cumin
- Salt and pepper
- 1 tbsp sesame oil
- 1 tbsp toasted sesame seeds (optional)

Instructions:
1. Prepare chimichurri by mixing parsley, garlic, olive oil, red wine vinegar, cumin, salt, and pepper; set aside.
2. Heat sesame oil in a wok over high heat; add beef slices and stir‑fry 2‑3 minutes until browned; remove and keep warm.
3. Add the potato noodles to the wok, stir‑fry 3‑4 minutes until just tender; season with soy sauce, salt, and pepper.
4. Return the beef to the wok, pour the chimichurri over everything, and toss quickly to coat.
5. Transfer to plates, sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds, and serve hot.
title: Chimichurri Beef Stir‑Fry with Potato Noodles

text:
Nonce: eeead8d30b01ee1b8e177d71bd0f01a4c3601b30
Chimichurri Steak Pizza with Potato Slices

Ingredients:
- 1 pre‑made pizza dough (≈250 g)
- 200 g thinly sliced steak (e.g., ribeye)
- 1 large potato, thinly sliced
- 1 cup parsley, chopped
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- ¼ cup olive oil
- 2 tbsp red wine vinegar
- 1 tsp dried oregano
- Salt and pepper
- 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 250 °C (475 °F) with a pizza stone inside.
2. Toss potato slices with olive oil, oregano, salt, and pepper; arrange on a baking sheet and roast 12 minutes until just softened.
3. In a small bowl, combine parsley, garlic, remaining olive oil, red wine vinegar, salt, and pepper to make chimichurri.
4. Stretch the pizza dough on a parchment sheet, spread a thin layer of chimichurri, sprinkle mozzarella, then layer steak slices and roasted potato rounds.
5. Slide the pizza onto the hot stone and bake 8‑10 minutes, until crust is golden and cheese melted.
6. Remove, drizzle a little extra chimichurri, slice, and serve.
title: Chimichurri Steak Pizza with Potato Slices

text:
Nonce: c2fb5c3f599880b982b14f24db4e7bfaef79d9b0
Chimichurri Steak Sandwich on Rustic Bread with Potato Chips

Ingredients:
- 2 ciabatta rolls or rustic bread halves
- 250 g grilled steak (e.g., striploin), sliced
- 1 large potato, cut into thin chips
- 1 cup parsley, chopped
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- ¼ cup olive oil
- 2 tbsp red wine vinegar
- 1 tsp smoked paprika
- Salt and pepper
- 2 tbsp mayonnaise
- 1 tbsp Dijon mustard

Instructions:
1. Toss potato chips with smoked paprika, salt, and a drizzle of olive oil; bake at 200 °C for 20 minutes, turning once, until crisp.
2. Blend parsley, garlic, olive oil, red wine vinegar, salt, and pepper to create chimichurri.
3. Mix mayonnaise and Dijon mustard; spread on the cut sides of the bread.
4. Layer sliced steak on the bottom half, drizzle generously with chimichurri, then top with the other half of bread.
5. Serve the sandwich with a side of crunchy potato chips and an extra drizzle of chimichurri for dipping.
title: Chimichurri Steak Sandwich on Rustic Bread with Potato Chips

text:
Nonce: a7f414cbb5382fdbcc926f2c4cfd118ea303ee76
Chimichurri Steak Soup with Potato Dumplings

Ingredients:
- 200 g beef sirloin, cut into bite‑size cubes
- 4 cups beef broth
- 2 large potatoes, boiled and mashed
- 1 cup parsley, finely chopped
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- ¼ cup olive oil
- 2 tbsp red wine vinegar
- 1 tsp smoked paprika
- Salt and pepper
- 1 tbsp flour
- 1 tbsp butter

Instructions:
1. Prepare chimichurri by mixing parsley, garlic, olive oil, red wine vinegar, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper; set aside.
2. In a pot, bring beef broth to a simmer; add beef cubes and cook 10 minutes until tender.
3. For dumplings, combine mashed potatoes, flour, butter, and a pinch of salt; form small balls (≈1 cm) and drop into the simmering soup; cook 5 minutes until dumplings float.
4. Stir chimichurri into the soup just before serving, adjusting seasoning as needed.
5. Ladle soup into bowls, ensuring each serving gets several potato dumplings and a generous spoonful of chimichurri‑infused broth.
title: Chimichurri Steak Soup with Potato Dumplings

text:
Nonce: 776f9475674e33e26de545cf8a4d8d33b990e244
Chimichurri Steak Ramen with Crispy Potato Garnish

Ingredients:
- 200 g thinly sliced steak (e.g., ribeye)
- 4 cups chicken or beef broth
- 2 packs ramen noodles
- 1 large potato, cut into matchsticks
- 1 cup parsley, chopped
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- ¼ cup olive oil
- 2 tbsp red wine vinegar
- 1 tsp soy sauce
- 1 tsp sesame oil
- Salt and pepper
- 1 soft‑boiled egg (optional)
- 2 tbsp sliced green onions

Instructions:
1. Make chimichurri by blending parsley, garlic, olive oil, red wine vinegar, salt, and pepper; set aside.
2. Heat oil in a pan and fry potato matchsticks until golden and crispy; drain on paper towels and season with salt.
3. In a pot, bring broth to a boil, add soy sauce and sesame oil, then cook ramen noodles according to package; drain and divide noodles into bowls.
4. Quickly sear steak slices in a hot skillet, 1‑2 minutes per side, then slice thinly.
5. Assemble each ramen bowl: place noodles, pour hot broth over, arrange steak slices on top, drizzle chimichurri, add crispy potato garnish, sliced egg, and green onions. Enjoy immediately.
title: Chimichurri Steak Ramen with Crispy Potato Garnish
